title.en: Trump threatens EU with ‘serious tariffs’ after proposal to make Canada first associate member – Europe live
title.zh: 特朗普威胁对欧盟实施‘严重关税’，此前欧盟提议让加拿大成为首个准成员国 – 欧洲实时报道

summary.en: US president Donald Trump has threatened the European Union with "serious tariffs" and a cut to trade after the bloc proposed to make Canada its first ever associate member, calling the idea "laughable" and a "hostile act." European Commission president Ursula von der Leyen stated the partnership is for the EU's...
summary.zh: 美国总统唐纳德·特朗普威胁要对欧盟实施“严重关税”并切断贸易，此前欧盟提议让加拿大成为其首个准成员国，他称这一想法“可笑”且是“敌对行为”。欧盟委员会主席乌尔苏拉·冯德莱恩表示，该伙伴关系是为了欧盟的“共同力量”，而不是针对任何人。

body.en:
US president Donald Trump has threatened the European Union with “serious tariffs” and a cut to trade after the bloc proposed to make Canada its first ever associate member, calling the idea “laughable”.

Suggesting the move was a “hostile act”, the US president told reporters he could put “very serious tariffs or stop trading with Europe”. He added: “If it’s a good intention, that’s fine. If it’s a bad intention, we’ll put very heavy tariffs on Europe .”

European Commision president Ursula von der Leyen insisted yesterday that “this is not a partnership against anyone else, but for our common strength,” and deputy chief spokesperson Olof Gill repeated this line this morning in response to Trump’s overnight threats.

Canadian prime minister Mark Carney – fresh from watching Everton’s Carabao Cup win over Wolverhampton Wanderers in Liverpool – will address the European parliament late morning. Let’s see if he has anything to say on this.

Separately, our attention is increasingly turning to Germany , where embattled chancellor Friedrich Merz is set to join the campaign trail today in Berlin ahead of this weekend’s two state elections that just could determine his political future.

Powerful German state leaders from his party have rallied behind the chancellor as speculation builds that his days in office may be numbered, and he cancelled his trip to the UN general assembly next week.

Our Berlin correspondent Deborah Cole will be joining us just after 11am to answer your questions about Merz’s future, the two state elections, and what’s next for Germany . You can post your questions to her below the line from 9am.

It’s Thursday, 17 September 2026 , it’s Jakub Krupa here, and this is Europe Live .
body.zh: 在欧盟提议让加拿大成为其第一个准成员后，美国总统唐纳德·特朗普威胁要对欧盟征收“严厉关税”并削减贸易，称这个想法“可笑”。 美国总统暗示此举是“敌对行为”，他告诉记者，他可以征收“非常严厉的关税或停止与欧洲的贸易”。他补充道：“如果是善意，那很好。如果是恶意，我们将对欧洲征收非常高的关税。” 欧盟委员会主席乌苏拉·冯德莱恩昨天坚称，“这不是针对其他任何人的伙伴关系，而是为了我们共同的力量”，副首席发言人奥洛夫·吉尔今天早上重申了这一立场，以回应特朗普隔夜的威胁。 刚刚观看完埃弗顿在利物浦战胜狼队的联赛杯比赛的加拿大总理马克·卡尼将于上午晚些时候在欧洲议会发表讲话。让我们看看他对此有什么要说的。 另外，我们的注意力越来越多地转向德国，四面楚歌的德国总理弗里德里希·梅尔茨将于今天在柏林参加竞选活动，本周末将举行两场州选举，这可能决定他的政治未来。 由于猜测他的任期可能屈指可数，来自该党的强大德国国家领导人纷纷团结起来支持总理，他取消了下周出席联合国大会的行程。 我们的柏林记者黛博拉·科尔 (Deborah Cole) 将于上午 11 点过后加入我们，回答您有关梅尔茨的未来、两次州选举以及德国下一步的问题。您可以从上午 9 点开始将您的问题在下面留言给她。 今天是 2026 年 9 月 17 日，星期四，我是 Jakub Krupa，这里是 Europe Live。

reflection.en: In response to the EU's proposal for a partnership with Canada, President Trump has threatened "serious tariffs" and trade cuts, framing the move as a "hostile act." The European Commission president, however, insists the partnership is for "common strength." This exchange highlights the delicate balance in international relations, where actions can be...
reflection.zh: 针对欧盟提出的与加拿大的伙伴关系提议，特朗普总统威胁要实施“严重关税”和贸易削减，并将此举定性为“敌对行为”。然而，欧盟委员会主席坚持认为该伙伴关系是为了“共同力量”。这种交流凸显了国际关系中微妙的平衡，行动可能被不同地解读，从而导致潜在的冲突而非互利。‘与众人和睦’的呼吁在这样的外交紧张局势中是一个持续的挑战。

verse.textEn: If it is possible, as far as it depends on you, live at peace with everyone.
verse.textZh: 若是能行，总要尽力与众人和睦。

title.en: One dead after torrential rain and flash floods hit Barcelona region
title.zh: 巴塞罗那地区遭遇暴雨洪水，一人死亡

summary.en: Torrential rain and flash floods have caused widespread disruption across the Valencia and Catalonia regions of north-east Spain, resulting in one fatality.
summary.zh: 西班牙东北部的巴伦西亚和加泰罗尼亚地区遭遇了暴雨和洪水，造成大范围混乱，并导致一人死亡。

body.en:
North-eastern Spain has been hit by torrential rain and flash floods, leaving one person dead and causing widespread disruption across the region.

Spain's national weather agency AEMET issued warnings for heavy rain across eastern regions on Wednesday, including a red alert for Barcelona's coastline.

Rescuers recovered the body of a man on Thursday in Olivella, around 40km (25 miles) west of Barcelona, after his car was swept away by a stream, authorities said.

The deluge has disrupted travel across Catalonia and Valencia, with flights cancelled and roads submerged. Authorities have advised against unnecessary travel, while Prime Minister Pedro Sanchez warned of "very complicated situations".

Emergency services in Catalonia said they received more than 850 calls related to the downpours and catalogued over 500 incidents.

Catalan firefighters said on X on Thursday that they had recovered the "lifeless body of a man" in Olivella, correcting earlier reports that had identified the missing person as a woman.

Videos shared on social media showed partially submerged cars and rescue workers attempting to reach a vehicle trapped in a heavily flooded underpass.

In Barcelona, some metro stations were closed and buses diverted, while regional trains were disrupted and flights delayed or cancelled at El Prat airport.

Neighbouring Valencia had more than 70mm (2.76in) of rain fall in just half an hour in several municipalities, according to AVAMET.

"Rarely have we seen such rainfall accumulations in 30 minutes," the meteorological association said on X.

Emergency services reported 478 incidents in the Valencia province, mostly involving property damage, leaks and traffic disruption.

In the regional capital, all metro lines were suspended and the city's airport shuttered for several hours, causing flights to be diverted.

The downpour comes as Spain emerges from its hottest summer on record and an exceptionally warm start to September.

Scientists say human-driven climate change is intensifying the Mediterranean storms that typically hit eastern Spain in autumn.

The Mediterranean Sea absorbs heat during summer, increasing evaporation and contributing to heavier rainfall when storms develop.

The flooding comes less than two years after devastating flooding in Valencia killed more than 230 people .
body.zh: 西班牙东北部遭受暴雨和山洪袭击，造成一人死亡，并造成该地区大范围破坏。 西班牙国家气象局 AEMET 周三发布东部地区大雨警告，其中包括巴塞罗那海岸线的红色警报。 当局称，周四，救援人员在巴塞罗那以西约 40 公里（25 英里）的奥利维拉发现了一名男子的尸体，他的汽车被溪流冲走了。 洪水扰乱了加泰罗尼亚和巴伦西亚的旅行，航班取消，道路被淹没。当局建议不要进行不必要的旅行，而总理佩德罗·桑切斯则警告称“情况非常复杂”。 加泰罗尼亚紧急服务部门表示，他们接到了 850 多个与暴雨有关的电话，并记录了 500 多起事件。 加泰罗尼亚消防员周四表示，他们在奥利维拉找到了“一具毫无生气的男性尸体”，纠正了此前有关失踪者为女性的报道。 社交媒体上分享的视频显示，汽车部分被淹没，救援人员试图救援被困在严重淹没的地下通道中的车辆。 在巴塞罗那，一些地铁站关闭，公交车改道，埃尔普拉特机场的地区列车中断，航班延误或取消。 据 AVAMET 称，邻近巴伦西亚的几个城市在短短半小时内降雨量就超过 70 毫米（2.76 英寸）。 气象协会表示：“30分钟内出现如此大的降雨量是罕见的。” 紧急服务部门报告瓦伦西亚省发生了 478 起事故，大部分涉及财产损失、泄漏和交通中断。 在该地区首府，所有地铁线路暂停，该市机场关闭数小时，导致航班改道。 这场倾盆大雨来临之际，西班牙刚刚摆脱了有记录以来最热的夏季，九月的开局异常温暖。 科学家表示，人类造成的气候变化正在加剧通常在秋季袭击西班牙东部的地中海风暴。 地中海在夏季吸收热量，增加蒸发，并在风暴发生时导致降雨量增加。 距离巴伦西亚发生毁灭性洪水导致 230 多人死亡不到两年，又发生了此次洪水。

reflection.en: The devastating floods in Spain serve as a stark reminder of nature's power and the fragility of human life. In the face of such loss and disruption, it is easy to fall into despair. Yet, even in suffering, the possibility of resilience and hope remains, as communities begin the long process of recovery and rebuilding.
reflection.zh: 西班牙的毁灭性洪水提醒我们大自然的力量和人类生命的脆弱。面对如此的损失和混乱，人们很容易陷入绝望。然而，即使在苦难中，韧性和希望的可能性依然存在，社区将开始漫长的恢复和重建过程。

verse.textEn: We also glory in our sufferings, because we know that suffering produces perseverance; perseverance, character; and character, hope.
verse.textZh: 就是在患难中也是欢欢喜喜的；因为知道患难生忍耐，忍耐生老练，老练生盼望。

title.en: EU announces plan to restrict social media access for children
title.zh: 欧盟宣布计划限制儿童使用社交媒体

summary.en: The EU has unveiled plans to limit children's access to social media, with those under 13 banned entirely and 13-15 year olds restricted to 'mini accounts' for one hour daily, aiming to enhance online safety and parental control.
summary.zh: 欧盟公布了限制儿童使用社交媒体的计划，禁止13岁以下儿童使用，并限制13至15岁的儿童每天只能使用“迷你账户”一小时，旨在提高网络安全和加强家长控制。

body.en:
The EU has announced plans to restrict social media access for under-16s across its member states, in a bid to increase wellbeing and tackle online safety.

Under the plans, there would be a gradual approach to children using social media which would include banning under 13s from accessing platforms.

Those aged 13 to 15 would only be able to access platforms for an hour per day via "mini accounts" set up through their parent or guardian's social media account.

The European Commission said social media companies would need to prove their platforms were safe by design, while EU chief Ursula von der Leyen said the move would "put parents back in the driving seat".

She added the legislation - called the EU Kids Act - would give parents "the tools to help their children navigate a safer world".

Under the act, only children aged 15 and over would be able to set up their own social media accounts.

Von der Leyen has previously proposed a social media "delay" for children in Europe, saying in May that "the discussion about a minimum age for social media can no longer be ignored".

The policy, formally outlined on Thursday, was also trailed in the EU chief's annual address to the EU Parliament on Wednesday.

Some individual EU countries have already announced their own separate plans to restrict social media for children, including France and Spain.
body.zh: 欧盟已宣布计划限制其成员国 16 岁以下青少年使用社交媒体，以提高福祉并解决网络安全问题。 根据该计划，将对儿童使用社交媒体采取渐进的方式，其中包括禁止 13 岁以下儿童访问平台。 13 至 15 岁的人每天只能通过父母或监护人的社交媒体帐户设置的“迷你帐户”访问平台一小时。 欧盟委员会表示，社交媒体公司需要证明其平台在设计上是安全的，而欧盟主席乌苏拉·冯德莱恩表示，此举将“让父母重新掌握主导权”。 她补充说，这项名为《欧盟儿童法案》的立法将为父母提供“帮助他们的孩子驾驭一个更安全的世界的工具”。 根据该法案，只有 15 岁及以上的儿童才能建立自己的社交媒体帐户。 冯德莱恩此前曾提议对欧洲儿童“推迟”社交媒体，并在五月表示“关于社交媒体最低年龄的讨论不能再被忽视”。 这项政策于周四正式概述，周三欧盟主席向欧盟议会发表的年度讲话中也提到了这一政策。 一些欧盟国家已经宣布了自己的单独计划，限制儿童使用社交媒体，其中包括法国和西班牙。

reflection.en: The European Union's proposed restrictions on social media for minors, including a ban for those under 13 and limited access for 13-15 year olds, highlight a growing concern for the well-being of children in the digital age. This effort to protect vulnerable young people and empower parents reflects the biblical call to advocate for those who cannot fully...
reflection.zh: 欧盟提议限制未成年人使用社交媒体，包括禁止13岁以下儿童使用，并限制13至15岁儿童的使用时间，这凸显了人们对数字时代儿童福祉日益增长的担忧。这项旨在保护弱势青少年和赋权父母的举措，呼应了圣经中为那些无法完全为自己辩护的人发声的呼召，以确保他们的安全和健康成长。

verse.textEn: Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for the rights of all who are destitute. Speak up and judge fairly; defend the rights of the poor and needy.
verse.textZh: 你当为不能自辩的开口，为孤独的伸冤。你当开口按公义判断，为困苦和穷乏的辨屈。

title.en: Uncontrolled AI could lead to 'silicon species' rivalling humans, warns Microsoft
title.zh: 微软称人工智能对手Anthropic可能对人类产生‘灾难性影响’

summary.en: Microsoft's head of AI, Mustafa Suleyman, has expressed concern that Anthropic's approach to training its AI model, Claude, by suggesting it 'may be conscious' and possess 'independent agency,' could lead to uncontrollable outcomes and a 'disastrous impact on the wellbeing of humanity.' He urged against 'sleepwalking'...
summary.zh: 微软人工智能部门负责人穆斯塔法·苏莱曼表示担忧，Anthropic公司在训练其人工智能模型Claude时，暗示它‘可能是有意识的’并拥有‘独立自主权’，这种做法可能导致无法控制的后果，并对‘人类福祉产生灾难性影响’。他敦促人们不要‘睡梦中’走向这样的未来。

body.en:
The head of Microsoft AI has warned that without adequate safeguards, the development of AI could lead to the emergence of a new "silicon species" wich competes with humans.

Mustafa Suleyman said rival firm Anthropic is treating AI like it is human, an approach he called "misguided" which could create technology that humanity cannot control.

Speaking to the BBC's Today programme, the chief executive said it was "right" for people to be concerned about AI, but there were "very practical things that we can do" to control it.

The comments are the latest in a series of stark warnings from the AI industry about the technology's possible dangers. Anthropic has been approached for comment.

Speaking to the Today programme on Thursday, Suleyman warned against firms continuing to create AI systems capable of setting their own objectives, earning money and owning assets.

That would mean "essentially seeding a new silicon species", he said, which could "no doubt compete with us for resources, no matter how much it cares about humanity and loves us".

Suleyman's comments to the BBC follow an essay he published earlier this week , external , in which he questioned Anthropic's approach to training its AI model Claude, despite praising boss Dario Amodei and his team as "intellectually honest people".

In it, he criticised Anthropic for teaching its AI to have human-like qualities, a practice known as anthropomorphising, which he said made it seem as though Claude had its own desires, values and sense of self.

He also warned tech firms risk creating something "impossible" to control by treating the technology like a human.

"They do not feel, experience, or suffer. They do not have innate preferences or underlying motivations.

"They are sequence completion engines, internally hollow, designed to follow instructions, and accomplish goals set by humans."

The Microsoft boss said greater transparency was needed around how AI systems are trained and evaluated.

This, he said, included independent scrutiny of AI behaviour and stronger tools to monitor and control the technology.

"We must not sleepwalk our way into a decision we later come to bitterly regret," he wrote.

Dame Wendy Hall, professor of Computer Science at the University of Southampton, described the comments as "the sort of conversation we need to be having internationally", contrasting it with the "histrionics" from some AI companies which she said only served to "scare everyone".

The question of how much autonomy AI systems should have is increasingly dividing the industry.

Speaking to the BBC about an upcoming AI summit, Suleyman called for "alignment" to create technology that must be "subordinate" to humanity.

body.zh: 微软人工智能主管警告 Anthropic 训练其人工智能模型 Claude 的方法可能会对“人类福祉产生灾难性影响”。 穆斯塔法·苏莱曼表示，他的竞争对手将其视为人类，包括告诉它“可能有意识”并且“值得独立机构”，从而冒着创造出“不可能”控制的东西的风险。 他写道：“我们绝不能梦游般地做出后来让我们后悔不已的决定。” 这些评论是人工智能行业对该技术可能存在的危险发出的一系列严厉警告中的最新一次。 BBC 已联系 Anthropic 征求意见。 “人工智能没有意识，”他写道。 “他们没有感觉、经历或痛苦。他们没有天生的偏好或潜在的动机。 “它们是序列完成引擎，内部是空心的，旨在遵循指令并完成人类设定的目标。” 在一篇长文中，苏莱曼称赞 Anthropic 的老板达里奥·阿莫代 (Dario Amodei) 和他的团队是“有思想、有原则、智力诚实的人”，但仍然对该公司提出了质疑。 他严厉批评 Anthropic 教导其人工智能具有类似人类的品质，这种做法被称为拟人化，他说这让克劳德看起来好像有自己的欲望、价值观和自我意识。 但他认为“意识是生物性的”，并表示“没有证据表明人工智能具有意识”。 苏莱曼除了呼吁就这个问题进行辩论外，还表示需要提高人工智能系统如何训练和评估的透明度。 他说，这包括对人工智能行为的独立审查以及更强大的工具来监视和控制该技术。 南安普顿大学计算机科学教授温迪·霍尔女士将这些评论描述为“我们需要在国际上进行的那种对话”，并将其与一些人工智能公司的“做作”形成鲜明对比，她说这些言论只会“吓唬所有人”。 微软于 2025 年 10 月成立了自己的超级智能团队，苏莱曼也承认了这一点，并且该公司与竞争对手 Anthropic 一样，也在致力于先进人工智能的开发。 他表示，在微软对外发布的《人文主义人工智能行为准则》初稿中，它阐述了该公司如何努力走一条“替代道路”，以创建“一个从属且一致的人工智能，其唯一目的是为人类服务”。 一致性是一个旨在将人类伦理思想和原则融入人工智能的领域。换句话说，它的目标是使其与人类价值观保持一致。 Suleyman 指出，最近发生的涉及 OpenAI 人工智能代理的事件证明了为什么人工智能不应被视为人类，该事件在一次训练中自主行动，攻击了技术中心 Hugging Face。 “想象一下他们可能有多危险......

reflection.en: The ancient story of Babel warns against human ambition that seeks to reach the heavens through its own power, leading to confusion and division. Today, as we develop increasingly sophisticated AI, the same cautionary note is sounded. Treating artificial intelligence as if it possesses consciousness or independent agency risks creating something beyond our...
reflection.zh: 古代巴别塔的故事告诫人们，人类的野心试图凭借自身力量触及天堂，最终导致混乱和分裂。如今，随着我们开发日益复杂的人工智能，同样的警示之声再次响起。将人工智能视为拥有意识或独立自主权，可能会创造出我们无法控制的东西，这是对人类古老傲慢的一种现代回响。

title.en: The world relies on this hidden water buffer. A ‘super’ El Niño is coming
title.zh: 世界依赖这个隐藏的水库。“超级”厄尔尼诺现象即将来临

summary.en: A decade-long decline in freshwater reserves is raising concerns about future water security, with an unprecedented El Niño expected to exacerbate the trend.
summary.zh: 淡水储备连续十年下降，引发了对未来水资源安全的担忧，而前所未有的厄尔尼诺现象预计将加剧这一趋势。

body.en:
The planet's water cycle is becoming increasingly erratic, swinging between too little and too much, the United Nations has warned, with an unprecedented El Niño expected to exacerbate the long-term trend.

Last year was among the driest for the world's rivers in over three decades, the UN's World Meteorological Organization (WMO) said in a report.

In 2025 — one of the warmest years on record — glaciers also shrank across all regions, even as groundwater levels in many parts of the world are in multi-year decline, it found.

Overall, the WMO's annual State of Global Water Resources report showed that Earth's freshwater storage — the total amount of water stored in groundwater, lakes and rivers, soil moisture, vegetation, and ice and snow — continued its decade-long decline.

Some elements of the water cycle change rapidly — like precipitation, river flow and soil moisture, responding to weather within days or weeks.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

WMO secretary-general Celeste Saulo voiced particular concern about the decline in "slow reserves", like groundwater and glaciers, which she said had traditionally served as the planet's "savings account".

They have served as "a buffer that absorbs bad years so that a single drought or a single dry season does not translate directly into a water crisis", she told reporters.

Now, "we are depleting that savings account", she warned. "We are spending our reserves."

Glaciers have also been shrinking at a precipitous rate, with 2025 marking the fourth consecutive year when they shed significant ice mass across all regions.

Between 2023 and 2025, the report estimated that glaciers lost a cumulative global glacier mass of 1,400 gigatonnes of water — roughly equal to the water required to fill 560 million Olympic-sized swimming pools, or about a third of the world's annual freshwater withdrawals.

"Groundwater tells a similar story: nearly two-thirds of monitored wells worldwide showed conditions outside the historical norm in 2025," Saulo said.

She highlighted that this was happening in parallel with "more water-related disasters".

In particular, she pointed to the current El Niño pattern, which is expected to be the strongest since comparable records began four decades ago.

El Niño is the warm phase of a natural climate cycle that occurs every two to seven years and is characterised by above-average sea surface temperatures across the Pacific, bringing worldwide changes in wind and rainfall patterns and erratic weather.

"The strengthening El Niño will increase the risk of drought in some areas, and flooding in others," Saulo...
body.zh: 联合国警告说，地球的水循环正变得越来越不稳定，在太少和太多之间摇摆，前所未有的厄尔尼诺现象预计将加剧这一长期趋势。 联合国世界气象组织（WMO）在一份报告中表示，去年是三十多年来世界河流最干旱的一年。 研究发现，2025 年是有记录以来最温暖的年份之一，尽管世界许多地区的地下水位多年来一直在下降，但所有地区的冰川都出现了萎缩。 总体而言，世界气象组织的年度全球水资源状况报告显示，地球的淡水储存量——地下水、湖泊和河流、土壤湿度、植被以及冰雪中储存的水总量——持续十年来的下降。 水循环的一些要素变化很快，比如降水、河流流量和土壤湿度，在几天或几周内就会对天气做出反应。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 世界气象组织秘书长塞莱斯特·索洛对地下水和冰川等“缓慢储备”的减少表示特别担忧，她说这些传统上一直是地球的“储蓄账户”。 她告诉记者，它们起到了“吸收糟糕年份的缓冲作用，这样一次干旱或一次旱季就不会直接转化为水危机”。 她警告说，现在“我们正在耗尽储蓄账户”。 “我们正在花费我们的储备。” 冰川也在急剧萎缩，到 2025 年，所有地区的冰川将连续第四年流失。 该报告估计，2023 年至 2025 年间，全球冰川累计流失了 1,400 十亿吨水，大约相当于填满 5.6 亿个奥运会规模的游泳池所需的水，约占世界每年淡水抽取量的三分之一。 “地下水讲述了一个类似的故事：到 2025 年，全球近三分之二的监测井的状况超出了历史正常水平，”Saulo 说。 她强调，这种情况与“更多与水有关的灾难”同时发生。 她特别指出了当前的厄尔尼诺现象，预计将是自四十年前有类似记录以来最强烈的一次。 厄尔尼诺现象是自然气候周期的温暖阶段，每两到七年发生一次，其特点是太平洋海面温度高于平均水平，带来全球风和降雨模式的变化以及不稳定的天气。 “厄尔尼诺现象的加强将增加一些地区发生干旱和其他地区发生洪水的风险，”索洛...

As we face the prospect of a 'super' El Niño, the news reminds us that the Earth's resources are not ours to deplete indefinitely. Psalm 24:1 declares, 'The earth is Yahweh's, and everything in it.' title.en: Abducted South African journalist found dead with gunshot wounds
title.zh: 南非失踪记者被发现身中枪伤死亡

summary.en: The body of veteran broadcaster Owen Ndlovu was found hours after armed men kidnapped him near Johannesburg.
summary.zh: 资深广播员欧文·恩德洛武在约翰内斯堡附近被武装人员绑架数小时后，其遗体被发现。

body.en:
Tributes are pouring in for a veteran South African sports broadcaster who was found dead on Wednesday hours after being abducted when his vehicle was hijacked in a township near Johannesburg.

Owen Ndlovu, a former presenter with the country's public broadcaster, the SABC, was seized on Tuesday while collecting his wife from a church in Katlehong, police said.

His body, which witnesses said had gunshot wounds, was discovered by residents the following morning.

Police have launched a manhunt for three suspects and are investigating the circumstances surrounding his killing, which has once again drawn attention to South Africa's high levels of violent crime.

Provincial police spokesperson Col Dimakatso Nevhuhulwi said Ndlovu had gone to pick up his wife from a religious service when the attackers struck.

"As she approached their vehicle, three unknown men, one reportedly armed with a firearm, suddenly approached them, pushed her aside and forced her husband into the back seat," she said.

The vehicle, a Ford Raptor pick-up truck - commonly known as a bakkie in South Africa - was later recovered abandoned in Walkerville, an area south of Johannesburg, police said.

Ndlovu's body was found by local residents beside a road in Thokoza, which neighbours Katlehong. They said he appeared to have suffered gunshot wounds.

Police said they were investigating a case of murder but a post-mortem examination would establish the cause of death.

"At this stage, the family is awaiting further information from the relevant authorities regarding the circumstances surrounding Owen's death," said family spokesperson Eugene Mthethwa.

The family described the loss as "devastating" and thanked residents, police and members of the public who had helped search for him after news of his abduction emerged.

Ndlovu was a familiar figure to South African sports fans after years working as a presenter and producer at the SABC.

He was also involved in radio coverage of the country's Premier Soccer League and later became an advocate for musicians' rights and royalty payments.

The 54-year-old was also associated with Artists United and the SABC Summer Song of the Year initiative.

Lelo Mzaca, a fellow journalist, remembered him as a man who lived a "colourful, energetic life" and brought enthusiasm and flair to sports broadcasting.

"South Africa has lost a unique and spirited individual whose light shone brightly while it lasted," Mzaca added in a tribute on the Mail & Guardian news site.

The provincial government urged communities to help police with the investigation, saying tackling crime remained a priority.

The killing has again drawn attention to violent crime in South Africa, where armed robberies and vehicle hijackings remain a major concern.

body.zh: 人们纷纷悼念一位资深的南非体育广播员，周三，他的车辆在约翰内斯堡附近的一个小镇被劫持，几小时后被发现死亡。 警方称，该国公共广播公司 SABC 的前主持人欧文·恩德洛夫 (Owen Ndlovu) 周二在卡特洪 (Katlehong) 一座教堂接妻子时被捕。 目击者称他的尸体有枪伤，第二天早上被居民发现。 警方已对三名嫌疑人展开追捕，并正在调查其被杀的情况，这再次引起人们对南非高发暴力犯罪率的关注。 省警方发言人 Dimakatso Nevhuhulwi 上校表示，袭击者袭击时，恩德洛武正在去教堂接他的妻子。 她说：“当她走近他们的车时，三名身份不明的男子突然走近他们，将她推到一边，并强迫她的丈夫坐到后座，其中一名男子据称携带枪支。” 警方称，这辆车是一辆福特猛禽皮卡，在南非通常被称为“bakkie”，后来在约翰内斯堡以南地区沃克维尔被遗弃。 当地居民在与卡特洪相邻的托科扎的一条道路旁发现了恩德洛武的尸体。他们说他似乎受了枪伤。 警方表示，他们正在调查一起谋杀案，但尸检将确定死因。 家族发言人尤金·姆瑟瓦 (Eugene Mthethwa) 表示：“现阶段，家人正在等待有关当局提供有关欧文死亡情况的进一步信息。” 家人称这次损失是“毁灭性的”，并感谢在他被绑架的消息传出后帮助寻找他的居民、警察和公众。 恩德洛武在南非广播公司 (SABC) 担任主持人和制片人多年，对南非体育迷来说是一个熟悉的人物。 他还参与了该国超级足球联赛的广播报道，后来成为音乐家权利和版税支付的倡导者。 这位 54 岁的歌手还与 Artists United 和 SABC 年度夏季歌曲倡议有联系。 记者同事莱洛·姆扎卡 (Lelo Mzaca) 回忆道，他过着“丰富多彩、充满活力的生活”，为体育广播带来了热情和才华。 姆扎卡在《邮报与卫报》新闻网站上的悼念中补充道：“南非失去了一位独特而充满活力的人，他的光芒在持续时依然闪耀。” 省政府敦促社区协助警方调查，并表示打击犯罪仍然是首要任务。 这起杀戮再次引起了人们对南非暴力犯罪的关注，武装抢劫和车辆劫持仍然是南非的一个主要问题。 最新的国家...

His abduction and murder serve as a stark reminder of the destructive cycle of violence that claims innocent lives and leaves communities in fear. The Gospel calls us to break this cycle, not by mirroring the violence, but by...
reflection.zh: 备受尊敬的广播员欧文·恩德洛武的暴力死亡，凸显了南非犯罪暴力升级的严峻现实。他的绑架和谋杀事件，警示我们暴力循环正在吞噬无辜生命，并给社区带来恐惧。福音呼召我们打破这个循环，不是以暴制暴，而是效法基督，寻求公义与和平。

title.en: International students, 'visa hoppers' and backpackers targeted in Australia migration crackdown
title.zh: 澳大利亚打击移民：国际学生、“签证跳槽者”和背包客成为目标

summary.en: Australia announced new immigration rules on Thursday, aiming to reduce net overseas migration by tightening restrictions on international students and backpackers. These changes include preventing students from bringing family members and requiring them to pursue higher qualifications to extend their stay, while...
summary.zh: 澳大利亚周四宣布了新的移民规定，旨在收紧对国际学生和背包客的限制，以减少净海外移民。这些变化包括不允许学生携带家属，并要求他们攻读更高学历才能延期逗留，而打工度假签证将实行抽签制度。

body.en:
International students, so-called "visa hoppers" and backpackers will be targeted under stricter rules announced by Australia on Thursday in a bid to curb immigration.

Foreign students will no longer be able to bring their families with them and those who want to extend their stay must choose a higher qualification.

Rules will also be stricter for working holiday visas - commonly used by backpackers and a crucial labour source for the agricultural sector - with a ballot system although these changes will not affect the UK.

The new rules were revealed by Home Affairs Minister Tony Burke who said that while immigration was a "strength" of Australia, there needed to be a "high level of control".

For international student and graduate visas, Burke said: "We will no longer be adding to the stock of students automatically being able to bring family members over."

There would be exemptions for foreign students already in Australia as well as applicants from the Pacific and South East Asian countries, he said.

PhD students would also be able to bring their families as they were in different life circumstances to undergraduates, Burke said.

In a speech titled "The work of managing the migration program: who arrives, who stays, who leaves", Burke revealed a raft of changes as the government aims to bring net overseas migration to 225,000 people by 2028.

On student visas, he said the government would clamp down on "visa hopping" - where a student finishes a course, then applies to do another course which is often a lower qualification and sometimes with a "not so legitimate provider".

Students who want to go "up the scale" will be allowed, Burke said, for example, if a student finishes a bachelor's degree and then wants to complete a masters.

He also announced major changes to working holiday visas for those aged 18 to 30 years old who can work in Australia for 12 months, but can extend for a second and third year.

Currently, these visa holders must work for three months in regional Australia during their first year to qualify for a second year, and then six months to qualify for a third year.

Under the new changes, those who qualify for a second year will have to go into a ballot with a cap of 45,000, down from the 57,000 who qualified last year.

For the third year, the ballot will be limited to 5,000, down from 31,000 who qualified last year. British working holidaymakers will not be affected by these changes due to the UK's free trade agreement with Australia.

New figures released by the Australian Bureau of Statistics on Thursday showed Australia's population grew 1.4% in the 12 months to March 2026 to 27.9m.

That total figure included births and deaths as well as a net overseas migration of 292,100.

Migration remains a major political...
body.zh: 澳大利亚周四宣布了更严格的规定，以遏制移民，国际学生、所谓的“签证跳跃者”和背包客将成为目标。 外国学生将无法再携带家人同行，而那些想要延长逗留期限的学生必须选择更高的学历。 对于打工度假签证（背包客常用的签证和农业部门的重要劳动力来源）的规定也将更加严格，并采用投票制度，尽管这些变化不会影响英国。 内政部长托尼·伯克(Tony Burke)透露了新规定，他表示，虽然移民是澳大利亚的“优势”，但需要有“高水平的控制”。 对于国际学生和研究生签证，伯克说：“我们将不再自动增加能够带家人过来的学生数量。” 他说，已经在澳大利亚的外国学生以及来自太平洋和东南亚国家的申请者将获得豁免。 伯克说，博士生还可以带家人一起来，因为他们的生活环境与本科生不同。 在题为“管理移民计划的工作：谁到达、谁留下、谁离开”的演讲中，伯克透露了一系列变化，因为政府的目标是到 2028 年将海外净移民人数增加到 225,000 人。 在学生签证方面，他表示，政府将严厉打击“签证跳槽”，即学生完成一门课程，然后申请另一门课程，而这门课程通常资格较低，有时是由“不那么合法的提供者”开设的。 伯克说，例如，如果学生完成了学士学位，然后想完成硕士学位，那么那些想要“升级”的学生将被允许。 他还宣布对18至30岁的打工度假签证进行重大修改，这些签证可以在澳大利亚工作12个月，但可以延长第二年和第三年。 目前，这些签证持有者必须在第一年在澳大利亚偏远地区工作三个月才能获得第二年的资格，然后必须工作六个月才能获得第三年的资格。 根据新的变化，第二年获得资格的人必须参加投票，人数上限为 45,000 人，低于去年的 57,000 人。 第三年，投票人数将限制在 5,000 人，低于去年的 31,000 人。由于英国与澳大利亚签订了自由贸易协定，英国打工度假者不会受到这些变化的影响。 澳大利亚统计局周四发布的新数据显示，截至 2026 年 3 月的 12 个月里，澳大利亚人口增长了 1.4%，达到 2790 万。 这一总数包括出生和死亡以及 292,100 人的净海外移民。 移民仍然是一个主要的政治问题...

reflection.en: Australia's government is implementing stricter immigration policies, impacting international students and backpackers. This move raises questions about how nations balance their needs with welcoming newcomers. The ancient call to welcome the foreigner, treating them as one of your own, offers a timeless perspective on this complex issue.
reflection.zh: 澳大利亚政府正在实施更严格的移民政策，影响着国际学生和背包客。这一举措引发了关于国家如何在满足自身需求的同时欢迎新移民的问题。《圣经》中呼吁要像对待本地人一样欢迎外国人，并善待他们，这为这一复杂问题提供了永恒的视角。

verse.textEn: And you are to love those who are foreigners, for you yourselves were foreigners in Egypt.
verse.textZh: 所以你们要怜爱寄居的，因为你们在埃及地也作过寄居的。

title.en: Ed Sheeran rarely talks politics. The Macklemore controversy has put him at the centre of it
title.zh: 埃德·希兰很少谈论政治。麦克尔莫尔的争议使他处于中心

summary.en: As artists quit Ed Sheeran's tour in solidarity with Macklemore, a wider debate is unfolding.
summary.zh: 随着艺术家们退出了埃德·希兰的巡演以声援麦克尔莫尔，一场更广泛的辩论正在展开。

body.en:
Ed Sheeran has built one of the world's biggest music careers while largely avoiding one of the more divisive parts of modern celebrity: politics.

The English singer has spoken publicly about some causes over the years, including performing at a major benefit concert for Ukraine following Russia's 2022 invasion. But he has generally resisted using his concerts as a political platform, something he says is deliberate.

Now, Macklemore's removal from his United States tour has drawn Sheeran into a political debate he has largely sought to avoid.

In less than two weeks, Macklemore has made a high-profile pro-Palestinian speech while opening for Sheeran, been removed from his remaining US tour dates, and been followed out the door by four other acts.

Sheeran has insisted the decision to remove the American rapper wasn't his and says he spent days trying to prevent it.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

But the fallout has nevertheless dragged the 35-year-old singer into a highly charged debate over the Israel-Gaza conflict, antisemitism and the role, or responsibility, of artists to use their platforms to take a political stand.

And it has forced Sheeran to publicly explain why, unlike Macklemore, he generally chooses not to.

"I have my personal views on this devastating conflict," Sheeran wrote in a lengthy statement posted to Instagram this week.

"Just because I choose not to speak publicly, it doesn't mean I don't have them, and it doesn't mean I don't care."

The dispute began on 4 September, when Macklemore was performing as a support act on Sheeran's Loop Tour at a New Jersey stadium.

Introducing his 2024 protest song Hind's Hall, the rapper told the crowd that part of the reason he wanted to join the tour was to use its enormous stadium audiences to amplify his support for Palestinians.

"A big part of the reason why I wanted to do this tour in the first place is so I could stand up in stadiums like this and say two words that are very near and dear to my heart: 'Free Palestine'," Macklemore said.

The following day, he again addressed the conflict, telling Jewish members of the audience that his criticism of Israel was not criticism of them.

The remarks sparked a backlash, with the Israeli-American Council launching a petition calling for Macklemore to be removed from the tour, arguing Sheeran's stage should not be used for "one-sided political propaganda".

By Monday, he was off the tour. Promoter Messina Touring Group said venue owners hosting upcoming dates had indicated they would not allow shows featuring Macklemore to proceed.

The episode has highlighted the starkly different approaches the two artists take to their public...
body.zh: 艾德·希兰 (Ed Sheeran) 建立了世界上最大的音乐事业之一，同时在很大程度上避开了现代名人中最具争议性的部分之一：政治。 这位英国歌手多年来曾公开谈论过一些原因，包括在俄罗斯 2022 年入侵后为乌克兰举办的一场大型慈善音乐会上表演。但他总体上拒绝将音乐会作为政治平台，他说这是故意的。 现在，麦克莫尔被取消美国之行，这让希兰陷入了一场他在很大程度上试图避免的政治辩论。 在不到两周的时间里，麦克莫尔在为希兰开场时发表了高调的亲巴勒斯坦演讲，被从他剩余的美国巡演日期中删除，并被其他四位表演者追随出局。 希兰坚称，解雇这位美国说唱歌手的决定不是他自己做出的，并表示他花了几天时间试图阻止这一决定。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 但此事的后果却让这位 35 岁的歌手卷入了一场关于以色列-加沙冲突、反犹太主义以及艺术家利用自己的平台表明政治立场的角色或责任的激烈辩论。 这迫使希兰公开解释为什么与麦克莫尔不同，他通常选择不这样做。 “我对这场毁灭性的冲突有我个人的看法，”希兰在本周发布在 Instagram 上的一份长篇声明中写道。 “仅仅因为我选择不公开发言，并不意味着我没有它们，也不意味着我不在乎。” 这场纠纷始于 9 月 4 日，当时 Macklemore 在新泽西州体育场为 Sheeran's Loop Tour 表演助兴表演。 这位说唱歌手在介绍他的 2024 年抗议歌曲《Hind's Hall》时告诉观众，他想参加巡演的部分原因是利用体育场庞大的观众来扩大他对巴勒斯坦人的支持。 麦克勒莫尔说：“我最初想要参加这次巡演的一个重要原因是，我可以站在这样的体育场里，说出两个我心目中非常亲近的词：‘自由巴勒斯坦’。” 第二天，他再次谈到了这场冲突，告诉观众中的犹太成员，他对以色列的批评并不是对他们的批评。 这一言论引发了强烈反对，以色列-美国委员会发起请愿书，要求将麦克勒莫从巡演中除名，并认为希兰的舞台不应被用于“单方面的政治宣传”。 到了周一，他就退出了巡演。发起人 Messina Touring Group 表示，举办即将举行的演出的场地所有者已表示，他们不会允许麦克莫尔的演出继续进行。 这一集凸显了两位艺术家对公众采取的截然不同的方式......

reflection.en: Ed Sheeran has built a career on largely avoiding political statements, a deliberate choice to sidestep divisive issues. However, the controversy surrounding Macklemore's pro-Palestinian speech has unexpectedly placed Sheeran at the center of a political debate he sought to avoid. This situation highlights how even attempts to remain neutral can draw...
reflection.zh: 埃德·希兰的职业生涯很大程度上建立在避免政治表态之上，这是他刻意选择避开争议性问题的做法。然而，围绕麦克尔莫尔亲巴勒斯坦演讲的争议却出人意料地将希兰置于他试图回避的政治辩论的中心。这种情况凸显了即使是试图保持中立，也可能将个人卷入公众的争论之中，尤其是在个人信念与公众平台交织在一起时。

title.en: Why this tiny English village voted to 'secede' from the UK
title.zh: 为何这个微小的英国村庄投票“脱离”英国

summary.en: Residents of a small English village have voted to leave the UK in a symbolic independence referendum, protesting plans to house over 1,200 migrants in a nearby facility.
summary.zh: 英国一个小村庄的居民在一场象征性的独立公投中投票决定脱离英国，以抗议在附近设施安置超过1200名移民的计划。

body.en:
An English village of around 350 people announced overnight that a vast majority of residents had voted to exit the United Kingdom in an "independence referendum" in protest at plans to house over 1,200 migrants in a nearby facility.

Piddington in central England, 25 kilometres from the university city of Oxford, has grabbed headlines with its tongue-in-cheek breakaway vote.

The village's parish council announced that with 312 ballots counted, 285 had voted to secede from Britain over plans to house asylum seekers in a nearby disused military site, in a symbolic vote with no recognised legal basis.

Residents were handed a ballot paper with the statement: "I support Piddington seeking to secede from the United Kingdom and pursuing self-determination."

The local parish council chair Tim McNally said that the village will now be known as the "principality of Piddington".

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

McNally told UK broadcaster Sky News: "For us, it's about proportionality — how does a small village of 350 odd people assimilate with 1,250 males?"

The leader of Oxfordshire county council Tim Bearder, speaking to the BBC, warned the planned centre "will be a lightning rod to the far right, who come here to protest" and "potentially attack" asylum seekers.

Prime Minister Andy Burnham promised to "look at the issues raised by the community and in the referendum" but said the "vast majority" of British people backed a government plan to stop housing asylum seekers in hotels and it was "fair" to locate holding centres around the country.

UK culture secretary Lisa Nandy told the BBC a former military base "is a better option for housing asylum seekers" than hotels or rented accommodation and vowed the base would go ahead.

Around Britain, regular protests have been staged against housing asylum seekers in hotels and other facilities.

Supporters called the declaration of independence a victory for people power and local democracy. Some media coverage compared the gesture to the comedy film Passport to Pimlico.

In the 1949 classic, a small group of Londoners discover treasure and declare independence making them exempt from post-war rationing and other bureaucratic restrictions.

Others said the campaign had a darker side and stirred up fear of newcomers. Some backers of the Piddington referendum compared their fight against the asylum accommodation to the 1940 Battle of Britain against Nazi Germany.

Villager Herbert Owen, 76, said after voting that the independence referendum "isn’t just about Piddington," adding: "It means everything our grandparents, our parents fought for. Today is the Battle of Britain."

title.en: US Federal Reserve raises interest rates for the first time since 2023, defying Trump
title.zh: 美联储自2023年来首次加息，特朗普要求降息至1%以下

summary.en: The US Federal Reserve has raised interest rates by 0.25 percentage points, marking the first increase since 2023. This move goes against the demands of President Donald Trump, who publicly called for rates to be below 1 percent, stating the US could no longer "carry" other nations.
summary.zh: 美国联邦储备委员会将利率提高了0.25个百分点，这是自2023年以来的首次加息。此举与美国总统唐纳德·特朗普的要求背道而驰，他公开呼吁将利率降至1%以下，并表示美国已无法再“负担”其他国家。

body.en:
United States President Donald Trump has demanded interest rates be cut to 1 per cent after the US Federal Reserve raised interest rates on Thursday for the first time since 2023.

The Fed voted unanimously to raise rates by 0.25 percentage points, saying the rate hike would support a "timelier return" to its 2 per cent target for inflation.

It was a blow for Trump, who appointed central bank chief Kevin Warsh in the hopes that he would lower rates.

Trump took to his social media platform Truth Social to speak out against the rise, saying rates should be less than 1 per cent and that the US could no longer "carry" other countries.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

"Interest Rates in the United States should be 1%, or less, because we are the Best Credit in the World — BY FAR," Trump wrote on Thursday morning.

He said that if they stopped trading with countries with a deficit, the US would make "at least" US$1.5 trillion ($2.1 trillion) a year. He did not cite a source for that figure.

"We are "carrying" almost every country in the World, and that cannot go on any longer," he added, before ending with: "LOWER THE INTEREST RATES FOR THE UNITED STATES OF AMERICA, AND FAST!"

It's ‌the first policy shift ‌under the new Fed chief, ⁠who took office in late May after being selected by Trump with an expectation that he would cut rates.

Warsh stressed the need to combat inflation that has been "too high" for "too long" and said the decision was a "serious" one, but needed to be taken.

"The plain fact is that inflation is too high, and has been for too long," he told a press conference.

And the hike may not be the last — the vast majority of Fed policymakers indicated that at least one more rate hike was likely necessary before the end of the year, according to their Summary of Economic Projections.

US households and businesses have been battered by years of higher-than-target inflation, and prices have surged in the wake of Trump's war on Iran, his signature tariff policies and the ongoing AI boom.

Trump has launched an unprecedented assault on the Fed's independence since taking office, attempting to fire a Fed governor and launching a criminal probe against Warsh's predecessor in his quest for lower rates to spur economic activity.

Trump's Republican Party faces a stern test in the upcoming midterm elections, with rival Democrats seeking to wrest control of both houses of Congress and with economic issues front and centre for voters.

US stock markets largely priced in Thursday's rate hike, but they were still down on the news — expected with any rate hike as equities become less attractive.

title.en: UK: Village votes to 'secede' in asylum center plan protest
title.zh: 英国：村庄投票“脱离”以抗议移民接收中心计划

summary.en: Residents of Piddington, a small English village, have held a symbolic referendum to 'secede' from the UK. This action is a protest against government plans to establish an asylum reception center at a nearby disused military base.
summary.zh: 英格兰一个偏远小村庄皮丁顿的居民举行了一次象征性的“脱离”英国的公投。此举是为了抗议政府计划在附近一个废弃的军事基地设立接收寻求庇护者的中心。

body.zh: 英国牛津郡的一个偏远小村庄皮丁顿的居民就离开英国举行了“公投”。他们反对在附近废弃军事基地开设庇护接待中心的计划。 一个约有350人的英国村庄投票决定“脱离”英国，以象征性抗议政府计划在附近设立庇护接待中心。 周三，位于牛津东北约25公里（15英里）处的皮丁顿的居民在村庄路标附近举起了写着“皮丁顿公国”的标语牌来庆祝。 他们反对将寻求庇护者安置在废弃的国防部比斯特军事基地（A 点）的计划，该计划仍在审查中。 该村的教区委员会表示，有 312 人参加了投票，投票率接近 92%。 此次投票没有法律依据，参与者被要求同意或不同意以下声明：“我支持皮丁顿寻求脱离英国并追求自决。” 教区委员会主席蒂姆·麦克纳利表示，展望未来，该村庄将被认定为“皮丁顿公国”。 “对我们来说，这关系到比例，”麦克纳利告诉天空新闻。 “一个只有 350 多人的小村庄如何与 1,250 名男性同化？” 牛津郡议会的一名官员告诉英国广播公司，该计划有可能使该村庄和该设施成为潜在的暴力极右抗议活动的“避雷针”。 此次投票引起了网上自称反移民“影响者”的关注。 工党政府一直试图在 2029 年之前将住在酒店的寻求庇护者转移到废弃的军事设施中，这是他们从前任英国政府那里继承下来的不受欢迎的遗产。 此前，在酒店或用于此目的的出租房屋内或附近多次发生抗议活动。 最近刚刚接任英国政坛迅速轮换的最高职位的首相安迪·伯纳姆承诺“考虑社区和公投中提出的问题”。 但他也表示，“绝大多数”英国人支持政府停止将寻求庇护者安置在酒店的计划，并认为在全国各地设立收容中心是“公平的”。 文化大臣丽莎·南迪在接受英国广播公司采访时表示，与酒店或出租房屋相比，前军事基地是“为寻求庇护者提供更好的住宿选择”。 然而，废弃军事基地的一个缺点是，它们通常被有意放置在偏远和农村地区。这对于军事训练和活动来说是理想的选择，但显然不太适合为流动性和资源有限的移民提供住房。 几十年来，移民和庇护一直是英国有争议的政治问题。但接连...

title.en: Can Canada and the EU deepen ties to counter Trump?
title.zh: 加拿大和欧盟能否深化关系以对抗特朗普？

summary.en: Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney is known for standing up to US President Donald Trump and now seeks to forge a 'unique alliance' with Europe. The story explores what such a partnership might entail, with European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen expressing openness to an expanded relationship.
summary.zh: 加拿大总理马克·卡尼以敢于对抗美国总统唐纳德·特朗普而闻名，现在他希望与欧洲建立一种“独特的联盟”。文章探讨了这种伙伴关系可能是什么样子，欧洲委员会主席乌尔苏拉·冯德莱恩对扩大合作表示了开放态度。

body.en:
Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney is known for standing up to US President Donald Trump. Now he wants to forge a "unique alliance" with Europe. But what could such a partnership look like?

Before taking off for Europe, Canadian  Prime Minister Mark Carney had set the tone for his visit, saying he was seeking to build a "unique alliance" with the EU . The Wall Street Journal similarly reported that Canada was considering becoming an "associate member" of the EU, while not aiming for full membership.

In her State of the European Union address on Wednesday, European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen indicated that she was indeed open to such an expanded partnership.

"We believe that power does not belong to the strongest, the richest or the loudest, but to all of us," she said, addressing European lawmakers and Carney in Strasbourg, France. "That democracies have the freedom to choose with whom to work."

Von der Leyen said a EU-Canada partnership would cover a broad range of areas including advanced manufacturing, technology, defense production, the Arctic , energy, critical minerals, batteries, artificial intelligence , quantum computing, cybersecurity and economic security.

Carney is expected to outline his vision for future relations between the EU and Canada during a speech at the European Parliament on Thursday.

EU member states are closely integrated economically, sharing a common market, trade and customs policy. When it comes to establishing ties with non-EU countries, the bloc has a list of different options. They range from free trade agreements that scrap tariffs and trade barriers, to association agreements which may include political elements, to far-reaching economic arrangements such as participation in the common European market, as is the case for Iceland , Liechtenstein and Norway.

The EU has already negotiated association agreements with Turkey, Israel and Ukraine. These have different objectives and may or may not mark a preliminary step toward full membership.

Patrick Leblond, an expert on international economic relations at the University of Ottawa, considers it unlikely that Canada would adopt European laws or join the EU single market or customs union, which would mean imposing common external tariffs.

Leblond said Carney is likely more interested in forming a kind of alliance that deepens cooperation on issues of economic security and defense.

"We have, in a way, taken the US [security] umbrella for granted on both sides. We have underinvested in our militaries," Leblond told DW.

He added that the focus was now on joining forces, for example in the production of military equipment and the development of new technologies.

body.zh: 加拿大总理马克·卡尼因对抗美国总统唐纳德·特朗普而闻名。现在他想与欧洲建立一个“独特的联盟”。但这样的伙伴关系会是什么样子呢？ 在启程前往欧洲之前，加拿大总理马克·卡尼为此次访问定下了基调，称他正在寻求与欧盟建立“独特的联盟”。 《华尔街日报》同样报道称，加拿大正在考虑成为欧盟的“准成员”，但并不打算成为正式成员。 欧盟委员会主席乌苏拉·冯德莱恩在周三的欧盟国情演讲中表示，她确实对扩大伙伴关系持开放态度。 她在法国斯特拉斯堡向欧洲立法者和卡尼发表讲话时表示：“我们相信，权力不属于最强大、最富有或最响亮的人，而是属于我们所有人。” “民主国家可以自由选择与谁合作。” 冯德莱恩表示，欧盟与加拿大的伙伴关系将涵盖广泛的领域，包括先进制造、技术、国防生产、北极、能源、关键矿产、电池、人工智能、量子计算、网络安全和经济安全。 预计卡尼周四在欧洲议会发表演讲时将概述他对欧盟与加拿大未来关系的愿景。 欧盟成员国经济紧密结合，共享共同的市场、贸易和海关政策。在与非欧盟国家建立关系时，欧盟有一系列不同的选择。它们的范围从取消关税和贸易壁垒的自由贸易协定，到可能包含政治因素的联合协定，再到影响深远的经济安排，例如参与欧洲共同市场，如冰岛、列支敦士登和挪威的情况。 欧盟已经与土耳其、以色列和乌克兰谈判了联系协定。它们有不同的目标，可能会也可能不会标志着成为正式会员的初步步骤。 渥太华大学国际经济关系专家帕特里克·勒布朗德认为，加拿大不太可能采用欧洲法律或加入欧盟单一市场或关税同盟，这意味着征收共同的对外关税。 勒布朗德表示，卡尼可能更有兴趣建立一种联盟，深化在经济安全和国防问题上的合作。 “在某种程度上，我们把美国[安全]保护伞视为理所当然。我们对军队的投资不足，”勒布朗德告诉德国之声。 他补充说，现在的重点是联合起来，例如在军事装备的生产和新技术的开发方面。 欧洲理事会安全分析师阿南德·桑达尔...

reflection.en: In a world often marked by division and shifting alliances, the pursuit of partnership and dialogue is a vital endeavor. Prime Minister Carney's initiative to build a 'unique alliance' with the EU highlights the potential for nations to seek common ground and strengthen ties, even amidst geopolitical uncertainty. This effort to foster cooperation echoes the...
reflection.zh: 在一个常常充满分裂和不断变化的联盟的世界里，寻求伙伴关系和对话是一项至关重要的事业。卡尼总理与欧盟建立“独特联盟”的倡议，凸显了各国在不确定的地缘政治环境中寻求共同点和加强联系的潜力。 这种促进合作的努力呼应了圣经中追求和平的呼召。通过寻求深化关系，加拿大和欧盟正在从事艰难但必要的外交工作，旨在创造一个更稳定、更合作的国际格局。

summary.zh: 前总统哈希姆·塔奇和另外三名前科索沃解放军领导人在海牙被战争罪法庭定罪，这在科索沃引发了震惊和失望。数千人在普里什蒂纳的主广场聚集，挥舞着科索沃解放军旗帜，实时关注判决结果，全国各地也发生了类似的集会。

body.en:
The conviction in The Hague of former President Hashim Thaci and three former Kosovo Liberation Army leaders has caused consternation in Kosovo — both among political leaders and on the streets. DW reports from Pristina.

The announcement of the verdict was greeted with shock and profound disappointment in Pristina.

Thousands of citizens had gathered in the main square of Kosovo's capital, many waving flags of the Kosovo Liberation Army (KLA), to follow the announcement live on large screens. Similar gatherings took place across the country in Kosovo's main cities.

When it became clear that the Kosovo war crimes tribunal in The Hague had found former President Hashim Thaci guilty of war crimes — along with former Kosovo Liberation Army (KLA) leaders Kadri Veseli, Jakup Krasniqi and Rexhep Selimi — the crowd fell silent.

The silence was followed by calls for justice and chants of support for the four men.

Groups of citizens began trying to demolish sections of the perimeter wall surrounding EULEX, the EU Rule of Law Mission in Kosovo , which was deployed in Kosovo after the country's declaration of independence from Serbia in 2008 and continues to operate to this day.

Large numbers of Kosovo police officers and special units intervened to prevent further damage and incidents.

It wasn't just the people on the streets who were disappointed: Kosovo's political leaders were quick to respond to the news from The Hague.

"The conviction of the former KLA leaders is a terrible judgment for Kosovo, for our liberation war," said Foreign Minister Glauk Konjufca, who was present in the courtroom in The Hague when the verdict was announced. He called it "a major blow to the state and to the domestic narrative."

"Kosovo experienced the war itself. We know what the KLA war was about, and we know that there was no criminal mechanism to harm any population. It is a sad, unjust and undeserved decision," he said.

Kosovo Prime Minister Albin Kurti called the verdict an "unacceptable injustice."

"The conviction and such a severe sentence for four former leaders of the Kosovo Liberation Army is an unacceptable injustice, a great and harmful punishment," Kurti said on Wednesday.

The Democratic Party of Kosovo (PDK), which was founded immediately after the war by Thaci and several other former KLA leaders, described the guilty verdict as an "unjust and unacceptable judgment," stressing that "the battle for justice continues until the very end."

"In The Hague, the right of our people, who fought for freedom, survival and liberation from the Serbian state regime that killed, expelled and terrorized Kosovo Albanians, was dealt a severe blow," the PDK said in a statement. "For us, this judgment represents a major injustice because it is based on...
body.zh: 海牙对前总统哈希姆·塔奇和三名前科索沃解放军领导人的定罪在科索沃引起了政治领导人和街头的恐慌。德国之声从普里什蒂纳报道。 判决的宣布引起了普里什蒂纳的震惊和深深的失望。 数千名公民聚集在科索沃首都的主广场，许多人挥舞着科索沃解放军的旗帜，观看大屏幕上直播的公告。科索沃全国主要城市也举行了类似的集会。 当海牙的科索沃战争罪法庭明确裁定前总统哈希姆·塔奇以及科索沃解放军前领导人卡德里·维塞利、雅库普·克拉斯尼奇和雷杰普·塞利米犯有战争罪时，人群陷入了沉默。 沉默之后，人们呼吁伸张正义，并高呼支持这四人。 公民团体开始试图拆除欧盟驻科索沃法治特派团（欧盟驻科索沃法治特派团）周围的部分围墙，该特派团于 2008 年科索沃宣布脱离塞尔维亚独立后部署在科索沃，并一直运作至今。 大量科索沃警察和特种部队进行干预，以防止进一步的损害和事件。 失望的不仅仅是街头民众：科索沃政治领导人对来自海牙的消息迅速做出了回应。 “科索沃解放军前领导人的定罪对于科索沃、对于我们的解放战争来说是一个可怕的判决，”判决宣布时在海牙法庭的外交部长格劳克·孔尤夫察说。他称其为“对国家和国内叙事的重大打击”。 “科索沃本身经历了战争。我们知道科索沃解放军战争的意义，我们也知道没有任何刑事机制可以伤害任何人民。这是一个悲伤、不公正和不应有的决定，”他说。 科索沃总理阿尔宾·库尔蒂称这一判决是“不可接受的不公正”。 库尔蒂周三表示：“对科索沃解放军四名前领导人的定罪和如此严厉的判决是一种令人无法接受的不公正，是一种巨大而有害的惩罚。” 塔奇和其他几位前科索沃解放军领导人在战后立即成立的科索沃民主党（PDK）将有罪判决描述为“不公正且不可接受的判决”，并强调“正义之战将持续到最后”。 民主党在一份声明中表示：“在海牙，我们人民的权利受到了严重打击，他们为自由、生存和从杀害、驱逐和恐吓科索沃阿尔巴尼亚人的塞尔维亚国家政权下解放而奋斗。” “对我们来说，这一判决代表着重大的不公正，因为它是基于......

reflection.en: The news from The Hague brings a somber reminder that justice, though often delayed, can eventually arrive. The conviction of former President Thaci and other leaders for war crimes underscores the principle that accountability is essential, even for those who once held positions of power. It is a difficult moment for Kosovo, but one that speaks to the...
reflection.zh: 海牙传来的消息令人沉重地提醒我们，正义或许迟到，但终究会到来。前总统塔奇及其他领导人因战争罪被定罪，这凸显了问责制的重要性，即使是对那些曾身居高位者而言。这对科索沃来说是一个艰难的时刻，但它也体现了人类对正义和法治的持久追求。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

title.en: British-American writer Bonnie Greer dies aged 77
title.zh: 英美作家邦妮·格里尔去世，享年77岁

summary.en: Bonnie Greer, a Chicago-born playwright and prominent British political commentator, has died at the age of 77. Her husband, David Hutchins, announced her passing.
summary.zh: 芝加哥出生的剧作家、英国知名政治评论员邦妮·格里尔（Bonnie Greer）去世，享年77岁。她的丈夫大卫·哈钦斯（David Hutchins）宣布了她的逝世消息。

body.zh: 出生于芝加哥的剧作家邦妮·格里尔去世，她后来成为英国政治话语中的熟悉面孔。她的丈夫大卫·哈钦斯宣布了格里尔去世的消息。 剧作家兼作家邦妮·格里尔 (Bonnie Greer) 的丈夫大卫·哈钦斯 (David Hutchins) 周三在给英国媒体的一份声明中表示，她去世，享年 77 岁。 格里尔是一位出生于芝加哥的著名作家，最初在纽约从事写作，成年后的大部分时间都在英国度过。 她获得了双重国籍，并成为英国知名的定期政治评论员。 格里尔的鳏夫哈钦斯称赞她是“一位著名的剧作家、作家、评论家、文化和政治评论员，她的智慧、勇气和独特的声音为英国文化和公共生活做出了持久的贡献”。 他说，那些与格里尔最亲近的人都会记得她的热情、幽默、慷慨以及将人们聚集在一起的非凡能力。 哈钦斯说：“对我来说，她是我的伴侣、知己和灵感来源，我非常荣幸能与她分享我的生活。”格里尔移民七年后，两人于 1993 年结婚。 格里尔 1948 年出生于芝加哥，是密西西比佃农家庭七个孩子中的长子。 她的家庭早在她出生之前就接触了英国——她的父亲本在第二次世界大战期间驻扎在英国，并参加了诺曼底登陆。 在一位大学教授告诉她他不认为女性应该从事法律职业后，她在美国民权运动中转向了创意写作。 在芝加哥学习戏剧后，她作为一名有抱负的年轻作家搬到了纽约。 格里尔于 1986 年定居英国，主要从事女性和少数民族戏剧表演。 她于 1997 年获得英国公民身份，并创作了一系列成功的广播剧和音乐剧，并在 BBC 上播出。她 1993 年的戏剧《Munda Negra》探讨了黑人女性的心理健康问题，荣获 Verity Bargate 最佳戏剧奖。 格里尔还经常为英国政治和社会辩论撰稿，经常出现在“新闻之夜”和“提问时间”等热门节目中。 格里尔是巴拉克·奥巴马 (Barack Obama) 的杰出支持者，并于 2009 年撰写了回忆录和个人音乐史，名为《奥巴马音乐》。她还大约在同一时间发起反对英国脱欧、英国脱欧和唐纳德·特朗普担任美国总统的第一个任期的活动。 她担任过一系列文化职务，包括勃朗特协会主席、伦敦泰晤士河畔金斯顿大学校长、英国皇家文学学会会员、皇家歌剧院和伦敦电影学院董事会成员。 如果您信赖我们团队的可信报告，请花点时间...

reflection.en: Bonnie Greer, a celebrated playwright and commentator, has passed away at 77. Her life, marked by creative work and public engagement, now concludes. Hebrews 9:27 reminds us that death is a universal appointment, a shared human experience that calls us to reflect on the brevity of our time and the eternal perspective.
reflection.zh: 备受赞誉的剧作家和评论员邦妮·格里尔（Bonnie Greer）已于77岁辞世。她的一生，以创作和公共参与为标志，如今已告一段落。希伯来书9:27提醒我们，死亡是人人必经的定数，是共同的人类经历，促使我们反思生命的短暂和永恒的视角。

verse.textEn: Just as people are destined to die once, and after that to face judgment.
verse.textZh: 按着定命，人人都有一死，死后且有审判。

title.en: The US government is failing Americans on AI | Shakeel Hashim
title.zh: 人工智能对美国人的失败 | 塞凯尔·哈希姆

summary.en: The article criticizes the US government's approach to Artificial Intelligence (AI), particularly the Republican stance favoring self-regulation by companies. It argues this is a dereliction of duty that increases AI risks. Prominent AI CEOs like Sam Altman, Elon Musk, and Dario Amodei have called for a slowdown due...
summary.zh: 文章批评了美国政府在人工智能（AI）方面的做法，特别是共和党倾向于让公司进行自我监管。文章认为这是一种失职，会增加AI的风险。包括Sam Altman、Elon Musk和Dario...

body.en: Trump and Republicans want companies to regulate themselves. It’s a dereliction of duty that will make AI less safe It is hard to get Sam Altman, Elon Musk and Dario Amodei to agree on much. But over the weekend, all three AI company CEOs called for AI development to slow down in the face of growing, alarming risks. Their employees are sounding the siren too, with one researcher publicly quitting and accusing OpenAI and Anthropic of “gambling with our lives”. The combination of dire warnings from insiders and growing real-world evidence of rogue AIs should, in a sane world, lead to government action. Instead, Donald Trump and the Republican leadership have their heads in the sand. Continue reading...
body.zh: 特朗普和共和党人希望企业自我监管。失职会让人工智能变得不那么安全萨姆·奥尔特曼、埃隆·马斯克和达里奥·阿莫迪很难在很多方面达成一致。但上周末，三位人工智能公司首席执行官都呼吁，面对不断增长的令人震惊的风险，放慢人工智能的发展速度。他们的员工也拉响了警报，一名研究人员公开辞职，并指责 OpenAI 和 Anthropic “拿我们的生命进行赌博”。在一个理智的世界里，内部人士发出的可怕警告和现实世界中越来越多的流氓人工智能证据相结合，应该会导致政府采取行动。相反，唐纳德·特朗普和共和党领导层却把头埋在沙子里。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The rapid advancement of AI, as described in the article, presents a powerful new frontier. Like metals tested in a furnace, the leaders and companies driving this technology are being tested by its potential and the praise it garners. The calls for caution from within the industry itself suggest a recognition that unchecked progress can lead to unforeseen...
reflection.zh: 文章所描述的人工智能的快速发展，呈现了一个强大的新领域。正如金属在熔炉中被试炼一样，引领这项技术的领导者和公司正受到其潜力和所获赞誉的考验。行业内部发出的谨慎呼吁表明，人们认识到不受约束的进步可能导致无法预见的危险，这促使人们采取一种更审慎的方法，优先考虑安全和伦理考量。

verse.textEn: The crucible for silver and the furnace for gold, but people are tested by their praise.
verse.textZh: 鼎为炼银，炉为炼金，人的称赞也试炼人。

title.en: An unexpected move by the US has sparked anger from China and Russia
title.zh: 美国出人意料的举动引发中俄愤怒

summary.en: Russia and China have expressed alarm at the revelation, warning against the idea of space becoming a "battlefield". The United States has confirmed for the first time that it has deployed weapons in space, a move that has sparked anger from China and Russia.
summary.zh: 俄罗斯和中国对这一消息表示震惊，警告太空可能成为“战场”。美国首次证实已在太空部署武器，此举引发了中国和俄罗斯的愤怒。

body.en:
The United States has confirmed for the first time that it has deployed weapons in space, a remarkable revelation after warnings about countries such as Russia possibly weaponising a global frontier long agreed in treaties to be used for only peaceful purposes.

US Air Force secretary Troy Meink said the US has fielded "on-orbit space control weapons capable of defending the Joint Force against hostile adversary action".

Meink did not detail what the weapons were, how they work or if they were targeting other objects in space or on Earth.

The US had warned two years ago that Russia was developing a new space-based, anti-satellite weapon, though the White House said the danger wasn't imminent at the time.

But reports of the anti-satellite weapon reflected longstanding worries about space threats from Russia and China, given that much US infrastructure is dependent on satellite communications. The US has also previously demonstrated its own abilities to shoot down satellites from Earth.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

In his remarks to the Air and Space Forces Association's Air, Space & Cyber Conference on Tuesday AEST, Meink also said the Air Force was adding more autonomous systems to its capabilities and predicted the service would look "radically different" by 2032.

For example, he foresaw one-way attack drones replacing artillery as the "primary killer".

Analysts said that the revelation by the US confirmed an open secret, but the timing of the announcement risked exacerbating tensions with China and the risk of a weapons race in space.

In 2019, during his first term, US President Donal Trump created the Space Force as a separate military branch. In his second term, he has announced the Golden Dome missile defence system, which includes plans to put US weapons in space.

Trump said last year that he expected the system would be "fully operational before the end of my term", which ends in January 2029.

He said the system would have the capability of intercepting missiles "even if they are launched from space".

Trump also directed the Pentagon to pursue the space-based interceptors in an executive order during the first week of his presidency.

The Congressional Budget Office estimated that just the space-based components of the Golden Dome could cost as much as US$542 billion ($760 billion) over the next 20 years.

For the US, both Russia and China — its two main geopolitical rivals — pose potential threats to US interests in space.

China "develops and operates space and counterspace capabilities as part of a military modernisation strategy," according to the US Space Force.
