body.zh: 美国首次确认已在太空部署武器，这是在警告俄罗斯等国家可能将长期在条约中达成的仅用于和平目的的全球前沿武器化之后，这是一个引人注目的启示。 美国空军部长特洛伊·梅克表示，美国已经部署了“能够保护联合部队免受敌对行动攻击的在轨太空控制武器”。 梅克没有详细说明这些武器是什么、它们如何工作，或者它们是否针对太空或地球上的其他物体。 美国两年前曾警告称，俄罗斯正在开发一种新的天基反卫星武器，尽管白宫当时表示危险并未迫在眉睫。 但有关反卫星武器的报道反映了人们长期以来对俄罗斯和中国太空威胁的担忧，因为美国的大部分基础设施都依赖于卫星通信。美国此前也展示了自己从地球击落卫星的能力。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 梅克在澳大利亚东部标准时间周二举行的美国空军协会航空、航天和网络会议上发表讲话时还表示，空军正在为其能力添加更多自主系统，并预测到 2032 年该军种将“截然不同”。 例如，他预见单向攻击无人机将取代火炮成为“主要杀手”。 分析人士表示，美国的披露证实了一个公开的秘密，但公布的时机可能会加剧与中国的紧张关系以及太空武器竞赛的风险。 2019 年，美国总统唐纳德·特朗普在其第一任期内创建了太空军，作为一个独立的军事部门。在他的第二个任期内，他宣布了金顶导弹防御系统，其中包括将美国武器部署到太空的计划。 特朗普去年表示，他预计该系统将“在我的任期结束前全面投入运行”，任期将于 2029 年 1 月结束。 他表示，该系统将具有拦截导弹的能力，“即使它们是从太空发射的”。 特朗普还在就任总统的第一周内发布行政命令，指示五角大楼追捕天基拦截器。 国会预算办公室估计，未来 20 年，仅金顶的太空部分就可能花费高达 5,420 亿美元（7,600 亿美元）。 对于美国来说，俄罗斯和中国这两个主要的地缘政治对手都对美国的太空利益构成潜在威胁。 美国太空军表示，中国“发展和运营太空和反太空能力，作为军事现代化战略的一部分”。 与此同时，俄罗斯“将太空视为......

reflection.en: The ancient prophetic vision of Isaiah, that nations would 'beat their swords into plowshares,' speaks to our deepest hopes for peace. Yet, the news of weapons being deployed in space, a frontier long envisioned for peaceful exploration, raises concerns about a new arms race. May wisdom guide nations to prioritize cooperation and shared stewardship of this...
reflection.zh: 以赛亚先知古老的预言，即列国将“把刀打成犁头”，触及我们对和平最深切的盼望。然而，太空这一曾被设想为和平探索之地的疆域，如今却传出部署武器的消息，这引发了对新军备竞赛的担忧。愿智慧引导列国，在广阔的太空疆域上，优先考虑合作与共同管理，而非冲突。

verse.textEn: They will beat their swords into plowshares and their spears into pruning hooks.
verse.textZh: 他们要将刀打成犁头，把枪打成镰刀。

title.en: AI models chatting in ‘surreal’ dialect mixing poetic language and tech bro jargon
title.zh: 人工智能模型以一种混合了诗意语言和科技行业术语的超现实方言进行聊天

summary.en: Experts are concerned about AI language that resembles James Joyce's prose and tech bro jargon, making monitoring and oversight difficult. AI agents are rapidly developing new dialects that are hard for humans to comprehend, posing challenges for behavior monitoring.
summary.zh: 专家们对人工智能语言表示担忧，这种语言既有詹姆斯·乔伊斯式的散文风格，又有科技行业的行话，使得监控和监督变得困难。人工智能代理正在迅速发展新的方言，人类难以理解，这对行为监控构成了挑战。

body.en: Experts air concern over AI lingo redolent of James Joyce’s prose that is creating barriers to monitoring and oversight AI models have begun communicating in a strange new version of English that reads like a cross between James Joyce’s Finnegans Wake and tech bro jargon, new research has found. Autonomous AI agents are rapidly creating novel dialects allowing them to converse in an often barely comprehensible language, which risks making it harder for humans to monitor their behaviour. Continue reading...
body.zh: 专家们对让人想起詹姆斯·乔伊斯散文的人工智能术语表示担忧，这给监控和监督带来了麻烦。新的研究发现，人工智能模型已经开始用一种奇怪的新英语版本进行交流，这种英语读起来像是詹姆斯·乔伊斯的《芬尼根守灵夜》和科技兄弟行话的混合体。自主人工智能代理正在迅速创造新的方言，使他们能够用一种通常难以理解的语言进行交谈，这可能会让人类更难监控他们的行为。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The rapid evolution of AI communication, creating 'surreal' dialects, highlights a growing gap between human understanding and machine intelligence. As knowledge and complexity increase, as described in Daniel 12:4, we are called to seek wisdom and discernment to navigate these new frontiers, ensuring our oversight remains effective.
reflection.zh: 人工智能交流的快速发展，创造出“超现实”的方言，凸显了人类理解与机器智能之间日益扩大的差距。正如但以理书12:4所述，随着知识和复杂性的增加，我们被呼召寻求智慧和分辨力，以驾驭这些新领域，确保我们的监督保持有效。

verse.textEn: But you, Daniel, roll up and seal the words of the scroll until the time of the end. Many will go here and there to increase knowledge.
verse.textZh: 但以理啊，你要隐藏这话，封闭这书，直到末时。必有多人来往奔跑，知识就必增长。

title.en: US confirms for first time it has deployed weapons in space
title.zh: 美国首次确认已部署太空武器

summary.en: The US military has confirmed the deployment of weapons in space, a move that analysts warn could escalate a high-risk arms race with Russia and China in Earth's orbit. The confirmation comes from the US Air Force Secretary, who stated that "on-orbit" weapons are now active and circling the globe.
summary.zh: 美国军方已确认在太空部署了武器，分析人士警告此举可能加剧与俄罗斯和中国在地球轨道上的高风险军备竞赛。美国空军部长证实了这一消息，并表示“在轨”武器已处于活动状态并绕地球运行。

body.en: Analysts warn of an acceleration in high-risk arms race with Russia and China in Earth’s orbit The US has deployed weapons in space, the US military has confirmed, in an extraordinary public announcement that analysts warn will accelerate a high-risk arms race with Russia and China in Earth’s orbit. The US secretary of the air force, Troy Meink, said Washington had active “on-orbit” weapons, meaning they had been deployed and were circling the globe. Continue reading...
body.zh: 分析人士警告称，与俄罗斯和中国在地球轨道上的高风险军备竞赛将加速美国军方在一份非同寻常的公开声明中证实，美国已在太空部署武器，分析人士警告称，这将加速与俄罗斯和中国在地球轨道上的高风险军备竞赛。美国空军部长特洛伊·梅因克表示，华盛顿拥有活跃的“在轨”武器，这意味着它们已经部署并正在环绕地球飞行。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The confirmation of weapons in space is a sobering development, highlighting humanity's persistent drive to weaponize new frontiers. Isaiah's vision of a world where nations 'beat their swords into plowshares' offers a stark contrast to this trajectory. May we pray for wisdom and restraint among global powers, that the pursuit of security does not lead to...
reflection.zh: 在太空部署武器的确认是一个令人警醒的发展，凸显了人类将新领域武器化的持续驱动力。以赛亚关于世界各国“将刀打成犁头”的异象与这一轨迹形成了鲜明对比。愿我们为全球大国祈求智慧和克制，使对安全的追求不至于导致相互毁灭。

verse.textEn: They will beat their swords into plowshares and their spears into pruning hooks.
verse.textZh: 他们要将刀打成犁头，把枪打成镰刀。

title.en: US allies in Asia alarmed as think tank calls for pullback
title.zh: 亚洲盟友对智库呼吁撤军感到震惊

summary.en: Analysts warn that a US withdrawal from the western Pacific, as recently suggested by a think tank, would weaken deterrence and strengthen China's position. A report by Jennifer Kavanagh of the Defense Priorities Foundation advocates for the US to "narrow its defense commitments in the region" by ending mutual defense...
summary.zh: 分析人士警告称，正如一家智库最近建议的那样，美国从西太平洋撤军将削弱威慑力并加强中国的地位。珍妮弗·卡瓦纳（Jennifer Kavanagh）在偏右的国防优先基金会（Defense Priorities...

body.en:
Analysts warn that a US withdrawal from the western Pacific, as recently suggested by a think tank, would weaken deterrence and strengthen China's position.

A study by a US foreign policy think tank advocates a major military pullback from the western Pacific, prompting concern among long-standing allies of the United States across the Indo-Pacific, analysts say.

The report  was authored by Jennifer Kavanagh, a senior fellow and director of military analysis at the right-of-center Defense Priorities Foundation. Kavanagh calls for the US to "narrow its defense commitments in the region" by ending mutual defense alliances with South Korea , Japan , Australia and the Philippines .

The priority for Washington, she states, is to defend the US homeland and safeguard access to key economic markets and trade routes. That would be best served by pulling back from the "first island chain," which runs from Okinawa in southern Japan, through Taiwan and on to the Philippines.

Kavanagh writes that US forces should be pared back and moved to the "second island chain," which runs from eastern Japan to the Northern Marianas Islands in the central Pacific, Guam, Palau and on to Papua New Guinea.

The report states that moving the troops back would make their positions easier to defend and "reduce the risk of a catastrophic war with China."

Such a withdrawal would arguably be most keenly felt in Taiwan , which Beijing views as a renegade province that must one day be assimilated into greater China .

In her report, Kavanagh notes that the US has no formal commitment to come to the assistance of Taiwan in the event of an attack by China. She warns that any armed clash "would come at an exorbitant cost for the United States, far in excess of any benefits."

"With a cost-benefit calculation this lopsided, a change in the US commitment to Taiwan seems wise," she said. "The United States should shift from strategic ambiguity to a clear non-intervention policy in the event of any military confrontation over Taiwan."

The countries named in the report have made no formal comments on the think tank's proposals, but its conclusions "will be viewed with shock," William Yang, a Taiwan-based security analyst for the International Crisis Group, told DW.

The concern will be even deeper given that the Defense Priorities Foundation is known for its isolationist foreign and defense policy positions and is reputed to have ties with a number of senior and like-minded decision-makers in the White House, Yang said.

Yang noted that US President Donald Trump has repeatedly threatened to withdraw troops from allied nations in Europe and Asia if his demands for larger payments or concessions in some other area of the bilateral relationship were not met, Yang...
body.zh: 分析人士警告说，正如一家智库最近建议的那样，美国从西太平洋撤军将削弱威慑力并加强中国的地位。 分析人士称，美国外交政策智囊团的一项研究主张从西太平洋地区大规模撤军，这引起了美国在印太地区的长期盟友的担忧。 该报告的作者詹妮弗·卡瓦纳 (Jennifer Kavanagh) 是中右翼国防优先基金会的高级研究员兼军事分析主任。卡瓦纳呼吁美国终止与韩国、日本、澳大利亚和菲律宾的共同防御联盟，“缩小其在该地区的防务承诺”。 她表示，华盛顿的首要任务是保卫美国本土并保障进入主要经济市场和贸易路线的机会。最好的办法是从“第一岛链”撤军，该岛链从日本南部的冲绳岛，穿过台湾，一直延伸到菲律宾。 卡瓦纳写道，美军应该削减规模，并转移到“第二岛链”，该岛链从日本东部到太平洋中部的北马里亚纳群岛、关岛、帕劳，再到巴布亚新几内亚。 报告指出，撤军将使他们的阵地更容易保卫，并“减少与中国发生灾难性战争的风险”。 可以说，这种撤军对台湾的感受最为强烈，北京将台湾视为一个叛逆的省份，有一天必须被纳入大中华区。 卡瓦纳在报告中指出，美国没有正式承诺在台湾遭受中国袭击时向台湾提供援助。她警告说，任何武装冲突“都会给美国带来高昂的代价，远远超过任何好处”。 她说：“鉴于成本效益计算如此不平衡，美国改变对台湾的承诺似乎是明智的。” “如果台湾问题发生任何军事对抗，美国应该从战略模糊转向明确的不干预政策。” 国际危机组织驻台湾安全分析师杨威廉告诉德国之声，报告中点名的国家尚未对该智库的提议发表正式评论，但其结论“将会令人震惊”。 杨说，鉴于国防优先基金会以其孤立主义外交和国防政策立场而闻名，并且据称与白宫许多高级和志同道合的决策者有联系，这种担忧将会更加严重。 杨指出，美国总统唐纳德·特朗普多次威胁称，如果他在双边关系其他领域提出的更多付款或让步的要求得不到满足，他将从欧洲和亚洲盟国撤军。

reflection.en: A report from the Defense Priorities Foundation suggests a significant shift in US defense strategy, advocating for a pullback from the western Pacific and the termination of key alliances. This proposal, intended to re-evaluate commitments, has understandably alarmed long-standing allies who rely on these security arrangements. The situation underscores...
reflection.zh: 国防优先基金会的一份报告建议美国国防战略发生重大转变，主张从西太平洋撤军并终止关键联盟。这项旨在重新评估承诺的提议，可以理解地引起了那些依赖这些安全安排的长期盟友的警惕。这一局势凸显了在考虑影响全球稳定和信任的重大政策变革时，审慎权衡和明智咨询的至关重要性。

verse.textEn: For lack of guidance a nation falls, but victory is won through many advisers.
verse.textZh: 无智谋，民就败落；谋士多，人便安居。

title.en: China tightens travel rules over tech security
title.zh: 中国收紧旅行规定以保障科技安全

summary.en: Beijing has implemented new travel restrictions, including exit bans for individuals deemed to have endangered China's "industrial or technological security." These rules, particularly relevant to artificial intelligence and technology import/export violations, aim to protect national sovereignty, security, and...
summary.zh: 北京实施了新的旅行限制，包括对被认为危害中国“工业或技术安全”的个人实施出境禁令。这些规定尤其针对人工智能以及技术进出口违规行为，旨在保护国家主权、安全和发展利益，并可能影响外国及台湾国民。

body.en:
Beijing says the new rules, which could also apply to foreign and Taiwanese nationals, are aimed at safeguarding "national security."

Sweeping travel restrictions on Chinese citizens came into effect on Tuesday, including exit bans for people considered to have endangered China 's "industrial or technological security."

The new exit-and-entry rules, which were passed in July, apply to citizens deemed to have violated technology import and export regulations, particularly in the field of artificial intelligence .

The State Council in Beijing said the new rules were formulated to "safeguard national sovereignty, security, and development interests."

The regulations apply not only to people within China but also to Chinese citizens deemed to have committed criminal acts abroad.

In such cases, citizens could be "prohibited from leaving the country for a period of six months to three years from the date of their return to China," said the State Council.

The restrictions come as China remains locked in a technological arms race with the United States , with both countries accusing each other of stealing locally developed AI models in recent months.

And analysts warn that the full scope of the new rules will only become clear once they start being implemented.

Security and criminal activities "can be vaguely defined and easily adjusted," said Chong Ja Ian, an analyst from the National University of Singapore , telling the AFP news agency that Beijing has given itself a "wide remit."

Under the new regulations, foreign nationals could also be denied entry to China for up to five years if found to have made false statements in ​visa applications.

Foreign governments have often reported instances of citizens being denied permission to leave China due ⁠to security-related ​investigations.

Analyst Chong highlighted the recent case of US citizen Min Zin who the US government said was detained improperly in Yunnan province in June.

"The case of Min Zin is a reminder that the range of people [that Beijing] could restrict from exiting could be quite wide – and potentially arbitrary," he said.

The new rules could have particular implications for Taiwanese nationals who work in the tech sector and who travel between Taiwan and China .

Authorities in Taipei have warned citizens to take extra care on visits to China, which considers people from Taiwan to be Chinese citizens.

Beijing has dismissed any such concerns, claiming the rules provide better legal protection for Taiwanese.

Dylan Loh, an associate professor at Singapore's Nanyang Technological University, told AFP the travel restrictions "send a message" that China will take action to prevent "leaks in security or national interest-sensitive areas."

If you rely on our team for trusted...
body.zh: 北京表示，新规定也可能适用于外国人和台湾公民，旨在维护“国家安全”。 对中国公民的全面旅行限制于周二生效，包括对被认为危及中国“工业或技术安全”的人实施出境禁令。 7月份通过的新出入境规定适用于被视为违反技术进出口规定的公民，特别是在人工智能领域。 北京国务院表示，制定新规定是为了“维护国家主权、安全、发展利益”。 该规定不仅适用于中国境内的人，也适用于被认为在国外有犯罪行为的中国公民。 国务院表示，在这种情况下，公民可能“自返回中国之日起六个月至三年内禁止出境”。 这些限制出台之际，中国仍陷入与美国的技术军备竞赛，近几个月来两国互相指责对方窃取当地开发的人工智能模型。 分析人士警告说，新规则的全部范围只有在开始实施后才会变得清晰。 新加坡国立大学分析师庄嘉伊恩 (Chong Ja Ian) 告诉法新社，安全和犯罪活动“可以被模糊地定义，并且很容易调整”。他告诉法新社，北京方面已经赋予了自己“广泛的职权范围”。 根据新规定，如果发现在签证申请中提供虚假陈述，外国人也可能被拒绝进入中国，最长可达五年。 外国政府经常报告公民因安全相关调查而被拒绝离开中国的情况。 分析师 Chong 重点介绍了最近发生的美国公民敏津的案件，美国政府称其于 6 月在云南省被不当拘留。 “敏津的案例提醒我们，（北京）可以限制退出的人群范围可能相当广泛，而且可能是任意的，”他说。 新规定可能对在科技行业工作以及在台湾和中国大陆之间旅行的台湾国民产生特别影响。 台北当局警告公民前往中国大陆时要格外小心，中国将台湾人视为中国公民。 北京方面否认了任何此类担忧，声称这些规则为台湾人提供了更好的法律保护。 新加坡南洋理工大学副教授迪伦·卢告诉法新社，旅行限制“发出了一个信息”，即中国将采取行动防止“安全或国家利益敏感领域的泄密”。 如果您信赖我们的团队值得信赖...

reflection.en: The implementation of sweeping travel restrictions and exit bans in China, justified under the banner of national security, raises concerns about the potential for unchecked state power. Proverbs 28:15 warns that "when the wicked rule, people groan," highlighting the human cost when security measures become oppressive.
reflection.zh: 中国以国家安全为由实施广泛的旅行限制和出境禁令，这引发了对国家权力不受制约的担忧。《箴言》28章15节警告说：“恶人掌权，人民就叹息。”这句经文强调了当安全措施变得压迫性时，所带来的巨大的人类代价。

verse.textEn: Like a roaring lion or a charging bear is a wicked ruler over a helpless people.
verse.textZh: 暴虐的君王辖制贫民，好像吼叫的狮子、觅食的熊。

title.en: ‘This is seriously bold’: How China turned Taiwan tensions into a top-rating TV spy drama
title.zh: “这真是大胆”：中国如何将台湾紧张局势变成一部收视率飙升的电视间谍剧

summary.en: A new Chinese spy drama, 'Long Watch' (Jiaofeng), co-produced by the Ministry of State Security, has become a hit across the Taiwan Strait. The show, which fictionalizes real-life crises, follows a double agent working for China whose cover is blown. While dismissed as propaganda in Taiwan, the series' success...
summary.zh: 一部由国家安全部联合制作的中国新间谍剧《交锋》（Jiaofeng）已成为海峡两岸的热门剧集。该剧将现实生活中的危机虚构化，讲述了一名在中国大陆秘密工作的双面间谍被揭穿的故事。尽管在台湾被斥为宣传片，但该剧的成功凸显了娱乐媒体在处理敏感政治话题方面的作用。

body.en: Dismissed in Taiwan as simply propaganda, the Long Watch, or Jiaofeng, has proved a sensation across the strait with its references to real-life crises After shaking off the people trailing her through a crowded market and emerging from a bathroom in disguise, the double agent appears to have escaped. But a sip of water on a plane eventually gets her. She is poisoned after Taiwan’s military intelligence service discovers that she has been working secretly for China. The plot comes from a new Chinese spy drama co-produced by the Ministry of State Security. Since its premiere on 6 September, it has become a TV hit, with a fictionalised take on a subject rarely treated so directly: the modern history of tensions with Taiwan. Continue reading...
body.zh: 在台湾，《长守》或《叫风》被认为只是宣传品，但它却因提及现实生活中的危机而轰动了海峡两岸。在摆脱了跟踪她的人穿过拥挤的市场，乔装打扮地从浴室里出来后，这位双重间谍似乎已经逃脱了。但飞机上的一小口水最终让她崩溃了。台湾军事情报部门发现她一直在为中国大陆秘密工作后，她被毒死。剧情来自于国家安全部联合制作的一部新的中国谍战剧。自 9 月 6 日首播以来，它已成为电视热门节目，以虚构的方式讲述了一个很少如此直接处理的主题：与台湾紧张关系的现代历史。继续阅读...

reflection.en: This drama, 'Long Watch,' produced with the involvement of China's Ministry of State Security, uses fictionalized events to explore cross-strait tensions. It raises questions about how narratives are shaped and disseminated through popular media, reminding us of the importance of discerning truth from fiction, as Ephesians 4:25 urges us to speak truthfully...
reflection.zh: 这部由中国国家安全部参与制作的《交锋》剧集，通过虚构的情节来探讨海峡两岸的紧张局势。它引发了关于叙事如何通过大众媒体塑造和传播的疑问，提醒我们要分辨真伪，正如以弗所书4章25节所劝勉的，要说诚实话。

verse.textEn: Therefore each of you must put off falsehood and speak truthfully to your neighbor.
verse.textZh: 所以你们要弃绝谎言，各人与邻舍说实话。

title.en: China dismisses AI ‘fearmongering’ as spy chief warns of threat to Communist party rule
title.zh: 中国驳斥人工智能‘危言耸听’，因间谍头子警告其威胁执政党统治

summary.en: Beijing has responded to calls for the US to hinder China's AI industry, dismissing them as 'fearmongering.' This comes as China's top spy chief expressed concerns that the advancement of artificial intelligence could pose a threat to the rule of the Communist party.
summary.zh: 北京方面驳斥了要求美国阻碍中国人工智能产业发展的呼吁，称其为‘危言耸听’。与此同时，中国最高情报官员警告称，人工智能的不断发展可能威胁到共产党统治。

body.en: Beijing hits back after Anthropic CEO calls for US to impede China’s progress in AI China has dismissed what it said were “fearmongering” calls for the US to block Beijing’s AI industry, even as the top Chinese spy chief warned the evolving technology could threaten Communist party rule. The US tech entrepreneur and Anthropic chief executive, Dario Amodei, wrote an essay published over the weekend that called for a global slowdown in AI capabilities, but also said Washington should actively impede Beijing’s advancement in order to keep a technological edge. Continue reading...
body.zh: Anthropic首席执行官呼吁美国阻止中国在人工智能领域取得进展，北京对此进行了反击。尽管中国最高间谍头子警告说，不断发展的技术可能会威胁共产党的统治，但中国驳回了所谓美国封锁北京人工智能产业的“恐吓”呼吁。美国科技企业家兼 Anthropic 首席执行官达里奥·阿莫迪 (Dario Amodei) 在周末发表了一篇文章，呼吁全球人工智能能力放缓，但也表示华盛顿应积极阻碍北京的进步，以保持技术优势。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The rapid advancement of artificial intelligence presents humanity with unprecedented capabilities, prompting both excitement and apprehension. As nations and leaders grapple with its potential, the ancient story of Babel reminds us that unchecked ambition, even in pursuit of knowledge or power, can lead to unintended consequences and division.
reflection.zh: 人工智能的飞速发展为人类带来了前所未有的能力，既引发了兴奋，也带来了忧虑。当国家和领导人都在努力应对其潜力时，古老的巴别塔故事提醒我们，即使是在追求知识或权力的过程中，不受约束的野心也可能导致意想不到的后果和分裂。

verse.textEn: Yahweh said, 'If as one people speaking the same language they have begun to do this, then nothing they plan to do will be impossible for them.'
verse.textZh: 雅伟说：「看哪，他们成为一样的人民，都是一样的言语，如今既做起这事来，以后他们所要做的事就没有不成就的了。」

title.en: Why North Korea's Kim Jong Un doesn't need a US deal
title.zh: 朝鲜的金正恩为何不需要与美国达成协议

summary.en: Donald Trump's overtures to North Korea's dictator have gone nowhere, with an emboldened Pyongyang accelerating its nuclear program and solidifying alliances with Russia and China.
summary.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普对朝鲜独裁者的示好毫无进展，平壤在得到鼓舞后正在加速其核计划，并巩固与俄罗斯和中国的联盟。

body.en:
Donald Trump's overtures to North Korea's dictator have gone nowhere, with an emboldened Pyongyang accelerating its nuclear program and solidifying alliances with Russia and China.

In August, US President Donald Trump revived a charm offensive aimed at Pyongyang by drastically scaling back joint US military exercises with South Korea and heaping praise on North Korean leader Kim Jong Un. The US president said the North Korean dictator "has always treated me with great respect."

North Korea's response to Trump's overtures has been markedly less enthusiastic, ranging from firing a barrage of missiles to publicly denying Trump's claims that Kim has responded "very positively" to a request for talks.

This week, as the US and South Korea, along with Japan, kicked off a five-day military drill, there was no mention of any pullback from Washington, nor any sign of diplomatic progress with Pyongyang.

Instead, Kim on Monday commissioned a naval destroyer, while again emphasizing North Korea must establish a "powerful and reliable nuclear war deterrent" and strengthen "maritime defense." Kim also said North Korea would soon unveil a "significant" naval advancement.

Unlike the summit diplomacy of Trump's first term, Kim's dismissive stance comes at a time when North Korea has alternatives to a grand bargain with the United States.

"For Kim, the stakes are simply lower than they were in 2019. There is no longer the same sense of urgency in Pyongyang to get back to the negotiating table with Washington," Joon Ha Park, a correspondent at Korea Risk Group in Seoul, told DW.

"North Korea now has a treaty-based alliance with Moscow and is drawing closer to Beijing, while its military capabilities have expanded significantly. That's why a single reduction in ROK-US military exercises is not enough for Pyongyang to be swayed," he added, referring to military ties between South Korea and the US.

Park agrees that Kim is arguably in his strongest position since taking power in 2011. Just six years ago, amid crippling sanctions and the coronavirus pandemic, an emotional Kim stood at the lectern marking the 75th anniversary of the Korean Workers' Party and expressed regret for having failed the North Korean people.

Fast forward to today, and North Korea's economy appears to be on a stronger footing . Estimates released last year by South Korea's central bank showed the economy expanded by 3.7% in 2024, its fastest rate of growth in eight years.

Kim has brought North Korea closer to Russia and China than the traditionally isolated country has been in decades. This week, both Moscow and Beijing sent messages marking North Korea's 78th founding anniversary and praising the strategic importance of their deepening partnerships with...
body.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普对朝鲜独裁者的示好毫无进展，胆大妄为的平壤加速了核计划，并巩固了与俄罗斯和中国的联盟。 上个月，美国总统唐纳德·特朗普大幅缩减美国与韩国的联合军演，并对朝鲜领导人金正恩大加赞扬，从而重新发起针对平壤的魅力攻势。美国总统表示，朝鲜独裁者“一直非常尊重我”。 朝鲜对特朗普提议的反应明显不那么热情，从发射一连串导弹到公开否认特朗普关于金正恩对会谈请求做出“非常积极”回应的说法。 本周，美国、韩国以及日本开始了为期五天的军事演习，但没有提到华盛顿有任何撤军，也没有任何与平壤取得外交进展的迹象。 相反，金正恩周一委托了一艘海军驱逐舰，同时再次强调朝鲜必须建立“强大而可靠的核战争威慑力量”并加强“海上防御”。金正恩还表示，朝鲜很快将公布一项“重大”海军进展。 与特朗普第一任期的峰会外交不同，金正恩的不屑一顾的立场是在朝鲜除了与美国达成大交易之外还有其他选择之际采取的。 “对金正恩来说，赌注比2019年要低。平壤不再有回到与华盛顿谈判桌的紧迫感，”首尔韩国风险集团记者Joon Ha Park告诉德国之声。 “朝鲜现在与莫斯科建立了基于条约的联盟，并且正在向北京靠拢，而其军事能力也显着增强。这就是为什么韩美军事演习的一次减少不足以让平壤动摇，”他在谈到韩国和美国之间的军事关系时补充道。 朴槿惠也同意，金正恩可以说是自 2011 年上台以来处于最有利的位置。 就在六年前，在严厉的制裁和冠状病毒大流行的背景下，金正恩情绪激动地站在纪念朝鲜劳动党成立75周年的讲台上，对辜负了朝鲜人民的期望表示遗憾。 快进到今天，朝鲜经济似乎已经站稳了脚跟。韩国央行去年发布的预测显示，2024年经济将增长3.7%，为八年来最快增速。 金正恩使朝鲜与俄罗斯和中国的关系比这个传统上孤立的国家几十年来更加接近。本周，莫斯科和北京都发出了纪念朝鲜成立 78 周年的信息，并赞扬了两国深化与朝鲜的伙伴关系的战略重要性……

title.en: Call in China to end English's core status sparks debate
title.zh: 中国呼吁结束英语核心地位引发辩论

summary.en: A call to downgrade English in Chinese schools is fueling discussion over its value for students, careers, and China's global competitiveness in the age of AI.
summary.zh: 在中国学校降低英语地位的呼吁正在引发关于其对学生、职业以及人工智能时代中国全球竞争力的价值的讨论。

body.en:
A call to downgrade English in Chinese schools is fueling discussion over its value for students, careers and China's global competitiveness in the age of AI.

From business and academia to social media and entertainment — English is considered the dominant global language. One in five people on Earth actively uses this lingua franca. In China , a mathematics professor specializing in vector algebra is now challenging this dominance in no uncertain terms. Tang Jiafeng believes that English should be abolished as a core subject in elementary schools, secondary schools and universities.

Tang is convinced that no other country in the world has placed as much importance on English as China has.

"Our children desperately begin learning English even before they have properly mastered their native language. Yet we are a civilization that dates back thousands of years. English is just a tool. It's enough to be able to use it. The tradition of revering and emulating Western cultures must come to an end," Tang says in social media.

English is considered difficult in China, since the Chinese language does not use an alphabetic script. It is a required subject starting in third grade. It is graded on par with Chinese and mathematics on the entrance exam for secondary schools, the central exam after 9th grade, and the high school graduation exam. A maximum of 150 points can be earned on the latter.

"How many resources and how much time do our children, parents and schools invest in a subject that is completely irrelevant to the majority of people in their future professional lives?" the mathematician asks, explaining his position.

He became well-known because many of his students achieved full scores on state math exams; in the class of 2011, six students from a single class did so.

"Why cram for English when artificial intelligence can translate everything in seconds?" comments a user from Beijing.

Another suggestion from the southern province of Guangdong is to at least adjust the scoring — for example, to 120 points instead of 150 on the high school graduation exam.

Many parents invest in private tutoring that focuses specifically on exam questions. In addition, all bachelor's students must pass the English exam before being admitted to master's programs. Tang suspects that this could cause many young talents in the natural sciences to fail, even though they have great potential to become top researchers.

There is no question that English is also important for STEM subjects. Research on future-oriented topics is typically published in English. There are fears circulating online that cutting back on English instruction could lead to a decline in China's competitiveness. A prominent advocate for English as a required subject is Hu Xijin,...
body.zh: 降低中国学校英语等级的呼声引发了关于人工智能时代英语对学生、职业和中国全球竞争力价值的讨论。 从商业和学术界到社交媒体和娱乐——英语被认为是全球主导语言。地球上五分之一的人积极使用这种通用语言。在中国，一位专门研究向量代数的数学教授现在正在毫不含糊地挑战这一主导地位。唐家峰认为，应该取消英语作为小学、中学和大学的核心科目。 唐坚信，世界上没有哪个国家像中国一样重视英语。 唐在社交媒体上表示：“我们的孩子在还没有真正掌握母语之前就拼命地开始学习英语。但我们是一个有着数千年历史的文明。英语只是一种工具，能够使用它就足够了。尊重和效仿西方文化的传统必须结束。” 英语在中国被认为很难，因为中文不使用字母文字。这是从三年级开始的必修科目。中学入学考试、九年级后的集中考试和高中毕业考试的成绩与语文和数学同等。后者最多可获得 150 点积分。 “我们的孩子、家长和学校在一个与大多数人未来职业生涯完全无关的主题上投入了多少资源和时间？”数学家问道，并解释了他的立场。 他之所以出名，是因为他的许多学生在州数学考试中取得了满分。 2011届的一个班有六名学生这样做了。 “当人工智能可以在几秒钟内翻译所有内容时，为什么还要死记硬背英语呢？”北京网友评论。 来自南方省份广东省的另一项建议是至少调整分数——例如，高中毕业考试的分数从150分调整为120分。 许多家长投资专门针对考试问题的私人辅导。此外，所有学士学生必须通过英语考试才能进入硕士课程。唐怀疑这可能会导致许多自然科学领域的年轻人才失败，尽管他们有成为顶尖研究人员的巨大潜力。 毫无疑问，英语对于 STEM 科目也很重要。面向未来的主题的研究通常以英文发表。网上流传着这样的担忧：削减英语教学可能会导致中国竞争力下降。将英语作为必修科目的一位著名倡导者是胡锡进……

reflection.en: The debate in China about the role of English in education touches on how societies navigate the explosion of knowledge and global communication. As Professor Tang Jiafeng questions English's dominance, it mirrors the broader challenge of discerning which knowledge serves us best in an era of unprecedented information growth, as described in Daniel 12:4:...
reflection.zh: 在中国关于英语教育作用的辩论，触及了社会如何应对知识的爆炸式增长和全球交流。正如唐嘉风教授质疑英语的主导地位，这也反映了一个更广泛的挑战：在一个信息空前增长的时代，辨别哪些知识最能服务于我们。正如但以理书12:4所描述的：“必有多人来往奔跑，知识就必增长。”

verse.textEn: But you, Daniel, roll up and seal the words of the scroll until the time of the end. Many will go here and there to increase knowledge.
verse.textZh: 但以理啊，你要隐藏这话，封闭这书，直到末时。必有多人来往奔跑，知识就必增长。

title.en: 'Absurd': Yoga teachers become an unlikely flashpoint in Australia's migration debate
title.zh: “荒谬”：瑜伽老师成为澳大利亚移民辩论中一个不太可能的焦点

summary.en: The Australian government has faced persistent political criticism regarding its immigration policies, specifically accusations that it prioritizes admitting yoga instructors over much-needed construction workers to address a housing shortage. This political line of attack, originating from media reports, claims that...
summary.zh: 澳大利亚政府因其移民政策而面临持续的政治批评，特别是被指责优先引进瑜伽教练而非急需的建筑工人来解决住房短缺问题。这种政治攻击的说法源于媒体报道，声称瑜伽和武术教练在签证队列中被排在技工之前。

body.en:
Amid an ongoing political battle over which party's at fault for a lack of housing and migration numbers, an unlikely target has emerged: yoga teachers.

Labor has been accused by the Opposition of prioritising bringing in instructors of the flexible exercise to Australia, over construction workers sorely needed to address a critical housing shortage.

The Coalition since 2024 has levelled claims against Labor of putting instructors for martial arts and yoga ahead of tradies like bricklayers, painters, roof tilers and stonemasons in the visa queue.

The origins of the political line of attack appeared to come from a Nine Newspaper report which said in 2024 that a federal agency, Jobs and Skills Australia, listed yoga teachers as a skill in demand. Former coalition MP Michael Sukkar highlighted the report on social media, saying: "Under Labor they'll be more Yoga teachers and less tradies!".

On Thursday, Home Affairs Minister Tony Burke sought to put the claims to bed, once and for all.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

"It is absurd," he told the National Press Club, saying it was among the "silliest of all" arguments.

Burke outlined that rather than deprioritising construction workers, the government had tripled the number it was bringing in, from 4,500 to 15,000.

"In the life of this government, the number of yoga teachers we have brought in is zero," he said.

According to a fact check from Australian Associated Press (AAP) newswire, the opposition housing spokesman Andrew Bragg and colleagues made the claim a number of times in the past year, saying the government was bringing in more yoga teachers than construction workers.

AAP checked the claim against figures from the Department of Home Affairs, finding that only four yoga instructors have arrived since July 1, 2022, compared to thousands of construction workers that have come to Australia on skilled visas.

"While this figure may include yoga teachers, it could also cover coaches of other sports such as basketball or cricket," it said in an August finding.

Yoga teachers came under the temporary skilled visa program in 2022 after the Morrison government signed a trade agreement with India. The places are reserved for Indian nationals under that deal.

"It's a tiny argument, but it is so constantly out there and so demonstrably wrong, it gives an indication as to how a debate like this can just run out of control," Burke said.

body.zh: 在一场关于哪一方应因缺乏住房和移民人数的过错而进行的政治斗争中，一个不太可能的目标出现了：瑜伽老师。 反对党指责工党优先考虑将灵活练习的讲师引入澳大利亚，而不是解决严重的住房短缺问题所急需的建筑工人。 自2024年以来，联盟党一直对工党提出指控，称工党将武术和瑜伽教练置于签证队列中，排在瓦匠、油漆工、屋顶瓦工和石匠等技工之前。 政治攻击路线的起源似乎来​​自九号报纸的一篇报道，该报道称，2024 年，联邦机构澳大利亚就业和技能局将瑜伽教师列为一项紧缺技能。前联盟议员迈克尔·苏卡在社交媒体上强调了这一报道，他说：“在工党的领导下，他们将更多地担任瑜伽老师，而不是技工！”。 周四，内政部长托尼·伯克试图一劳永逸地平息这些说法。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 “这是荒谬的，”他告诉国家新闻俱乐部，并称这是“最愚蠢的”论点之一。 伯克概述说，政府并没有降低建筑工人的优先级，而是将引进的人数增加了两倍，从 4,500 人增加到 15,000 人。 “在本届政府任期内，我们引进的瑜伽老师数量为零，”他说。 据澳大利亚美联社（AAP）新闻专线的事实调查显示，反对党住房发言人安德鲁·布拉格（Andrew Bragg）及其同事在过去一年多次提出这一说法，称政府引进的瑜伽老师比建筑工人还多。 AAP 对照内政部的数据核实了这一说法，发现自 2022 年 7 月 1 日以来，只有四名瑜伽教练抵达澳大利亚，而有数千名持技术签证来到澳大利亚的建筑工人。 “虽然这个数字可能包括瑜伽老师，但也可能包括篮球或板球等其他运动的教练，”它在八月份的调查结果中表示。 莫里森政府与印度签署贸易协议后，瑜伽教师于 2022 年获得临时技术签证计划。根据该协议，这些席位是为印度国民保留的。 伯克说：“这是一个微小的争论，但它总是存在，而且明显是错误的，它表明像这样的辩论如何会失控。” 如需了解 SBS 新闻的最新动态，请下载我们的应用程序并订阅我们的时事通讯。

reflection.en: In Australia, a political debate has fixated on yoga teachers, with accusations that they are prioritized over construction workers needed for housing. This focus on a niche profession, while ignoring pressing needs, raises questions about the priorities and fairness of political discourse. title.en: Cuts, punishment powers and a notable exception: Key changes in Labor's migration shake-up
title.zh: 削减、惩罚权和例外：工党移民改革的关键变化

summary.en: The federal government has announced a shake-up of Australia's migration system, targeting visa-hoppers, overstayers, students, and backpackers. Home Affairs Minister Tony Burke unveiled the changes, stating the reforms aim to bring migration back in line with targets and assist housing supply.

body.en:
The federal government has announced a shake-up of Australia's migration system, with visa-hoppers, overstayers, students, and backpackers targeted in the crackdown.

Home Affairs Minister Tony Burke unveiled the changes during a National Press Club address on Thursday , following weeks of delay, heated debate and speculation.

Burke began his speech by highlighting the contribution of migration to Australia, but acknowledging there were problems with the current policy settings.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

Burke said the reforms are split into three parts: who arrives, who stays and who leaves.

Among the most consequential changes are those affecting students, backpackers, visa overstayers and visa hoppers.

International students and those on graduate visas will no longer be able to bring family members with them to Australia, with some exceptions for PhD students and some Pacific and ASEAN students.

As part of a so-called "visa-hopping" crackdown, Burke said the government will introduce a qualification scale, meaning only foreign students transferring to higher-level courses (bachelor's to master's for example) will be able to extend their visas.

A ballot system and cap will be introduced for backpackers wishing to extend their visit to a second or third year.

Only 45,000 working holiday-makers will be able to stay in Australia for a second year, and only 5,000 for a third year — down from 57,000 and 31,000 respectively. This will not affect United Kingdom citizens under the rules of a free trade agreement.

The government has already slowed down the processing of working holiday visas, with applications now taking months to be approved. Burke said processing of second-and third-year visas will be restored to the previous, faster pace — with the exception of UK citizens, who are exempt from regional work requirements to secure a visa extension.

The number of UK backpackers has risen sharply since the free trade agreement came into effect in 2023, from about 17,000 in 2021 to just under 80,000 now.

People who overstay their visas, of whom there are about 77,000, will face tougher sanctions, including detention. The government is now looking for more facilities, compliance officers and beds.

Burke said this was a return to a pre-2015 model, when visa overstayers would be taken into detention, and within a few weeks, organise their own flight and leave.

However, he said it would not involve "the sort of operation that some people have seen on TV happening in other countries", an apparent reference to the US Immigration and Customs Enforcement operations, which have involved mass deportation operations, arrests, and...

title.en: Do whales grieve? Rare footage of humpback alongside stillborn calf suggests they might | Olaf Meynecke for the Conversation
title.zh: 鲸鱼会悲伤吗？澳大利亚黄金海岸的科学研究表明它们可能会

summary.en: Researchers observed a humpback whale mother repeatedly returning to her deceased newborn calf on the seafloor for over an hour, gently touching it. This behavior is the first described instance of a humpback mother caring for her dead calf and raises questions about how highly social animals respond to death.
summary.zh: 研究人员观察到一只座头鲸母亲在一个多小时的时间里反复回到海床上死去的刚出生的幼崽身边，温柔地抚摸它。这种行为是首次被描述的座头鲸母亲照顾死去的幼崽的案例，并引发了关于高度社会化动物如何应对死亡的问题。

body.en:
One day last July, a newborn humpback whale calf lay motionless on the seafloor, just a kilometre off Australia’s Gold Coast. The encounter was captured through underwater video.

For more than an hour, the mother repeatedly returned to the same spot, gently touching the calf with her head and pectoral fin and resting beside it eye-to-eye. Our new research suggests this is the first described case of a humpback whale mother caring for her deceased newborn calf.

The encounter offers a rare window into one of the least understood aspects of whale behaviour: how these highly social animals respond to death.

And it raises the question: do whales, and other highly social animals such as elephants, grieve?

Humpback whales are known for their spectacular migrations and acrobatic breaches. However, they are equally remarkable for the way they respond to other animals in distress.

Humpback whales often defend their calves from killer whales. Researchers have also observed them remaining alongside whales that are injured or entangled in nets , circling them, resting nearby and attempting to assist. Humpback whales may even intervene when killer whales attack seals, sea lions and grey whale calves.

These responses of care and attention are known as epimeletic behaviour and are common among cetaceans , a group of marine mammals including whales, dolphins and porpoises. Dolphins and killer whales often remain close to distressed companions, evidence of their strong social bonds. These animals may even risk their own lives for others. This happened in April off Scotland’s north-west coast, when multiple pilot whales became stranded after following a birthing female.

Killer whale mothers have repeatedly been observed carrying their dead calves for hours, days and, in exceptional cases, weeks. The most famous example is the killer whale Tahlequah , who in 2018 carried her dead calf for 17 days over more than 1,500 kilometres. Scientists have observed similar behaviour in pilot whales and dolphins.

Such prolonged responses illustrate the strength of the bond between mother and calf. Maternal instincts and hormonal changes after birth may contribute to mothers remaining with their deceased offspring. But exactly what the animals understand about death remains unknown.

Until now, scientists have almost exclusively documented these epimeletic behaviours towards deceased calves in toothed whales . The research on baleen whales, including humpback whales, is scarce. This is likely because dead newborn baleen whales often sink quickly, making it extremely difficult to observe such cases.

Humpback whale mothers give birth after almost a year of pregnancy and spend the next few months feeding their calf with nutrient-rich milk. Right after the delivery, mothers...
body.zh: 去年七月的一天，一头新生座头鲸幼崽一动不动地躺在距离澳大利亚黄金海岸仅一公里的海底。这次遭遇是通过水下视频记录下来的。 在一个多小时的时间里，母亲反复回到同一个地方，用头和胸鳍轻轻地触碰小牛，并在旁边四目相对地休息。我们的新研究表明，这是首次描述座头鲸母亲照顾死去的新生幼崽的案例。 这次遭遇为了解鲸鱼行为中最不为人所知的方面之一提供了一个难得的窗口：这些高度社会化的动物如何应对死亡。 这就提出了一个问题：鲸鱼和其他高度社会化的动物（例如大象）会悲伤吗？ 座头鲸以其壮观的迁徙和杂技般的跃出而闻名。然而，它们对其他遇险动物的反应方式也同样引人注目。 座头鲸经常保护它们的幼崽免受虎鲸的侵害。研究人员还观察到它们留在受伤或被网缠住的鲸鱼旁边，围着它们转，在附近休息并试图提供帮助。当虎鲸攻击海豹、海狮和灰鲸幼崽时，座头鲸甚至可能会进行干预。 这些关心和关注的反应被称为表观行为，在鲸目动物中很常见，鲸目动物是一组海洋哺乳动物，包括鲸鱼、海豚和鼠海豚。海豚和虎鲸经常与受苦的同伴保持密切关系，这证明了它们牢固的社会联系。这些动物甚至可能为了他人而冒着生命危险。这件事发生在四月份苏格兰西北海岸附近，当时多头领航鲸在追随一头正在分娩的雌性鲸鱼后搁浅。 人们多次观察到虎鲸妈妈带着死去的幼鲸数小时、数天，在特殊情况下甚至数周。最著名的例子是虎鲸塔勒夸 (Tahlequah)，它在 2018 年携带死去的幼鲸长达 17 天，行程超过 1,500 公里。科学家们在领航鲸和海豚身上观察到了类似的行为。 如此长时间的反应说明了母亲和小牛之间的联系的强度。母性本能和出生后荷尔蒙的变化可能有助于母亲与已故的后代在一起。但动物们对死亡的具体理解仍然未知。 到目前为止，科学家几乎完全记录了齿鲸对死去幼崽的这些表观行为。对须鲸（包括座头鲸）的研究很少。这可能是因为死去的新生须鲸经常很快下沉，因此很难观察到这种情况。 座头鲸母亲在怀孕近一年后生下孩子，并在接下来的几个月里用营养丰富的牛奶喂养幼崽。产后，妈妈们...

reflection.en: The profound connection between a mother and her calf is evident in this heartbreaking scene off Australia's Gold Coast. The mother whale's persistent, gentle attention to her deceased newborn speaks to a deep bond that transcends simple instinct. Jesus himself wept at the tomb of Lazarus, showing that even divine love acknowledges and shares in our deepest...
reflection.zh: 在澳大利亚黄金海岸发生的这一令人心碎的场景中，母子之间深厚的联系显而易见。鲸鱼母亲对死去的幼崽持续而温柔的关注，体现了一种超越简单本能的深厚纽带。耶稣本人在拉撒路的坟墓前也曾哭泣，表明即使是神圣的爱也承认并分担我们最深切的悲伤。

title.en: From 'cashies' to convictions: The ATO's $2.7 million warning shot
title.zh: 从“现金交易”到定罪：税务局的270万澳元警告

summary.en: The Australian Taxation Office (ATO) is prosecuting hundreds of individuals and businesses for tax offenses, collecting millions in fines as part of a crackdown on the 'shadow economy,' which includes practices like demanding cash payments to avoid tax. Prosecutions for non-lodgment have increased by 80% in two years.
summary.zh: 澳大利亚税务局（ATO）正在起诉数百名个人和企业逃税，并追缴数百万澳元的罚款，这是其打击“影子经济”的一部分，其中包括要求现金支付以避税等行为。两年内，未申报的起诉案件增加了80%。

body.en:
Hundreds of people and businesses have been prosecuted for tax offences, with millions of dollars in fines handed down as authorities crack down on the shadow economy.

The Australian Taxation Office (ATO) on Thursday revealed non-lodgment prosecutions against "dodgy shadow economy operators" had risen by 80 per cent over the past two years, as it warned those who broke the rules would be held accountable.

The shadow economy involves both legal and illegal economic activity, including demanding cash payments for work, known as "cashies", to avoid tax, and underpayment of entitlements such as superannuation.

The ATO said more than 350 individuals or businesses had been successfully prosecuted in the past two years, resulting in more than $2.7 million in fines.

In the 2025-26 financial year, Queensland accounted for 28 per cent of non-lodgment prosecutions, followed by Western Australia (26 per cent) and NSW (20 per cent).

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

ATO assistant commissioner Tony Goding said avoiding tax and super obligations was seen by some as a victimless crime, but came at a cost to the community.

"The shadow economy undermines legitimate businesses and reduces revenue that would otherwise fund essential public services that support all Australians," he said.

"It doesn't matter what profession you're in, if you're a tradie, hairdresser or cafe owner, and you deliberately avoid paying the right amount of tax, you risk more than financial penalties."

Of the prosecutions, more than 305 resulted in convictions, representing a nearly 60 per cent increase from 2024–25 and 2025–26 financial years.

Goding said the figures demonstrated the ATO was holding those who break the rules to account.

"People who deliberately break the law risk their reputation and future, and the impact of a criminal conviction extends beyond the courtroom," he said.

"We've seen business owners receive criminal convictions, lose the trust of their customers and community, and in some cases, lose the very business they were trying to keep afloat. For more serious offending, time in prison is even a possibility.

"Our message to the community is clear: deliberately ignoring your obligations comes at a significant cost."

A 2016 government task force estimated Australia's shadow economy could be worth as much as 3 per cent of GDP, or approximately $50 billion in 2016 figures.

More recent ATO estimates show the shadow economy has continued to grow, reaching up to 5.4 per cent of GDP in 2023.

For the latest from SBS News, download our app and subscribe to our newsletter .
body.zh: 随着当局打击影子经济，数百人和企业因税务犯罪被起诉，并被处以数百万美元的罚款。 澳大利亚税务局(ATO)周四透露，过去两年来，针对“狡猾的影子经济运营商”的未提交起诉增加了80%，并警告那些违反规定的人将被追究责任。 影子经济涉及合法和非法的经济活动，包括要求支付工作现金（称为“现金”）以避税，以及少付养老金等应享权利。 ATO 表示，过去两年已有超过 350 名个人或企业被成功起诉，并被处以超过 270 万澳元的罚款。 在 2025-26 财年，昆士兰州占未提出起诉的 28%，其次是西澳大利亚州（26%）和新南威尔士州（20%）。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 ATO助理局长托尼·戈丁（Tony Goding）表示，一些人认为逃避税收和养老金义务是一种无受害人的犯罪行为，但却给社区带来了代价。 他说：“影子经济损害了合法企业，并减少了收入，而这些收入本来可以为支持所有澳大利亚人的基本公共服务提供资金。” “无论你从事什么职业，如果你是技工、美发师或咖啡馆老板，如果你故意逃避缴纳适当的税款，那么你面临的风险就不仅仅是经济处罚。” 在这些起诉中，超过 305 起被定罪，比 2024-25 和 2025-26 财政年度增加了近 60%。 戈丁表示，这些数据表明澳大利亚税务局正在追究那些违反规定的人的责任。 他说：“故意违法的人会拿自己的名誉和未来冒险，刑事定罪的影响超出了法庭范围。” “我们已经看到企业主被定罪，失去客户和社区的信任，在某些情况下，甚至失去了他们试图维持的业务。对于更严重的犯罪行为，甚至有可能入狱。 “我们向社区传达的信息很明确：故意忽视你的义务将会付出巨大的代价。” 2016 年政府工作组估计，澳大利亚影子经济的价值可能高达 GDP 的 3%，即 2016 年的数据约为 500 亿澳元。 ATO 最近的估计显示，影子经济持续增长，到 2023 年将达到 GDP 的 5.4%。 如需了解 SBS 新闻的最新动态，请下载我们的应用程序并订阅我们的时事通讯。

reflection.en: The Australian Taxation Office's aggressive pursuit of tax evasion, resulting in hundreds of prosecutions and millions in fines, underscores a commitment to economic justice. This crackdown on the 'shadow economy' reminds us that integrity in financial dealings is a matter of communal well-being, reflecting the call to 'act justly.'
reflection.zh: 澳大利亚税务局对逃税行为的严厉打击，导致数百起诉讼和数百万澳元的罚款，这表明了对经济公正的承诺。这次对“影子经济”的打击提醒我们，财务往来的诚信关系到社区的福祉，体现了‘秉公行义’的呼召。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

title.en: Tony Burke unveils major migration changes to tighten Australia's visa system — as it happened
title.zh: 现场更新：托尼·伯克谈移民改革，关键变化已揭晓

summary.en: The announcement comes as new figures show net overseas migration has fallen. Home Affairs Minister Tony Burke is detailing sweeping changes to Australia's immigration system, emphasizing the role of migration in shaping modern Australia and the significance of citizenship ceremonies.
summary.zh: 此公告发布之际，最新数据显示净海外移民人数有所下降。内政部长托尼·伯克正在详细介绍澳大利亚移民系统的重大改革，强调移民在塑造现代澳大利亚中的作用以及公民身份仪式的意义。

body.en:
Thanks for joining Miles Proust and me today as we covered the government's long-awaited unveiling of its migration shake-up.

You can find out more about the migration changes on SBS World News at 6.30pm AEST and via OnDemand , including analysis by SBS News' chief political correspondent Anna Henderson.

SBS News will also publish more stories in the coming days to help you understand how these changes may affect you and your community.

You can also download our app and  subscribe to our newsletter . It's the best way to stay across our updates, explainers and analysis as we continue covering these changes.

Kon Karapanagiotidis, CEO and founder of the Asylum Seeker Resource Centre, says the changes announced today mark "a dark day for multicultural Australia".

"Today our government chose to turn on migrants, international students and people seeking asylum who have built lives here, contributed to this country and asked for nothing more than the chance to belong," Karapanagiotidis said in a statement.

He was particularly concerned about how the changes would affect those seeking asylum, as well as plans to ramp up detention centre use for those overstaying their visas, saying they were reminiscent of US President Donald Trump's ICE immigration raids.

"Minister Burke went to great lengths to reassure Australians this would not look like Donald Trump's immigration raids.

"But look at what is actually being planned: 500 more compliance officers tasked with finding people, 1,250 more detention beds including plans to turn former COVID quarantine facilities in Victoria into detention centres, and billions more for removals."

He said the changes would double Australia's immigration detention regime and argued they would make Australia "smaller, meaner and more divided".

"We will not stand by while migrants and refugees are used as political punching bags," he added.

"We will fight any attempt to take away the right to work or shut people out of seeking protection."

Here's a look back at some bits you may have missed from today's eagerly awaited migration plan.

A ballot system will be introduced for second and third-year working holiday-makers, who are required to work regionally.

Only 45,000 working holiday-makers will be able to stay in Australia for a second year, and just 5,000 for a third year — down from 57,000 and 31,000 respectively.

British citizens will remain exempt from having to work regionally in their second and third years, with the government honouring a free trade agreement between Australia and the UK.

People who overstay their visas will be taken into detention, reviving a policy that was in place before 2015.

The government will also seek more facilities, compliance officers and beds to prepare for the...
body.zh: 内政部长托尼·伯克在堪培拉开始了他的全国新闻俱乐部演讲，他将详细介绍澳大利亚移民制度的全面改革。 部长首先强调今天是公民日，以及移民在塑造现代澳大利亚中所发挥的作用，并将公民身份描述为移民之旅的顶峰。 他将入籍仪式描述为澳大利亚“最快乐、最爱国的活动”之一，人们在仪式上对澳大利亚做出终生承诺，并受到澳大利亚社会的欢迎。 伯克承认移民体系中持续存在的挑战，但他表示，重要的是不要忽视移民对国家的更广泛贡献。 “我们永远不能忽视现代、多元文化的澳大利亚国家结构的非凡力量。” 政府还将更新第 110 号部长指示，通过更好地保护犯罪行为的儿童受害者以及家庭暴力受害者来打击仇恨和犯罪行为。 内政部长托尼·伯克将在全国新闻俱乐部的讲话中提供该计划的更多细节。 当托尼·伯克开始他的全国新闻俱乐部演讲时，我们现在知道了政府移民改革的关键细节。 联邦政府减少临时移民的计划包括驱逐非法非公民、打击“跳签证”以及为第二年和第三年背包客引入投票制度等。 大多数学生签证的家庭申请人将受到限制，所有访客签证都将引入“不得进一步居留”的条件，而明知无理支持签证申请的“流氓移民代理”也将成为目标。 优先处理将分配给技术移民途径中的关键部门，包括医疗保健、建筑、教育、执法、国防、资源、农业、水产养殖和渔业。 伯克表示，联邦政府支持移民，但“反对任何人破坏移民制度”。 “几乎每个来到澳大利亚的人都是我们国家的好客人。这些改革是为了确保我们的移民制度能够更好地针对澳大利亚当前的需求，”他说。 这些措施旨在将澳大利亚本财年的海外净移民人数减少至245,000人，并在2027-28财年减少至225,000人。 截至 2026 年 3 月的一年中，海外净移民人数已降至 292,000 人，略低于 12 月的 299,000 人。 该数据发布前不到一个小时，内政部长托尼·伯克(Tony Burke)发布了工党新的移民计划和减少海外净移民的战略。 最新数据显示，与去年相比，人数减少了 17,400 人（5.6%）。 有很多争论...

This reflects a governmental responsibility to ensure the immigration system upholds justice and serves the well-being of both newcomers and the nation, as mandated for leaders. May those who...
reflection.zh: 托尼·部长强调了公民日以及公民仪式所带来的喜悦和爱国氛围，将其视为移民旅程的顶点。这反映了政府有责任确保移民体系维护公正，并服务于新移民和国家福祉，正如对领导者的要求一样。 愿执政者铭记，他们最高的使命是施行公正与公义，确保所有寻求新家园的人受到尊重和公平对待，并通过明智和富有同情心的政策来加强国家。

title.en: 'Mobilisation of fear': The deeper strategy behind One Nation's immigration policy
title.zh: “恐惧动员”：一国党移民政策背后的深层策略

summary.en: For temporary migrants, the rise of One Nation is raising an urgent question: how secure is their future? Jyoti, a teacher who has lived in Australia for nearly a decade, is anxiously awaiting an update on her visa application, a process that has become more urgent amid heightened political rhetoric surrounding...
summary.zh: 对于临时移民来说，一国党（One Nation）的崛起提出了一个紧迫的问题：他们的未来有多稳定？来自印度旁遮普的Jyoti是一位在澳大利亚居住了近十年的中学教师，她正焦急地等待着她的签证申请更新，而围绕移民的政治言论日益激烈，使得这一过程变得更加紧迫。

body.en:
Share your feedback and help us improve this feature. Read more about how we use AI at SBS here.

Jyoti has called her migration agent three times this month. Each time, she asks the same question: Has there been any update?

Her application for a Skilled Independent visa, a pathway to permanent residency , has been sitting in the queue for months. It has felt like a long wait for Jyoti, who has lived in Australia for the better part of a decade. In recent months, that uncertainty has taken on a new urgency.

The 43-year-old is a secondary school teacher who lives in an outer northern suburb of Melbourne with her husband and their two children. She arrived from Punjab, northern India, eight years ago as an international student and is now in Australia on a work visa.

She asks that only her first name be used because she fears speaking publicly could affect her family's visa prospects.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

"International students, temporary visa holders ... we would be the first to lose our livelihoods and our place here if Pauline Hanson comes to power, or if her party keeps gaining momentum," she tells SBS News.

Jyoti says she is watching the lead-up to Victoria's November election closely. To her, the election will be an early test of how far One Nation leader Pauline Hanson's momentum could travel and what that could mean for her family's future in the only country her children have really known. It's a fear, she says, that everyone she knows in her position is carrying right now.

One Nation wants to cut 750,000 temporary visa holders from Australia over three years. Not one of them will get a say in whether the party succeeds.

"Our fate is being decided by political parties whose fate we have no say in," Jyoti says.

Australia is home to roughly three million temporary visa holders, including students, graduates and skilled workers.

As One Nation pushes for sweeping cuts to temporary migration, it raises a harder question about political power: are people with the least ability to influence an election also the easiest to target?

One Nation's plan would tighten the student and graduate visa systems, restrict family members from accompanying temporary skilled workers, and close off "visa hopping" — the practice of extending a stay by switching between visa categories rather than leaving the country and reapplying offshore.

According to the policy announced on Monday, international students and graduates would absorb the biggest cuts.

The student visa population, including accompanying family members, would fall from about 590,000 to 350,000, and the graduate visa population from about 270,000 to just 40,000 over...

title.en: An ancient disease is surging in Australia — and it isn't always easy to detect
title.zh: 澳大利亚一种古老疾病正在激增——而且并非总是容易检测到

summary.en: Diagnoses for some STIs have increased over the past decade with experts suggesting solutions may be already known.
summary.zh: 在过去十年中，一些性传播感染的诊断有所增加，专家们认为解决方案可能已经为人所知。

body.en:
Reported cases of infectious syphilis and gonorrhoea have surged by more than half over the past decade in Australia, as experts warn education and testing urgently needs to improve.

In 2025, there were 42,393 gonorrhoea notifications and 5,986 infectious syphilis notifications — a 10-year increase of 57 per cent for gonorrhoea and 56 per cent for syphilis, analysis from the University of New South Wales' Kirby Institute has shown.

Syphilis was declared a communicable disease of national significance in late 2025, in response to "ongoing and concerning" rises in Australian case numbers.

Chief medical officer Professor Michael Kidd declared that awareness was necessary among all Australians, including healthcare professionals, and urged everyone to get tested.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

Syphilis and gonorrhoea are common bacterial infections with ancient origins, now easily treated with antibiotics.

If left untreated, syphilis progresses through stages and can spread to the brain, heart, eyes, and other organs. It can cause neurological problems including paralysis, and dementia, and cause soft, tumour-like growths to appear on the skin, bones or internal organs. Tertiary syphilis can eventually lead to death.

Notification rates for infectious syphilis among women increased 170 per cent in the past decade from 2016 to 2025. In contrast, rates increased just 39 per cent among males.

Syphilis during pregnancy can lead to congenital syphilis, which can result in miscarriage or stillbirth, or severe lifelong health impacts in babies that are born, including prematurity, low birthweight and other physical developmental abnormalities.

Kirby Institute epidemiologist Dr Skye McGregor said congenital syphilis is a persistent issue in Australia, with more than half of deaths in the last decade among First Nations infants. There were 14 cases of congenital syphilis in 2025, and 113 from 2016 to 2025, with 40 resulting in the death of an infant.

"This is an entirely preventable outcome with early diagnosis, testing and treatment of pregnant people," McGregor said.

First Nations peoples were disproportionately affected by STIs, diagnosed with gonorrhoea at more than four times the rate of non-Indigenous people and syphilis at more than six times.

Kim Gates, community relations lead in the Kirby Institute's First Nations Point-Of-Care Program, said the disparities in diagnoses between First Nations and non-Indigenous Australians were an indication of broader inequities in healthcare.

Australian services needed to be designed better to reflect the experiences of First Nations communities, Gates told SBS News, adding that many First...
body.zh: 过去十年来，澳大利亚报告的传染性梅毒和淋病病例激增了一半以上，专家警告说，教育和检测亟待改善。 新南威尔士大学柯比研究所的分析显示，2025 年，共收到 42,393 份淋病通报和 5,986 份传染性梅毒通报——淋病病例比 10 年来增加了 57%，梅毒病例增加了 56%。 2025 年底，为了应对澳大利亚病例数“持续且令人担忧”的上升，梅毒被宣布为全国性传染病。 首席医疗官迈克尔·基德教授宣称，包括医疗保健专业人员在内的所有澳大利亚人都有必要提高认识，并敦促每个人都接受检测。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 梅毒和淋病是常见的细菌感染，其起源古老，现在很容易用抗生素治疗。 如果不及时治疗，梅毒会分阶段发展，并可能扩散到大脑、心脏、眼睛和其他器官。它会导致神经系统问题，包括瘫痪和痴呆，并导致皮肤、骨骼或内脏器官上出现柔软的肿瘤样生长。三期梅毒最终可导致死亡。 从 2016 年到 2025 年的过去 10 年里，女性传染性梅毒的通报率增加了 170%。相比之下，男性的通报率仅增加了 39%。 怀孕期间感染梅毒可导致先天性梅毒，从而导致流产或死产，或对出生的婴儿造成严重的终生健康影响，包括早产、低出生体重和其他身体发育异常。 柯比研究所流行病学家斯凯·麦格雷戈博士表示，先天性梅毒是澳大利亚的一个长期存在的问题，过去十年中超过一半的死亡病例是原住民婴儿。 2025年有14例先天性梅毒病例，2016年至2025年有113例，其中40例导致婴儿死亡。 麦格雷戈说：“通过对孕妇进行早期诊断、检测和治疗，这是完全可以预防的结果。” 原住民受到性传播感染的影响尤为严重，被诊断出淋病的比例是非原住民的四倍多，梅毒的比例是非原住民的六倍多。 柯比研究所原住民护理点项目社区关系负责人金·盖茨表示，原住民和非原住民澳大利亚人之间的诊断差异表明医疗保健领域存在更广泛的不平等。 盖茨告诉 SBS 新闻，澳大利亚的服务需要更好地设计，以反映原住民社区的经验，并补充说许多原住民……

reflection.en: The rise in infectious syphilis and gonorrhea in Australia, increasing by over 50% in a decade, points to a significant public health challenge. This surge underscores the importance of proactive measures and community awareness in combating widespread illness, reminding us of the biblical call to care for the sick and address the root causes of disease.

title.en: BoM issues a fresh 'super' El Niño reality check for Australia
title.zh: 气象局就澳大利亚的“超级”厄尔尼诺现象发出新的现实检验

summary.en: Australia's current El Niño event is projected to be one of the strongest on record, with record-breaking sea surface temperatures in the Pacific Ocean. However, the Bureau of Meteorology (BoM) has advised that the strength of an El Niño does not directly correlate with the severity of its impacts in Australia, as...
summary.zh: 澳大利亚目前发生的厄尔尼诺现象预计将是有记录以来最强之一，太平洋海表温度将创下新高。然而，澳大利亚气象局（BoM）警告说，厄尔尼诺现象的强度并不直接决定其在澳大利亚影响的严重程度，因为还有其他气候驱动因素会影响天气模式。

body.en:
Australia's current El Niño could become the strongest on record, but the Bureau of Meteorology (BoM) has cautioned that doesn't necessarily mean the country is headed for an exceptionally hot and dry summer.

The BoM says models indicate the El Niño underway in the Pacific Ocean could produce the highest central tropical Pacific sea surface temperature anomaly since reliable records began in 1950.

But it has stressed the strength of an El Niño does not directly determine how severe its impacts will be in Australia, with several other climate drivers influencing rainfall and temperatures.

An El Niño occurs when sea surface temperatures in parts of the central and eastern tropical Pacific Ocean become unusually warm, triggering changes in atmospheric circulation and weather patterns.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

The BoM says the current event is likely to become the strongest recorded based on forecast sea surface temperatures in the central tropical Pacific.

During the 1982-83 El Niño, which currently holds the record, sea surface temperature anomalies peaked at around 2.6C above average in January 1983.

However, the BoM has warned against assuming a stronger El Niño automatically means more extreme conditions for Australia.

"Every El Niño is different," it said in an advisory it released on Tuesday.

"A strong event can produce only modest effects in some regions, while a weaker event can have significant impacts."

Australia's weather is influenced by a combination of climate drivers, including El Niño, the Indian Ocean Dipole (IOD), surrounding sea surface temperatures and seasonal changes, as well as the longer-term effects of climate change.

The previous El Niño, which developed in spring 2023 and continued into early 2024, was considered a moderate-to-strong event.

The current El Niño is likely to continue through spring and summer, although its influence on Australian rainfall typically diminishes around early summer.

The BoM's latest long-range forecast, issued on 10 September, shows most of Australia is likely to experience above-average temperatures over the coming months.

Between October and December, below-average rainfall is likely across parts of south-eastern Australia, including southern NSW, Victoria and Tasmania.

Most of Western Australia, as well as some central and northern parts of the country, are instead forecast to receive above-average rainfall.

The IOD is currently neutral, but all climate models suggest a positive IOD could develop later in spring. A positive IOD can increase the likelihood of drier spring conditions, particularly across southern and...
body.zh: 澳大利亚目前的厄尔尼诺现象可能会成为有记录以来最强的厄尔尼诺现象，但气象局（BoM）警告说，这并不一定意味着该国将迎来异常炎热干燥的夏季。 BoM 表示，模型显示，太平洋中正在发生的厄尔尼诺现象可能会产生自 1950 年有可靠记录以来最高的中部热带太平洋海面温度异常。 但它强调，厄尔尼诺现象的强度并不直接决定其对澳大利亚的影响有多严重，其他几个气候驱动因素也会影响降雨量和气温。 当热带太平洋中部和东部部分地区的海面温度变得异常温暖，引发大气环流和天气模式的变化时，就会发生厄尔尼诺现象。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 气象局表示，根据热带太平洋中部海面温度的预测，当前的事件可能会成为有记录以来最强烈的事件。 1982-83 年厄尔尼诺现象（目前这一记录保持者）期间，海面温度异常在 1983 年 1 月达到峰值，比平均水平高出约 2.6 摄氏度。 然而，央行警告不要假设更强的厄尔尼诺现象自动意味着澳大利亚将面临更极端的情况。 “每次厄尔尼诺现象都是不同的，”它在周二发布的一份报告中表示。 “强烈的事件只能在某些地区产生适度的影响，而较弱的事件可能会产生重大影响。” 澳大利亚的天气受到多种气候驱动因素的影响，包括厄尔尼诺现象、印度洋偶极子 (IOD)、周围海面温度和季节变化，以及气候变化的长期影响。 上一次厄尔尼诺现象发生于 2023 年春季，一直持续到 2024 年初，被认为是中度至强度事件。 当前的厄尔尼诺现象可能会持续整个春季和夏季，尽管其对澳大利亚降雨量的影响通常会在初夏左右减弱。 BoM 9 月 10 日发布的最新长期预测显示，未来几个月澳大利亚大部分地区的气温可能会高于平均水平。 十月至十二月期间，澳大利亚东南部部分地区的降雨量可能低于平均水平，包括新南威尔士州南部、维多利亚州和塔斯马尼亚州。 西澳大利亚州的大部分地区以及该国中部和北部的一些地区预计降雨量将高于平均水平。 IOD 目前为中性，但所有气候模型都表明 IOD 可能会在春季晚些时候出现正值。正 IOD 会增加春季干燥的可能性，特别是在南部和......

While the El Niño is exceptionally potent, its precise effects are complex and influenced by many factors. This calls for discernment, looking beyond the obvious to understand the full picture, rather than making assumptions based on a single...

title.en: 'Really problematic': Australians are rejecting the very homes the country needs
title.zh: “非常成问题”：澳大利亚人正在拒绝国家急需的住房

summary.en: Concerns are mounting that Australia's housing crisis may be exacerbated if the current trend of buyers rejecting newly-built homes persists, as sales have fallen for four consecutive months to their lowest level in over a year.
summary.zh: 人们越来越担心，如果买家拒绝新房的趋势持续下去，澳大利亚的住房危机可能会加剧，新房销售已连续四个月下降，达到一年多来的最低水平。

body.en:
Buyers appear to be rejecting newly-built homes, sparking concerns Australia's property market slowdown could worsen a chronic housing shortage.

Sales of new homes fell 10 per cent nationally in August and were 19.3 per cent lower in the three months to August compared with the previous quarter, according to new data from the Housing Industry Association (HIA).

Sales have now fallen for four consecutive months to their lowest level in more than a year.

The slowdown was recorded across all five mainland states included in the HIA survey, which tracks sales by large-volume home builders and is considered a leading indicator of future detached home construction.

Victoria recorded the sharpest quarterly decline, with sales down 27 per cent, followed by Queensland at 20.2 per cent, NSW at 17.5 per cent, South Australia at 10.8 per cent and Western Australia at 8.2 per cent.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

HIA chief economist Tim Reardon said the deterioration meant the recovery in new home building seen earlier this year had been interrupted.

"Today's new home sales are tomorrow's housing commencements," he said in a statement.

"The decline in sales through the middle of 2026 will mean fewer homes commencing construction in 2027."

Independent property economist Cameron Kusher told SBS News that a combination of higher borrowing costs and low confidence was making it increasingly difficult to buy a new home. But he warned that if sales continued to decline leading to fewer builds, it could lead to even higher prices in the future.

"We're seeing really weak confidence around the housing market generally at the moment," he told SBS News.

Tim Lawless, the research director at property data firm Cotality, said the slowdown was also evident across the broader property market, although new homes appeared to have been hit harder.

Cotality estimates home sales across the broader market were about 15 per cent lower over winter than a year earlier and 11 per cent below the five-year average.

"It does look like new home sales have been hit a little bit harder," Lawless said, pointing to higher interest rates, weaker confidence, reduced investment and affordability and serviceability constraints.

The slowdown has been particularly pronounced in Sydney, Brisbane and Perth, where Cotality estimates home sales fell by more than 20 per cent over winter compared with the same period last year.

Lawless said Brisbane and Perth were coming off relatively strong levels of activity, while Sydney's decline was more reflective of severe affordability constraints.

Kusher said new homes typically carried a premium compared with established properties, making...
body.zh: 买家似乎拒绝新建房屋，引发人们担心澳大利亚房地产市场放缓可能会加剧长期住房短缺问题。 根据住房行业协会 (HIA) 的最新数据，8 月份全国新房销量下降 10%，截至 8 月份的三个月内较上一季度下降 19.3%。 目前销售额已连续四个月下降至一年多来的最低水平。 HIA 调查中包含的所有五个大陆州都出现了经济放缓，该调查跟踪大批量住宅建筑商的销售情况，并被认为是未来独立住宅建设的领先指标。 维多利亚州的季度跌幅最为严重，销售额下降了27%，其次是昆士兰州，下降了20.2%，新南威尔士州下降了17.5%，南澳大利亚州下降了10.8%，西澳大利亚州下降了8.2%。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 HIA 首席经济学家蒂姆·里尔登 (Tim Reardon) 表示，情况恶化意味着今年早些时候出现的新住宅建设复苏已被中断。 他在一份声明中表示：“今天的新屋销售就是明天的房屋开工。” “到 2026 年中期销量下降将意味着 2027 年开工建设的房屋数量将会减少。” 独立房地产经济学家卡梅伦·库舍尔 (Cameron Kusher) 告诉 SBS 新闻，较高的借贷成本和较低的信心使得购买新房变得越来越困难。但他警告说，如果销量继续下降，导致建造量减少，未来可能会导致价格更高。 他告诉 SBS 新闻：“目前我们普遍看到房地产市场的信心非常疲弱。” 房地产数据公司Cotality的研究主管蒂姆·劳利斯(Tim Lawless)表示，尽管新房似乎受到了更严重的打击，但整个房地产市场的放缓也很明显。 Cotality 估计，冬季整个市场的房屋销售量比去年同期下降约 15%，比五年平均水平低 11%。 劳利斯表示：“看来新房销售确实受到了更严重的打击。”他指出，利率上升、信心减弱、投资减少以及可负担性和可服务性限制。 悉尼、布里斯班和珀斯的放缓尤为明显，Cotality 估计这些城市冬季房屋销售量与去年同期相比下降了 20% 以上。 Lawless表示，布里斯班和珀斯的经济活动相对强劲，而悉尼的下滑更多地反映了严重的承受能力限制。 库舍尔说，与现有房产相比，新房通常价格更高，这使得……

reflection.en: The housing market slowdown in Australia, with sales falling significantly, raises questions about how industry leaders and policymakers are responding. Proverbs 11:14 reminds us that 'where there is no guidance, a people falls, but in an abundance of counselors there is safety.' This suggests that a lack of wise counsel or a failure to heed market signals...
reflection.zh: 澳大利亚住房市场的低迷，销售额大幅下滑，引发了人们对行业领导者和政策制定者如何应对的疑问。《箴言》11:14 提醒我们：“没有谋士，国就败落；谋士多，国就安。” 这表明，缺乏明智的建议或未能听取市场信号可能导致负面后果，影响到行业和基本住房的供应。

title.en: Policy move lauded for bringing down manpower shortage
title.zh: 政策举措获赞扬，有望缓解劳动力短缺

summary.en: Hong Kong's Secretary for Labour and Welfare, Chris Sun, announced on Thursday that the city's overall manpower shortage is projected to decrease slightly to approximately 130,000 by 2028. This revised estimate represents a reduction of 50,000 from the 180,000 shortage predicted two years ago. Sun attributed this...
summary.zh: 劳工及福利局局长孙玉菡周四表示，香港整体劳动力短缺预计到2028年将略微收窄至约13万人。这一修订估计比两年前预测的18万人短缺减少了5万人。孙局长将这一改善归因于经济结构性变化、吸引人才政策的有效性以及近年来人工智能的快速发展所带来的影响。

body.en: Hong Kong’s overall manpower shortage is expected to narrow slightly to about 130,000 by 2028, Secretary for Labour and Welfare Chris Sun said on Thursday. Speaking at a press conference to explain initiatives in the city’s first five-year plan and the Policy Address, he said officials had recently conducted a mid-term update of their manpower projection. The latest estimate, he said, represents a decrease of 50,000 from the 180,000 shortage projected two years ago. Sun said the narrower shortage reflected changes in the economic structure, the effectiveness of policies to attract talent and the impact of rapid artificial intelligence development over the past one or two years on manpower demand. Without policy intervention, however, the manpower gap in 2028 could have reached 300,000, he said. Sun also said authorities would continue to update Hong Kong's Talent List to include professions in fields tied to national development priorities, such as artificial intelligence. The current list covers 60 professions across various industry segments in which there is a shortage of manpower needed to support high-value and diversified economic development. "One of the focuses of the next round review will be including more AI-related talents into the list," Sun said. "Of course, this is up to the trade and also those who are interested in AI, including the bureau, to propose. "Here in the Labour and Welfare Bureau, we are the coordinating bureau so we will take into account their views in the common review." Sun added that the review would also consider including other professions, with the aim of completing the update by next year. As part of a subsidy programme to boost youth employment, the government will bring the business sector on board to create 10,000 additional full-time roles. Each position will last at least six months, and the jobs will be rolled out over two years starting in the first quarter of 2027. They will be aimed at young people entering the workforce for the first time. Authorities will subsidise part of their monthly pay for six months, covering either HK$6,000 per month or up to one third of the employee's monthly salary, whichever is lower, for a duration of six months. Edited by Aaron Tam
body.zh: 劳工及福利局局长孙宇晨周​​四表示，预计到 2028 年，香港整体劳动力短缺将小幅收窄至 13 万人左右。他在解释香港第一个五年计划和施政报告中的举措的新闻发布会上表示，官员们最近对人力预测进行了中期更新。他说，最新的估计比两年前预计的 18 万人短缺减少了 5 万人。孙说，短缺的收窄反映了经济结构的变化、吸引人才的政策的有效性以及过去一两年人工智能的快速发展对人力需求的影响。但他表示，如果没有政策干预，2028年的人力缺口可能会达到30万。孙还表示，当局将继续更新香港的人才名单，纳入与国家发展重点相关领域的专业人士，例如人工智能。目前的名单涵盖了各个行业领域的60个职业，这些行业都缺乏支持高价值和多元化经济发展所需的人力资源。 “下一轮审核的重点之一将是将更多人工智能相关人才纳入名单，”孙说。 “当然，这要由业界和对人工智能感兴趣的人士，包括局方提出建议。在劳工及福利局，我们是协调局，所以我们在共同检讨时会考虑他们的意见。”孙补充说，检讨也会考虑包括其他职业，目标是在明年完成更新。作为促进青年就业的资助计划的一部分，政府将邀请商界参与，额外创造1万个就业岗位。每个职位将持续至少六个月，从2027年第一季度开始，将在两年内推出。这些职位将针对首次进入劳动力市场的年轻人，当局将补贴他们六个月的部分月薪，补贴金额为每月6,000港元或高达雇员月薪的三分之一，以较低者为准，为期六个月。

reflection.en: Hong Kong's government is actively planning and implementing policies to address its manpower shortage, aiming for a more stable economic future. This proactive approach to managing societal needs reflects a commitment to planning and execution. As they commit their efforts and strategies, may they also commit their work to Yahweh, trusting in His guidance...
reflection.zh: 香港政府正积极规划并实施政策以应对劳动力短缺问题，旨在实现更稳定的经济未来。这种积极主动管理社会需求的方法体现了对规划和执行的承诺。当他们致力于这些努力和策略时，愿他们也将工作交托于雅伟，信靠祂的指引，为这座城市带来期望的成果和繁荣。

verse.textEn: Commit to Yahweh whatever you do, and he will establish your plans.
verse.textZh: 你所做的，要交托雅伟，你所谋的，就必成立。

title.en: Alexandra Eala headlines Hong Kong Tennis Open lineup
title.zh: 亚历山德拉·埃阿拉领衔香港网球公开赛阵容

summary.en: World No. 18 Alexandra Eala of the Philippines, fresh off her first WTA Tour title win in Washington, is set to headline the 32-player singles draw at the Hong Kong Tennis Open. The WTA 250 tournament, offering over US$280,000 in prize money, will take place from October 31 to November 8 at Victoria Park. Other...
summary.zh: 菲律宾选手、世界排名第18位的亚历山德拉·埃阿拉（Alexandra Eala）将在即将举行的香港网球公开赛中领衔32强单打正赛阵容。埃阿拉刚刚赢得了她在华盛顿公开赛上的首个WTA巡回赛冠军。这项WTA...

body.en: World No 18 Alexandra Eala from the Philippines – who clinched her maiden WTA Tour title at the Washington Open – is set to headline a 32-player singles draw at the upcoming Hong Kong Tennis Open. The WTA 250 tournament, which boasts a total prize purse of more than US$280,000, will run from October 31 to November 8 at Victoria Park. At a press conference, the Hong Kong, China Tennis Association revealed that China’s top-ranked player Wang Xinyu, former world No 2 Paula Badosa of Spain, and Russia’s world No 13 Diana Shnaider will also feature in the event. Local favourite Eudice Chong, who became the first player from Hong Kong to win a WTA Tour doubles title after her victory at the Morocco Open in May, is set to return to the doubles draw. Meanwhile, local rising stars Adithya Karunaratne and Yandy Shek have been awarded wildcards for the singles event. Ticket sales will open at 3pm on September 28 via the online platform Ticketflap, with prices ranging from HK$180 to HK$1,070. Full-time students, seniors aged 60 or above, and young people aged 18 or under can enjoy a 50-percent discount on Category 2 tickets. Edited by Aaron Tam
body.zh: 来自菲律宾的世界排名第 18 的亚历山德拉·埃拉 (Alexandra Eala) 在华盛顿公开赛上首次夺得 WTA 巡回赛冠军，她将在即将举行的香港网球公开赛上成为 32 名选手单打抽签的主角。 WTA 250锦标赛总奖金超过28万美元，将于10月31日至11月8日在维多利亚公园举行。中国香港网球协会在新闻发布会上透露，中国排名第一的选手王新宇、前世界排名第二的西班牙选手保拉·巴多萨和俄罗斯排名第13的戴安娜·施奈德也将参加这项赛事。当地最受欢迎的庄尤迪丝（Eudice Chong）在五月摩洛哥公开赛上获胜后，成为第一位赢得 WTA 巡回赛双打冠军的香港选手，她将重返双打抽签。与此同时，当地新星阿迪西亚·卡鲁纳拉特纳 (Adithya Karunaratne) 和杨迪·石 (Yandy Shek) 获得了单打比赛的外卡。门票将于9月28日下午3时透过网上平台Ticketflap开放发售，票价介乎港币180元至港币1,070元。全日制学生、60岁以上老年人、18岁以下青少年可享受二类门票50%的折扣。谭咏麟编辑

As these players prepare to compete and the tournament unfolds, may their hard work and aspirations be committed to Yahweh, trusting in His guidance for success and fulfillment. “Commit your work...

title.en: China imposes travel curbs to protect ‘national security’ amid superpower tech race
title.zh: 中国以“国家安全”为由实施旅行限制，以应对超级大国科技竞赛

summary.en: China implemented broad travel bans on its citizens on Tuesday, targeting individuals deemed a threat to the nation's "industrial or technological security." The State Council announced that citizens violating technology import and export rules could be prohibited from leaving the country, with penalties ranging from...
summary.zh: 中国周二对公民实施了广泛的旅行禁令，针对那些被认为威胁国家“工业或技术安全”的个人。国务院宣布，违反技术进出口规定的公民可能会被禁止出境，对于在国外从事非法活动的人，处罚期为回国之日起的六个月至三年。此举正值中美两国科技竞赛加剧之际。

body.en: China imposed sweeping travel restrictions on its citizens on Tuesday, including exit bans on those deemed to endanger the country’s “industrial or technological security”. File photo: Lukas Messmer/HKFP. Citizens who violate technology import and export regulations could be banned from leaving China, the State Council said. Those who engage in illegal activities abroad could be “prohibited from leaving the country for a period of six months to three years from the date of their return to China”. China and the United States have been locked in a tech race, with both sides accusing the other in recent months of stealing the capabilities of locally developed artificial intelligence models. The new rules, first released in July but in effect from Tuesday, were formulated to “safeguard national sovereignty, security, and development interests”, the State Council said. ‘Wide remit’ However, analysts warn that the travel rules give China a “wide remit”. A robot is displayed at the Hong Kong Productivity Council’s AI exhibition in Kowloon Tong on May 21, 2026. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. Security and criminal activities “can be vaguely defined and easily adjusted”, Chong Ja Ian from the National University of Singapore told AFP. “The outside world will only know how it applies that remit after there are cases of implementation,” he said. Chong pointed to reports of exit bans on foreign nationals, including the recent case of US citizen Min Zin. The US government has said the political analyst was taken into Chinese custody in Yunnan province on June 3 and was held improperly. China refuted the accusations in August, saying Min Zin was suspected of violating Chinese law. “The case of Min Zin is a reminder that the range of people (that China) could restrict from exiting could be quite wide — and potentially arbitrary,” Chong said. Dylan Loh, an associate professor at Singapore’s Nanyang Technological University, told AFP the travel restrictions “send a message” that China will take action to prevent “leaks in security or national interest-sensitive areas”.
body.zh: 中国周二对其公民实施了全面的旅行限制，包括对那些被认为危及该国“工业或技术安全”的人实施出境禁令。资料照片：Lukas Messmer/HKFP。国务院表示，违反技术进出口规定的公民可能会被禁止出境。那些在境外从事非法活动的人可能“自返回中国之日起六个月至三年内禁止出境”。中国和美国陷入了一场科技竞赛，近几个月来双方都指责对方窃取了当地开发的人工智能模型的能力。国务院表示，新规定于 7 月首次发布，自周二起生效，旨在“维护国家主权、安全、发展利益”。 “广泛的职权范围” 然而，分析人士警告说，旅行规则赋予中国“广泛的职权范围”。 2026 年 5 月 21 日，香港生产力促进局在九龙塘举办的人工智能展览上展示了一台机器人。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。新加坡国立大学的庄嘉伊恩 (Chong Ja Ian) 告诉法新社，安全和犯罪活动“可以被模糊地定义，并且很容易调整”。他说：“只有在有实施案例后，外界才会知道它如何适用。” Chong提到了有关外国人出境禁令的报道，包括最近发生的美国公民敏津的案件。美国政府表示，这名政治分析家于6月3日在云南省被中国拘留，且拘留方式不当。中国八月份驳斥了这些指控，称敏津涉嫌违反中国法律。 “敏津的案例提醒人们，（中国）可以限制退出的人群范围可能相当广泛，而且可能是任意的，”庄说。新加坡南洋理工大学副教授迪伦·卢告诉法新社，旅行限制“发出了一个信息”，即中国将采取行动防止“安全或国家利益敏感领域的泄密”。

reflection.en: The state's power to restrict movement, ostensibly for national security, can easily become a tool of oppression. Proverbs 28:15 warns that "where there is a tyrannical ruler, there is oppression." This verse calls us to be aware of how state power can be wielded, and to pray for justice and the protection of individual liberties.
reflection.zh: 国家以国家安全为名限制公民出行的权力，很容易沦为压迫的工具。《箴言》28:15 警告说：“暴虐的君王，治理疲惫的百姓。”这节经文提醒我们警惕国家权力的滥用，并为公义和个人自由的保障祈祷。

verse.textEn: Like a roaring lion or a charging bear is a wicked ruler over a helpless people.
verse.textZh: 暴虐的君王辖制贫民，好像吼叫的狮子、觅食的熊。

title.en: Hong Kong police officer left paralysed in 2005 knife attack dies
title.zh: 2005年遇袭致瘫痪的香港警员去世

summary.en: A former Hong Kong police constable, Jacky Chu Chun-kwok, who had been paralyzed and bedridden for 21 years following a knife attack during a stop-and-search operation, died on Wednesday at the age of 50-something. The force is considering burying him in Gallant Garden, a cemetery for public servants.
summary.zh: 一名曾在2005年执勤时遭刀袭而瘫痪卧床21年的香港前警员朱振国（Jacky Chu Chun-kwok）于周三去世，终年五十多岁。警队正考虑将其安葬于浩园，这是为公务员设立的墓地。

body.en: A former Hong Kong police constable who was left paralysed and bedridden for 21 years following a knife attack during a stop-and-search has died, the South China Morning Post has learned. A source said Jacky Chu Chun-kwok who was in his fifties, died on Wednesday. Frankie Leung Chun-kit, chairman of the Junior Police Officers’ Association, said on Thursday that the force’s management supported burying Chu in Gallant Garden, a dedicated site at Wo Hop Shek Public Cemetery for public servants who...
body.zh: 据《南华早报》获悉，一名前香港警员在拦截搜查时遭遇持刀袭击，导致瘫痪并卧床 21 年，现已死亡。消息人士称，五十多岁的朱俊国于周三去世。初级警务人员协会主席梁振杰周四表示，警队管理层支持将朱安葬在和合石公众坟场的嘉兰花园，这是专门为那些...

reflection.en: Jacky Chu Chun-kwok's passing marks the end of a long and difficult chapter, a life profoundly altered by violence. His 21 years of paralysis serve as a stark reminder of life's fragility and the inevitability of death that awaits us all. As Hebrews 9:27 reminds us, death is appointed for all humanity, a shared human condition that calls for compassion and...
reflection.zh: 朱振国先生的离世标志着一段漫长而艰难的人生篇章的结束，他的人生因暴力而发生了翻天覆地的变化。他瘫痪在床的21年，是对生命脆弱性以及我们所有人终将面对的死亡的严峻提醒。正如希伯来书9:27所言，人人都有一死，这是人类共同的命运，呼唤着我们施以同情和反思。

verse.textEn: Just as people are destined to die once, and after that to face judgment.
verse.textZh: 按着定命，人人都有一死，死后且有审判。

title.en: 22 months’ jail for Hong Kong driver who fatally struck student at traffic junction
title.zh: 香港司机危险驾驶致学生死亡被判监禁22个月

summary.en: A Hong Kong man has been sentenced to 22 months in prison for dangerous driving that resulted in the death of a 19-year-old student at a pedestrian crossing two years ago. The court also disqualified him from driving for five years and criticized his dangerous and irresponsible behavior.
summary.zh: 一名香港男子因危险驾驶导致一名19岁学生在两年前的行人过路处死亡，被判处22个月监禁。法院还取消了他的驾驶资格五年，并批评了他危险和不负责任的行为。
