The District Court on Thursday also disqualified Ernest Au Yeung Shiu-hong from driving for five years and criticised his “extremely dangerous and irresponsible” attitude that led to Lisa Pun’s death on November 7, 2024. Au Yeung, an NGO event organiser, drove his Tesla Model Y past a box junction on On Lok Road in Yuen Long at...
body.zh: 一名香港男子因两年前危险驾驶并在人行横道造成一名 19 岁学生死亡而被判处 22 个月监禁。区域法院周四还取消欧阳绍康五年驾驶资格，并批评他“极其危险和不负责任”的态度，导致潘丽莎于 2024 年 11 月 7 日死亡。非政府组织活动组织者欧阳绍康驾驶他的特斯拉 Model Y 经过元朗安乐路的一个箱形路口。

reflection.en: The tragic death of a young student due to a driver's negligence underscores the profound impact of irresponsible actions. The sentence of 22 months reflects a measure of accountability, reminding us that our choices have weighty consequences for others. May this serve as a sober reminder of the importance of justice and responsible conduct in all our...
reflection.zh: 一名学生因司机疏忽而tragically死亡，凸显了不负责任行为的深远影响。22个月的判决在一定程度上体现了问责，提醒我们每一个选择都会对他人的生活产生沉重后果。愿这成为一个严肃的提醒，强调在所有交往中公正和负责任行为的重要性。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

title.en: Hong Kong airport records 10% passenger growth as cargo falls for second month
title.zh: 香港机场客运量增长10%，货运量连续第二个月下降

summary.en: Hong Kong International Airport saw a nearly 10% increase in passenger traffic in the first eight months of the year compared to 2025, reaching 44.3 million passengers. However, cargo volume decreased for the second consecutive month in August due to weak exports, with flight movements also seeing a modest increase.
summary.zh: 香港国际机场今年前八个月的客运量与2025年同期相比增长了近10%，达到4430万乘客。然而，由于出口疲软，8月份货运量连续第二个月下降，飞机起降架次也有小幅增长。

body.en: Hong Kong International Airport recorded a roughly 10 per cent increase in passenger traffic in the first eight months of the year, compared with the same period in 2025, while cargo volume declined for a second consecutive month in August amid weak exports. The airport said passenger numbers rose by 10.1 per cent to 44.3 million between January and August, year on year, while flight movements increased by 3.5 per cent to 269,900. Passenger traffic in August reached 5.86 million, up 3.5 per cent...
body.zh: 与 2025 年同期相比，香港国际机场今年前 8 个月的客运量增长了约 10%，而由于出口疲软，8 月份的货运量连续第二个月下降。该机场表示，1 月至 8 月期间，旅客人数同比增长 10.1%，达到 4430 万人次，航班起降量增长 3.5%，达到 269,900 架次。 8月旅客吞吐量586万人次，增长3.5%

reflection.en: The ebb and flow of passenger traffic and cargo volume at Hong Kong International Airport reflect the complex interplay of global economics and human endeavor. Proverbs 16:3 reminds us that while we plan and work, committing our endeavors to Yahweh's guidance can lead to success and stability, even amidst fluctuating conditions.
reflection.zh: 香港国际机场客运量和货运量的潮起潮落，反映了全球经济和人类努力之间复杂的相互作用。箴言16:3提醒我们，虽然我们计划和工作，但将我们的事业托付给雅伟的指引，即使在变化的环境中也能带来成功和稳定。

verse.textEn: Commit to Yahweh whatever you do, and he will establish your plans.
verse.textZh: 你所做的，要交托雅伟，你所谋的，就必成立。

title.en: Hong Kong’s ‘AI city brain’ will not tap personal data, breach privacy: John Lee
title.zh: 香港“城市大脑”不会侵犯个人数据和隐私：李家超

summary.en: Hong Kong's Chief Executive John Lee has stated that the new "AI city brain" system will not access personal data, thereby posing no privacy risks. He also emphasized the importance of AI education and literacy for young people, referencing concerns about over-reliance on technology leading to social isolation.
summary.zh: 香港行政长官李家超表示，新的“AI城市大脑”系统不会访问个人数据，因此不会带来隐私风险。他还强调了人工智能教育和素养对年轻人的重要性，并引用了过度依赖技术导致社交孤立的海外案例。

body.en: Hong Kong’s new “AI city brain” will not involve personal data and poses no privacy concerns, the city leader has said, adding that the system will also help improve visitor management during “golden week” holidays. Chief Executive John Lee Ka-chiu also stressed on Thursday the importance of AI education and the need to nurture young people’s AI literacy, citing overseas examples of adolescents who became socially isolated after relying too heavily on the technology. In his annual policy address...
body.zh: 香港领导人表示，香港新的“人工智能城市大脑”不会涉及个人数据，不会造成隐私问题，并补充说该系统还将有助于改善“黄金周”假期期间的游客管理。行政长官李家超周四也强调人工智能教育的重要性以及培养年轻人人工智能素养的必要性，并列举了海外青少年因过度依赖技术而受到社会孤立的例子。在他的年度施政报告中...

reflection.en: As Hong Kong develops its "AI city brain," leaders assure citizens that personal data will be protected. This echoes the profound truth that every individual is created in the image of Yahweh, possessing inherent dignity and rights that technology must respect. Our value is not in our data, but in our divine origin.
reflection.zh: 随着香港开发其“AI城市大脑”，领导人向市民保证个人数据将受到保护。这呼应了一个深刻的真理：每个人都是照着雅伟的形象所造，拥有技术必须尊重的内在尊严和权利。我们的价值不在于我们的数据，而在于我们神圣的起源。

verse.textEn: So God created mankind in his own image, in the image of God he created them; male and female he created them.
verse.textZh: 神就照着自己的形象造人，乃是照着他的形象造男造女。

title.en: Five-Year Plan: NGOs urge stronger protections for the underprivileged, from rent controls to heatwave measures
title.zh: 五年规划：非政府组织呼吁加强对弱势群体的保护，从租金管制到热浪措施

summary.en: Local concern groups have urged the government to provide low-income residents with stronger protections, ranging from rent controls to heatwave safety measures, in response to Hong Kong leader John Lee’s first Five-Year Plan and his administration’s final Policy Address.
summary.zh: 当地关注团体呼吁政府为低收入居民提供更强有力的保护，范围涵盖租金管制和热浪安全措施，以回应香港行政长官李家超的首个《五年施政方略》及其政府的最后一份施政报告。

body.en: Local concern groups have urged the government to provide low-income residents with stronger protections, ranging from rent controls to heatwave safety measures, in response to Hong Kong leader John Lee’s first Five-Year Plan and his administration’s final Policy Address. A group of NGOs – including Grassroots Wishes, Concerning Grassroot Housing Rights Alliance, and Alliance for Children Development Rights – holds a watch party in Mong Kok on Wednesday, September 16, 2026, as Chief Executive John Lee delivers his 2026 Policy Address. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. Among the groups that responded to Lee’s policy announcement was anti-poverty NGO the Society for Community Organization (SoCO), which urged the government to reinstate the income-based poverty line , scrapped by officials in 2022. A coalition of NGOs, including Grassroots Wishes, Concerning Grassroot Housing Rights Alliance, Care for Carers, and Alliance for Children Development Rights, held a watch party for Lee’s address to the Legislative Council on Wednesday. In a joint statement issued Wednesday evening, the coalition urged the government to cap non-local labour by implementing a circuit-breaker mechanism that triggers when unemployment, underemployment, salary levels, and the local labour supply hit a certain benchmark. It also urged authorities to review the existing heat stress warning system to take into account work environments and labour intensity. A group of NGOs – including Grassroots Wishes, Concerning Grassroot Housing Rights Alliance, and Alliance for Children Development Rights – held a watch party in Mong Kok on Wednesday, September 16, 2026, as Chief Executive John Lee delivered his 2026 Policy Address. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. Heat prevention requirements should also be incorporated into tender agreements, complete with a penalty system and fines, as well as restrictions on bidding for tenders, the groups said. Housing targets The coalition also presented a range of policy recommendations regarding housing, including urging the government to establish a cap on initial rents for Basic Housing Units — subdivided units that meet minimum living standards set by the authorities. See also: John Lee says wait for subsidised rental flats will fall to under 4 years by 2030 Residents have expressed concerns that landlords might hike rents after bringing their flats up to standard. Kei pays HK$2,200 every month for this 20-sq-ft coffin home. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. Lee’s Five-Year Plan says the government will aim to “resolve the issue of substandard subdivided units” by 2030 and expects to bring the average waiting time for subsidised rental housing down to four years in 2030/31. Delivering the half-decade policy blueprint, the chief executive said that the city will...
body.zh: 当地关注团体敦促政府为低收入居民提供更强有力的保护，包括租金管制和热浪安全措施，以回应香港领导人李家超的第一个五年计划及其政府的最终施政报告。一群非政府组织——包括草根愿望、关注草根住房权利联盟和儿童发展权利联盟——于2026年9月16日星期三在旺角举行观摩派对，聆听行政长官李家超发表2026年施政报告。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。响应李光耀政策声明的团体包括反贫困非政府组织社区组织协会 (SoCO)，该组织敦促政府恢复被官员于 2022 年废除的基于收入的贫困线。包括草根愿望、关注草根住房权利联盟、关爱照顾者和儿童发展权利联盟在内的非政府组织联盟周三为李在立法会的讲话举行了一场观摩会。在周三晚间发布的联合声明中，该联盟敦促政府通过实施熔断机制来限制非本地劳动力，该机制会在失业率、就业不足、工资水平和本地劳动力供应达到一定基准时触发。它还敦促当局审查现有的热应激预警系统，以考虑工作环境和劳动强度。一群非政府组织——包括草根愿望、关注草根住房权利联盟和儿童发展权利联盟——于2026年9月16日星期三在旺角举行观摩会，聆听行政长官李家超发表2026年施政报告。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。这些组织表示，防暑要求还应纳入招标协议中，并附有处罚制度和罚款，以及对投标的限制。住房目标 该联盟还提出了一系列有关住房的政策建议，包括敦促政府对基本住房单元（满足当局规定的最低生活标准的细分单元）的初始租金设定上限。另请参阅：John Lee 表示，到 2030 年，等待补贴租赁公寓的时间将降至 4 年以下 居民担心房东在公寓达到标准后可能会提高租金。 Kei每月为这套20平方尺的棺材屋支付2,200港元。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。李光耀的五年计划表示，政府的目标是到2030年“解决不合格劏房问题”，并预计到2030/31年将资助租赁房屋的平均轮候时间缩短至四年。行政长官在交付五年政策蓝图时表示，该市将...

reflection.en: In Hong Kong, non-governmental organizations are advocating for essential protections for the underprivileged, such as rent controls and heatwave safety measures. This mirrors the ancient call to "speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves." These groups are giving voice to the needs of low-income residents, ensuring their well-being is considered...
reflection.zh: 在香港，非政府组织正在为弱势群体争取基本保护，例如租金管制和热浪安全措施。这呼应了古老的呼召：“为不能说话者说话”。这些团体正在为低收入居民的声音代言，确保他们的福祉在政府规划中得到考虑。

verse.textEn: Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for the rights of all who are destitute. Speak up and judge fairly; defend the rights of the poor and needy.
verse.textZh: 你当为不能自辩的开口，为孤独的伸冤。你当开口按公义判断，为困苦和穷乏的辨屈。

title.en: Ivan Yang, Lydia Sham to be Asian Games flag bearers
title.zh: 楊佩珊將擔任亞運會持旗手

summary.en: Basketball player Ivan Yang and wushu athlete Lydia Sham have been selected by the Sports Federation & Olympic Committee of Hong Kong, China, to be the SAR's flag bearers for the opening ceremony of the Asian Games in Aichi-Nagoya. The selection recognizes their athletic achievements and leadership within the Hong...
summary.zh: 香港籃球運動員楊佩珊和武術運動員沈曉榆已被中國香港體育協會暨奧林匹克委員會選為亞運會開幕禮的香港代表團持旗手。這次選拔肯定了他們在運動方面的成就以及在香港代表團中的領導地位。

body.en: The Sports Federation & Olympic Committee of Hong Kong, China (SF&OC) has named basketball player Ivan Yang and wushu athlete Lydia Sham as the SAR’s flag bearers for the opening ceremony of the Asian Games in Aichi-Nagoya on Saturday. In a statement, the committee said representatives of the Hong Kong, China, contingent attended a flag-raising and team welcome ceremony held by the Asian Games organising committee at Nagoya Port Garden Pier on Thursday. The delegation joined those from the Chinese mainland and Macao, with the three teams exchanging best wishes and aiming for outstanding achievements at the Games. Wong Po-kee, chef de mission of the SAR contingent, said the athletes had undertaken long-term, dedicated training and were fully ready for the Games. "I hope they will enjoy competing and engaging with Asia’s top athletes, give their best performance, and achieve new heights," he said. "At the same time, I call on everyone to support and stand behind every athlete." Yang captained the men’s under-22 team at last year’s National Games and represented the city at the Fiba Asia Cup 2029 pre-qualifiers this year. Sham will be competing in her third Asian Games after winning gold last year in both the women’s Changquan–Jianshu–Qiangshu combined event at the World Games in Chengdu and the women’s Changquan event at the World Wushu Championships. Hong Kong, China, is sending a contingent of more than 800 members, including about 580 athletes, to compete in 38 sports at the Games, which will run from September 19 to October 4. The team will compete in padel, modern pentathlon and wrestling at an Asian Games for the first time. Edited by Aaron Tam
body.zh: 中国香港体育协会及奥林匹克委员会（SF&OC）任命篮球运动员杨伟雄和武术运动员沈殿霞为周六在爱知名古屋举行的亚运会开幕式的特区旗手。组委会在一份声明中表示，中国香港代表团代表周四出席了亚运会组委会在名古屋港花园码头举行的升旗和代表团欢迎仪式。代表团与内地和澳门代表团一起，三支队伍互致良好祝愿，力争在奥运会上取得优异成绩。特区代表团团长黄宝基表示，运动员们经过长期刻苦训练，已为奥运会做好了充分准备。 “我希望他们能够享受与亚洲顶尖运动员的竞争和接触，发挥出最好的表现，并达到新的高度，”他说。 “同时，我呼吁大家支持和支持每一位运动员。”杨在去年的全运会上担任男子22岁以下国家队队长，今年又代表香港参加了2029年国际篮联亚洲杯预选赛。岑女士继去年在成都世运会女子长拳、武术、武术混合项目和世界武术锦标赛女子长拳项目中获得金牌后，将第三次参加亚运会。中国香港将派出800多名队员，其中约580名运动员，参加9月19日至10月4日举行的亚运会，参加38个大项的比赛。该队将首次参加亚运会，参加板球、现代五项和摔跤比赛。谭咏麟编辑

reflection.en: As Ivan Yang and Lydia Sham carry the flag for Hong Kong at the Asian Games, they embody the spirit of dedication and striving for excellence. The Apostle Paul reminds us that athletes train with great discipline for a perishable reward, urging us to do the same in our own pursuits, aiming for an eternal prize. May their journey inspire all to approach...
reflection.zh: 當楊佩珊和沈曉榆在亞運會上為香港舉起旗幟時，他們體現了奉獻和追求卓越的精神。使徒保羅提醒我們，運動員為了會朽壞的獎賞而奮力爭勝，並敦促我們在各自的追求中也同樣努力，以求不朽的獎賞。 願他們的旅程激勵所有人以同樣的投入和毅力來面對自己的事業，認識到紀律嚴明付出的價值，無論是在運動場上還是在日常生活中。

verse.textEn: Do you not know that in a race all the runners run, but only one gets the prize? Run in such a way as to get the prize.
verse.textZh: 岂不知在场上赛跑的都跑，但得奖赏的只有一人？你们也当这样跑，好叫你们得着奖赏。

title.en: Policy sustainability must be taken into account: CE
title.zh: 政策可持续性须纳入考量：行政长官

summary.en: Chief Executive John Lee stated on Thursday that the government must prioritize financial sustainability and the efficient use of resources when developing policies. This comes after he announced 11 measures to encourage childbirth in his Policy Address the previous day, including an increase in the maximum mortgage...
summary.zh: 行政长官李家超周四表示，政府在制定政策时必须考虑财政可持续性和资源的合理分配。此前一天，他在施政报告中公布了11项鼓励生育的措施，其中包括将新生婴儿家庭的“白表”申请人的最高按揭贷款成数由九成提高至九成半。在周四的立法会答问环节中，有议员询问这项措施是否可以扩展至所有“白表”申请人，并指出许多年轻人因缺乏稳定的住房而犹...

body.en: Chief Executive John Lee on Thursday said the government must keep financial sustainability and the reasonable allocation of resources in mind when formulating policy. In announcing his Policy Address the day before, Lee outlined 11 measures to boost fertility, including raising the maximum mortgage loan-to-value ratio from 90 percent to 95 percent for White Form family applicants with newborns. At a Legco question-and-answer session on Thursday, lawmaker Scott Leung asked whether the initiative could be extended to all White Form applicants, saying many young people hesitate to marry and have children due to a lack of stable housing. “We need to consider that if we expand a measure too broadly, whether our financial commitments and responsibilities will remain sustainable,” Lee said in response. “The sustainability of a policy must be taken into account when allocating public resources, which is why some measures are intended to be one-off or short-term in nature.” Education sector lawmaker Tang Fei asked how the government plans to attract top tech talent to the Northern Metropolis. The chief executive noted that the Labour and Welfare Bureau will soon release its latest Manpower Projection, acknowledging that Hong Kong faces a shortage of AI specialists. Lee stressed that the government will do everything possible to recruit professionals in the field. “We have several advantages. First, our tertiary education is highly successful. For a small city, we boast five top-100 universities. Second is our internationalisation. Third, talent naturally leans towards opportunity, and our five-year plan clearly outlines where Hong Kong's future opportunities lie," he said. "Furthermore, all our policies are focusing on talent, technology, and industry development, as skilled professionals are drawn to research, academic, and industry ecosystems. Our push to build university towns is also important in attracting global talent.” On the five-year plan, DAB lawmaker Gary Chan asked Lee whether the public could expect to see clear improvements in the economy after five years, and whether their overall well-being would receive a major boost. Lee said it was up to the chief executive to make sure the plan was implemented. “Implementing a five-year plan means it needs to span across five Policy Addresses. But how do we ensure proper execution throughout those five years? The chief executive needs to report to national leaders each year, and the five-year plan explicitly states that during these briefings, the chief executive must explain the progress of its implementation," he said. “The chief executive is the person in charge, the ‘head of the household’, and it is his responsibility to implement the five-year plan.” The next five-year plan, Lee added, will set...
body.zh: 行政长官李家超周四表示，政府在制定政策时必须考虑财务可持续性和资源的合理分配。李在前一天公布施政报告时概述了11项提高生育率的措施，包括将有新生儿的白表家庭申请人的最高抵押贷款与价值比率从90%提高到95%。在周四的立法会问答会上，立法会议员梁志强询问是否可以将这项举措扩大到所有白表申请人，并表示许多年轻人由于缺乏稳定的住房而犹豫是否结婚生子。李回应说：“我们需要考虑，如果我们将一项措施扩大得太广泛，我们的财务承诺和责任是否仍然可持续。” “在分配公共资源时必须考虑政策的可持续性，这就是为什么有些措施是一次性或短期的。”教育界议员唐飞询问政府计划如何吸引顶尖科技人才来到北方都市。行政长官表示，劳工及福利局即将公布最新的人力推算，承认香港面临人工智能专家短缺的问题。李强调，政府将尽一切可能招募该领域的专业人士。他说：“我们有几个优势。首先，我们的高等教育非常成功。对于一个小城市来说，我们拥有五所排名前100的大学。其次是我们的国际化。第三，人才自然倾向于机会，我们的五年计划清楚地勾勒出香港未来的机会所在。” “此外，我们所有的政策都侧重于人才、技术和产业发展，因为研究、学术和产业生态系统吸引了熟练的专业人士。我们推动建设大学城对于吸引全球人才也很重要。”就五年计划，民建联议员陈家利向李光耀询问，五年后，巿民可否看到经济明显改善，整体福祉是否会得到大幅提升。李说，由首席执行官负责确保该计划得到实施。 “实施五年计划意味着需要跨越五份施政报告。但如何确保这五年得到妥善执行？行政长官每年都需要向国家领导人汇报，而五年计划明确规定，行政长官必须在这些吹风会上解释其实施进展，”他说。 “行政长官是负责人，是‘一家之主’，落实五年计划是他的责任。”李补充说，下一个五年计划将设定……

reflection.en: In Hong Kong, the Chief Executive has announced measures to encourage childbirth, highlighting the government's focus on supporting families. This policy initiative acknowledges the importance of new life and the challenges families face, particularly regarding housing. The biblical perspective reminds us that children are a gift from Yahweh, a blessing to...
reflection.zh: 香港行政长官公布了鼓励生育的措施，凸显了政府对支持家庭的关注。这项政策举措认识到新生命的重要性以及家庭面临的挑战，尤其是在住房方面。圣经的观点提醒我们，儿女是雅伟所赐的产业，是值得珍惜和支持的祝福，他们构成了社会的未来。

verse.textEn: Children are a heritage from Yahweh, offspring a reward from him.
verse.textZh: 儿女是雅伟所赐的产业。

title.en: Hong Kong to set up public ‘condolence points’ for first post-Handover leader Tung Chee-hwa
title.zh: 香港将设立公众吊唁点，悼念首位后移交时期领导人董建华

summary.en: Hong Kong's government has announced the establishment of three public sites for citizens to pay their respects to Tung Chee-hwa, the city's first leader after the 1997 handover, who died last Tuesday at the age of 89. Condolence books will be available over the weekend at designated locations, and a state funeral is...
summary.zh: 香港政府已宣布设立三个公众吊唁点，供市民向香港首位后移交时期领导人董建华致哀。董建华于上周二去世，享年89岁。吊唁簿将于周末在指定地点开放，并计划举行国葬。

body.en: Hong Kong’s government has announced that it will set up three sites for members of the public to pay their respects to the city’s first post-Handover leader Tung Chee-hwa, who passed away last Tuesday at the age of 89. Tung Chee-hwa. Photo: Our Hong Kong Foundation. The Home Affairs Department said on Wednesday that the “condolence points” will be opened over the weekend at Moreton Terrace Activities Centre in Causeway Bay, Kai Tak Community Hall, and Sai Lau Kok Garden in Tsuen Wan. Visitors will be able to sign condolence books at the venues between 9am and 9pm on Friday and Saturday, and from 9am to noon on Sunday. State funeral A state funeral will also be held over the weekend for Tung, who served two consecutive terms as Hong Kong’s first chief executive after the former British territory’s 1997 return to China. The Hong Kong Funeral Home in North Point will host a private vigil from 3pm to 10pm on Saturday, with a public memorial and funeral service beginning the following morning at 9am in the funeral home’s Fuk Hoi Tong hall. A funeral procession will immediately follow the farewell ceremony at 11am on Sunday. Tung Chee Hwa, then chief executive, shakes hand with China’s then-vice-President Hu Jintao in 1999. Photo: GovHK. Tung’s funeral will follow state funeral protocols, making him the third Hong Kong figure to be afforded the honour. Like Tung, the previous two – industrialist Ann Tse-kai and business tycoon Henry Fok – also served as vice-chairs of the Chinese People’s Political Consultative Conference, the country’s top political advisory body. Horse races cancelled The Hong Kong Jockey Club announced on Wednesday that it will cancel its Sha Tin race meeting scheduled for Sunday “in deference to the funeral arrangement for The Honourable Tung Chee Hwa.” In a statement, the club said it will also close off-course betting branches on Sunday to show respect for the ceremony.
body.zh: 香港政府宣布将设立三个场地，供公众悼念香港回归后首任领导人董建华，董建华于上周二去世，享年89岁。照片：我们的香港基金会。民政事务总署周三表示，将于周末在铜锣湾摩顿台活动中心、启德社区会堂及荃湾西楼角花园设立“慰问点”。周五和周六上午 9 点至晚上 9 点以及周日上午 9 点至中午，游客可以在吊唁簿上签名。国葬 董建华的国葬也将于周末举行，他在香港 1997 年回归中国后连续两届担任香港首任特首。位于北角的香港殡仪馆将于周六下午 3 点至晚上 10 点举行私人守夜活动，并于次日上午 9 点在殡仪馆的福海堂举行公众追悼会和葬礼。周日上午 11 点举行告别仪式后，将立即举行葬礼游行。 1999 年，时任行政长官董建华与时任国家副主席胡锦涛握手。照片：香港政府一站通。董建华的葬礼将遵循国葬礼仪，这使他成为第三位获此殊荣的香港人物。与董建华一样，前两位——实业家安泽楷和商业大亨霍英东——也曾担任中国最高政治咨询机构中国人民政治协商会议的副主席。赛马取消 香港赛马会周三宣布，将取消原定于周日举行的沙田赛马会，“以配合董建华先生的葬礼安排”。俱乐部在一份声明中表示，周日还将关闭场外投注点，以表达对仪式的尊重。

reflection.en: The news of Tung Chee-hwa's passing reminds us of the universal human experience of mortality. As the government prepares public spaces for mourning, it acknowledges a shared moment of reflection on life's finitude. Hebrews 9:27 speaks to this reality, reminding us that death is a certainty for all, a call to consider our own lives and legacies.
reflection.zh: 董建华先生逝世的消息提醒我们，死亡是全人类共同的经历。政府设立公众吊唁场所，标志着一个共同反思生命有限性的时刻。希伯来书9章27节正指出了这一现实，提醒我们死亡是所有人的必然归宿，促使我们思考自己的人生和身后事。

verse.textEn: Just as people are destined to die once, and after that to face judgment.
verse.textZh: 按着定命，人人都有一死，死后且有审判。

title.en: Man arrested after wife found dead in Heng Fa Chuen
title.zh: 男子在恒发邨被捕，妻子被发现死亡

summary.en: A 51-year-old man has been arrested in connection with the murder of his 53-year-old wife, who was discovered with numerous stab wounds in their Heng Fa Chuen residence on Wednesday. The husband reportedly surrendered himself to police.
summary.zh: 一名51岁男子因涉嫌谋杀其53岁妻子而被捕。周三，该女子被发现倒卧在他们位于恒发邨的住所内，身上有多处刺伤。据报，该名丈夫已向警方自首。

body.en: A 51-year-old man has been arrested over the murder of his 53-year-old wife, who was found with multiple stab wounds in their Heng Fa Chuen flat on Wednesday. Officers said the woman was found dead at the flat on Shing Tai Road, and that her husband turned himself in at Kowloon City police station at around 7.30pm the same day. The man told officers he had used a kitchen knife to attack his wife in the unit where they lived. Police found her on the bed in the master bedroom and she was confirmed dead at the scene by first responders. "Through police investigations and a preliminary examination by a forensic pathologist, it was found that the deceased had multiple knife wounds, including to the neck, waist and hands," said Kwan Chun-ting, assistant district commander (crime) of the Eastern district. "After investigating, we currently believe the incident occurred on September 16 between the early-morning hours and later in the day. "The arrested man used a kitchen knife to attack the victim." He was arrested on suspicion of murder and detained for investigation. Police said preliminary investigations showed he had recently made risky investments and accrued debts of more than HK$1 million, which were believed to have led to disputes and arguments with his wife. Kwan said the woman was a housewife while the man worked as an information technology professional and drew a stable income. The couple had two sons, aged 22 and 15. He said there were no previous records of domestic violence or disputes involving the family. Edited by Aaron Tam
body.zh: 一名 51 岁男子因谋杀其 53 岁妻子而被捕，周三，妻子在其杏花村公寓内被发​​现有多处刀伤。警方表示，该女子被发现死在盛泰道的单位内，其丈夫于同日晚上7时30分左右到九龙城警署自首。该男子告诉警察，他在他们居住的单位里用菜刀袭击了他的妻子。警方在主卧室的床上发现了她，急救人员证实她当场死亡。东区警区助理指挥官（刑事）关振廷表示，经警方调查及法医初步检查，发现死者有多处刀伤，包括颈部、腰部和手部。 “经调查，目前相信事件发生在9月16日凌晨至当日晚些时候。被捕男子以菜刀袭击受害人。他因涉嫌谋杀而被拘捕，并被扣留调查。警方表示，初步调查显示，他近期进行了风险投资，并累积了超过100万港元的债务，相信导致与妻子发生争执和争吵。关先生表示，该女子是家庭主妇，而男子则为资讯科技专业人士。夫妇俩有两个儿子，分别为22岁和15岁。他表示，此前没有家庭暴力或家庭纠纷的记录。

reflection.en: This tragic event, where a wife was found dead from multiple stab wounds, speaks to the profound brokenness that can occur within intimate relationships. The victim, silenced by violence, is a stark reminder of those who are oppressed and cannot speak for themselves. We are called to defend the vulnerable and seek justice for those who have been wronged.
reflection.zh: 这起悲剧事件，一名妻子因多处刺伤而身亡，揭示了亲密关系中可能发生的深刻破碎。受害者被暴力夺去生命，成为那些受压迫且无法为自己发声之人的惨痛警示。我们蒙召要保护弱者，为受屈者寻求公义。

verse.textEn: Learn to do right; seek justice. Defend the oppressed. Take up the cause of the fatherless; plead the case of the widow.
verse.textZh: 学习行善，寻求公平，解救受欺压的；给孤儿伸冤，为寡妇辨屈。

title.en: Policy Address 2026: Greenpeace criticises lack of wetland protection in Northern Metropolis development plan
title.zh: 绿色和平批评北部都会区发展计划缺乏湿地保护

summary.en: Greenpeace Hong Kong has criticized the Northern Metropolis development project, stating that its blueprint fails to protect sensitive wetlands near the border with mainland China. The plan, part of the Five-Year Plan (FYP) and annual Policy Address, was unveiled by Chief Executive John Lee. The environmental group...
summary.zh: 绿色和平香港批评北部都会区发展项目，指出其蓝图未能保护靠近中国大陆边境的敏感湿地。该计划是五年计划（FYP）和年度施政报告的一部分，由行政长官李家超公布。该环保组织指出，FYP的生态保护目标远未达到中国国家标准。

body.en: Greenpeace Hong Kong has criticised plans for the Northern Metropolis development project, saying that the blueprint lacks protections for sensitive wetlands near the city’s border with mainland China. Hong Kong Chief Executive John Lee (centre) attends a press conference after delivering the city’s first five-year plan and his annual Policy Address on September 16, 2026. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. Details for the sprawling tech hub were unveiled in the Five-Year Plan (FYP) and annual Policy Address delivered by Chief Executive John Lee on Wednesday. The green group said that the ecological protection goals set out in the FYP lagged far behind China’s national standards for preserving important wetlands. Lee laid out Hong Kong’s first FYP at the legislature on Wednesday, in a move seen as aligning the freewheeling city more closely with China’s national development trajectory. On environmental protection, Lee said the city would “maintain” 40 per cent of its land and 20 per cent of its marine area as protected zones by 2030. Hong Kong’s border areas near Shenzhen is set to be transformed into a 30,000-hectare Northern Metropolis. File photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. Proposed in 2021, the Northern Metropolis is a sprawling infrastructure project set to transform 30,000 hectares land near the city’s rural border with mainland China. The tech hub promises to provide jobs, more homes, and deeper integration with neighbouring Shenzhen. However, critics have voiced concern over the HK$224 billion project’s scale and ambition, its impact on sensitive wetland habitats, and the loss of existing homes and farmland. Greenpeace said the targets put forward in the plan omitted wetland protection and paled in comparison to neighbouring Shenzhen, which committed to a 50 per cent wetland protection rate by 2030 in its latest five-year plan. China also introduced a wetland protection law in 2022, the NGO added. While both the FYP and the Policy Address discussed policy measures aimed at expediting the Northern Metropolis project at great length, environmental conservation policies for the area were largely lacking, the NGO said. Large swathes of aquaculture farms inside a protected wetland area in Hong Kong’s Northern Metropolis. File Photo: Greenpeace. “Greenpeace urges the Hong Kong government to catch up with national standards in establishing binding wetland protection targets,” the NGO said in a Chinese-language statement. See also: Protected wetlands in Northern Metropolis damaged by ‘industrial-scale’ shrimp farms, Greenpeace says The NGO also lamented the absence of measures in the two policy documents to curb over-tourism in the city’s rural areas. The FYP failed to outline the timeline to transition to green energy, Greenpeace added....
body.zh: 香港绿色和平组织批评了北方都市发展项目的计划，称该蓝图缺乏对该市与中国大陆边境附近敏感湿地的保护。 2026 年 9 月 16 日，香港行政长官李家超（中）在发表香港第一个五年计划和年度施政报告后出席新闻发布会。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。这个庞大科技中心的细节在行政长官李约翰周三发表的五年计划（FYP）和年度施政报告中公布。该绿色组织表示，五年规划中设定的生态保护目标远远落后于中国重要湿地保护的国家标准。李周三在立法机关制定了香港的第一个五年计划，此举被视为使这个自由的城市更加紧密地配合中国的国家发展轨迹。在环境保护方面，李说，到2030年，香港将“保留”40%的土地和20%的海域作为保护区。香港靠近深圳的边境地区将转变为占地3万公顷的北方都会区。资料照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。北方都市计划于 2021 年提出，是一个庞大的基础设施项目，将改造该市与中国大陆边境附近农村地区的 3 万公顷土地。该科技中心承诺提供就业机会、更多住房，并与邻近的深圳进行更深入的融合。然而，批评人士对这个耗资 2,240 亿港元的项目的规模和雄心、对敏感湿地栖息地的影响以及现有房屋和农田的损失表示担忧。绿色和平组织表示，该计划提出的目标忽略了湿地保护，与邻近的深圳相比相形见绌，深圳在最新的五年计划中承诺到2030年将湿地保护率提高到50%。该非政府组织补充说，中国还于 2022 年出台了湿地保护法。该非政府组织表示，虽然五年计划和施政报告都详细讨论了旨在加快北方都市项目的政策措施，但该地区基本上缺乏环境保护政策。香港北部都会区湿地保护区内有大片水产养殖场。资料图：绿色和平组织。 “绿色和平组织敦促香港政府在制定具有约束力的湿地保护目标方面赶上国家标准，”该非政府组织在一份中文声明中表示。另请参阅：绿色和平组织称，北方都市的受保护湿地因“工业规模”养虾场而遭到破坏 该非政府组织还对两份政策文件中缺乏遏制该市农村地区过度旅游的措施表示遗憾。绿色和平组织补充说，五年计划未能概述向绿色能源过渡的时间表……

reflection.en: As Hong Kong plans its Northern Metropolis, the call for wetland protection underscores a fundamental question: who owns the land and its resources? The psalmist reminds us that the Earth and all its fullness belong to Yahweh. This perspective calls for careful stewardship, balancing human development with the care of creation.
reflection.zh: 随着香港规划其北部都会区，对湿地保护的呼吁凸显了一个根本性问题：土地及其资源属于谁？ 诗篇作者提醒我们，地和其中所充满的，都属于雅伟。 这一视角要求我们谨慎管理，在人类发展与关爱受造物之间取得平衡。

verse.textEn: The earth is Yahweh's, and everything in it, the world, and all who live in it.
verse.textZh: 地和其中所充满的，世界和住在其间的，都属雅伟。

title.en: Policy Address 2026: Hong Kong will build an ‘AI City Brain’ for urban management
title.zh: 政策 العنوان2026：香港将建造“人工智能城市大脑”以改善城市管理

summary.en: Hong Kong's leader, John Lee, announced in his annual Policy Address that the city will develop an 'AI City Brain' to enhance urban management and emergency response. A task force led by the Chief Secretary will be established to oversee this initiative, drawing members from various key government bureaus.
summary.zh: 香港领导人李家超在其年度施政报告中宣布，香港将开发“人工智能城市大脑”，以改善城市管理和应急响应。将成立一个由政务司司长领导的专项小组来监督这项计划，成员将来自多个关键政府部门。

body.en: Hong Kong will build an “AI City Brain” to improve urban management and bolster emergency response, the city’s leader John Lee has announced in his annual Policy Address. Security cameras. File photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. Speaking at the Legislative Council on Wednesday, Lee said he would establish an “AI City Brain” task force led by the Chief Secretary. The new body will include representatives from the Security Bureau, the Transport and Logistics Bureau, the Development Bureau, and the Innovation, Technology and Industry Bureau. Following the mainland’s lead The first “city brain” was developed 10 years ago in Hangzhou by tech giant Alibaba. Since then, the urban AI has spread to cities throughout the Chinese mainland. The platform promises to centralise real-time data from a variety of sources – CCTV cameras, tracking systems, smart sensors, government databases, social media and mobile apps – and then use this information to optimise traffic lights, waste management, and other aspects of urban governance. The digital infrastructure of the Security Bureau’s Emergency Monitoring and Support Centre is scheduled for integration in the first phase. Meanwhile, the Transport Department will study the possibility of setting up an AI traffic management platform that will gather real-time traffic information and help authorities formulate contingency plans for extreme weather and major public events. The police force will also set up a new “Inter-departmental Major Incident Platform” to centralise real-time data from all units when handling major public incidents. Firefighters clean a drain during a flood in Wong Tai Sin on July 20, 2025, as Typhoon Wipha neared the city. File photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. “This will enable more comprehensive information on casualties and missing persons. It will also make use of AI technology to expedite understanding regarding the circumstances of those affected by an incident and provide timely support,” Lee said in his Policy Address. Wang Fuk Court fire aftermath Lee also said that authorities had established an independent commission to investigate the causes of the Wang Fuk Court fire, which killed 168 and displaced thousands from the Tai Po housing estate in November last year. Authorities have arrested multiple individuals linked to the fire, Lee said, adding that the government has also introduced a series of measures and amended relevant laws to improve the maintenance of older buildings. Victims have condemned the government for failing to effectively monitor renovation works, calling for officials as well as construction firm managers to be held accountable. Wang Fuk Court in Tai Po on December 3, 2025, one week after a deadly fire hit the housing...
body.zh: 香港领导人李家超在年度施政报告中宣布，香港将建设“人工智能城市大脑”，以改善城市管理并加强应急响应。安全摄像头。资料照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。李周三在立法会发表讲话时表示，他将成立一个由布政司领导的“人工智能城市大脑”专责小组。新机构将包括保安局、运输及物流局、发展局和创新科技及工业局的代表。跟随大陆的脚步 科技巨头阿里巴巴十年前在杭州开发出了第一个“城市大脑”。自此，城市人工智能遍及中国大陆的各个城市。该平台承诺集中来自各种来源的实时数据——闭路电视摄像机、跟踪系统、智能传感器、政府数据库、社交媒体和移动应用程序——然后利用这些信息来优化交通信号灯、废物管理和城市治理的其他方面。保安局应急监察及支援中心的数码基建计划第一阶段进行整合。同时，运输署将研究建立人工智能交通管理平台，收集实时交通信息，协助当局针对极端天气和重大公共活动制定应急预案。警队还将建立新的“跨部门重大事件平台”，在处理重大公共事件时集中各单位的实时数据。 2025 年 7 月 20 日，台风威帕逼近黄大仙，消防队员正在清理黄大仙洪水期间的排水沟。资料照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。李在施政报告中表示：“这将使有关伤亡和失踪人员的信息更加全面。还将利用人工智能技术加快了解受事件影响的人的情况，并提供及时的支持。”宏福苑火灾后果 李还表示，当局已成立一个独立委员会来调查宏福苑火灾的起因。去年11月，宏福苑火灾造成168人死亡，数千人流离失所。李说，当局已逮捕多名与火灾有关的人员，并补充说，政府还采取了一系列措施并修改了相关法律，以改善旧建筑的维护。受害者谴责政府未能有效监控翻修工程，呼吁官员和建筑公司经理承担责任。 2025 年 12 月 3 日，大埔宏福苑发生致命火灾一周后......

reflection.en: The announcement of Hong Kong's 'AI City Brain' reflects a global trend of rapidly advancing knowledge and technology. Daniel 12:4 speaks of a time when 'many will run to and fro, and knowledge shall increase.' This technological leap forward offers potential benefits for urban efficiency and safety, but also calls for wisdom and discernment in its...
reflection.zh: 香港“人工智能城市大脑”的宣布，反映了全球知识和技术飞速发展的趋势。但以理书12:4提到“必有多人来往奔走，知识也必增长”。这一技术飞跃为城市效率和安全带来了潜在的好处，但也呼唤着智慧和辨别力来指导其应用。

verse.textEn: But you, Daniel, roll up and seal the words of the scroll until the time of the end. Many will go here and there to increase knowledge.
verse.textZh: 但以理啊，你要隐藏这话，封闭这书，直到末时。必有多人来往奔跑，知识就必增长。

title.en: Tiananmen Square vigil organisers jailed for seven years in Hong Kong
title.zh: 香港国安法下，支联会前正副主席煽动颠覆罪成判囚七年

summary.en: Hong Kong activists Chow Hang-tung and Lee Cheuk-yan have been sentenced to seven years in prison after being found guilty of inciting subversion under the city's national security law for their roles in organizing an annual vigil commemorating the Tiananmen Square massacre.
summary.zh: 香港活动人士周庭栋和李卓人因在组织纪念天安门事件的年度集会中煽动颠覆国家政权，根据香港国安法被判处七年监禁。

body.en: Pro-democracy activists Chow Hang-tung and Lee Cheuk-yan were found guilty of ‘incitement to subversion’ in controversial national security case Two pro-democracy activists who were put on trial for organising an annual Tiananmen Square massacre vigil in Hong Kong have been sentenced to seven years in jail, in one of the city’s most significant national security cases. Chow Hang-tung, 41 and Lee Cheuk-yan, 69, were found guilty in August of incitement to subversion . The court found they had “incited other persons to organise, plan, commit or participate in acts by unlawful means with a view to subverting the state power”. Continue reading...
body.zh: 民主活动人士周恒东和李卓人在有争议的国家安全案件中被判犯有“煽动颠覆罪”。两名因在香港组织一年一度的天安门广场大屠杀守夜活动而受审的民主活动人士被判处七年监禁，这是香港最重大的国家安全案件之一。 41 岁的周恒东和 69 岁的李卓人于 8 月被判犯有煽动颠覆罪。法院认为，他们“煽动他人以非法手段组织、策划、实施或者参与颠覆国家政权的行为”。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The sentencing of Chow Hang-tung and Lee Cheuk-yan highlights a profound tension between civic duty and conscience. Their conviction for organizing a Tiananmen Square vigil raises questions about the limits of free expression and assembly when they are perceived to challenge state power. The principle of obeying God over human authorities, even when it...
reflection.zh: 周庭栋和李卓人的判刑凸显了公民责任与良知之间的深刻张力。他们因组织天安门事件悼念集会被定罪，引发了关于言论和集会自由界限的疑问，尤其是在这些自由被视为挑战国家权力之时。即使面临世俗的惩罚，也要优先顺服雅伟而非人间的命令，这一原则在这样的处境中引起了深刻共鸣。

verse.textEn: We must obey God rather than human beings!
verse.textZh: 顺从神，不顺从人，是应当的。

title.en: Wall Street Journal publisher convicted in Hong Kong of deterring reporter from union role
title.zh: 《华尔街日报》出版商在香港被判犯有阻止记者担任工会职务的罪名

summary.en: Dow Jones, the publisher of The Wall Street Journal, has been convicted in a Hong Kong court of one count of deterring reporter Selina Cheng from taking up a role at the Hong Kong Journalist Association. The case raised concerns about press freedom in the city, as Cheng was dismissed weeks after her appointment as...
summary.zh: 《华尔街日报》的出版商道琼斯公司在香港一家法院被判犯有一项阻止记者郑丽莎担任香港记者协会职务的罪名。此案引发了对该市新闻自由的担忧，郑女士在2024年被任命为香港记协主席数周后被公司以重组为由解雇。

body.en: Dow Jones convicted of one count of deterring Selina Cheng from role at Hong Kong Journalist Association but cleared of second charge A Hong Kong court has convicted the publisher of the Wall Street Journal of deterring a reporter from taking up a trade union role, in a case that raised concerns about press freedom in the city. The newspaper dismissed Selina Cheng just weeks after she was appointed chair of the Hong Kong Journalist Association (HKJA) in 2024. She was told at the time her termination was officially due to restructuring. Continue reading...
body.zh: 道琼斯因一项阻止郑秀玲在香港记者协会任职的罪名被定罪，但第二项指控被洗清。香港一家法院判定《华尔街日报》出版商阻止一名记者担任工会职务的罪名成立，此案引起了人们对香港新闻自由的担忧。该报在 2024 年被任命为香港记者协会 (HKJA) 主席几周后解雇了郑嘉颖。当时她被告知，她的解雇正式是由于重组。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The conviction of Dow Jones in Hong Kong for deterring a reporter from union activity underscores a troubling trend where corporate actions can stifle worker advocacy. The prophet Micah reminds us that true righteousness involves acting justly and loving mercy, even in the face of corporate restructuring or perceived inconvenience. May we pray for leaders...
reflection.zh: 道琼斯公司在香港被判阻止记者参与工会活动，这凸显了一个令人担忧的趋势：企业行为可能扼杀工人维权。先知弥迦提醒我们，真正的公义在于秉行公义，喜爱怜悯，即使面对企业重组或所谓的“不便”。愿我们为媒体和商业界的领导者祈祷，愿他们坚守这些原则，确保追求利润不会掩盖员工的基本权利和尊严。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

title.en: Unidentified Murder review – playful sendup of alien abduction and true crime influencers in Hong Kong
title.zh: 《不明谋杀》评论——香港外星人绑架和真实犯罪影响者的趣味模仿

summary.en: Childhood friends claim to have witnessed the disappearance of a schoolkid in this low-budget comedy caper that pushes the limits of storytelling. Modestly scaled and intricately structured, Kwok Ka-Hei and Jack Lee Chun-Kit’s comedy is a playfully affectionate send-up of true crime aficionados and wannabe...
summary.zh: 在一部低成本喜剧冒险片《不明谋杀》中，童年好友声称目睹了一名学童的失踪，该片突破了叙事的界限。由郭嘉曦和李振杰执导的这部规模不大但结构精巧的喜剧，以一种充满爱意的趣味方式模仿了真实犯罪爱好者和伪网红，围绕一个虚构的、已成为香港热议话题的25年前的案件展开。

body.en: Childhood friends claim to have witnessed the disappearance of a schoolkid in this low-budget comedy caper that pushes limits of storytelling Modestly scaled and intricately structured, Kwok Ka-Hei and Jack Lee Chun-Kit’s comedy is a capriciously playful send-up of true crime aficionados and wannabe influencers, done with affection rather than malice. It revolves around a (fictional) 25-year-old case that captivates the whole of Hong Kong. Back when they were seven, childhood friends Mark (Ling Man-lung) and Kit (Ronald Lam Tsz-kit) claimed to have witnessed the abduction by aliens of their classmate Ho in the woods of Tung Tau Hill. On the 25th anniversary of this supposed incident, the pair re-enter the internet’s consciousness after an interview on an online chatshow about unsolved mysteries. Cashing in on their viral fame, Mark’s girlfriend Man (Renci Yeung) hires actor Kim (Peter Chan Charm-man) to pretend to be Ho, all in the hope of racking up views on her social channels. Just when the cameras are all set up, Man watches in horror as the staged reunion leads to a real murder … or does it? The film unfolds in a series of increasingly tricksy complications and reversals. All of a sudden, apparent victims are revealed to be scheming masterminds, and vice versa. As most of the actions take place in the forest where the abduction supposedly occurred, the plot derives comic relief from the increasingly blurred line between truth and playacting. Largely shot with handheld cameras, it has a visual style that lends authenticity to representations of online media, though occasionally this distracts from the physical comedy performed by the cast. The constant twists also turn into bit of a competitive sport, meaning the film becomes more of a writing exercise than anything else. Continue reading...
body.zh: 儿时的朋友声称在这部低成本喜剧中目睹了一名小学生的失踪，这部喜剧突破了讲故事的极限。郭家熙和李俊杰的这部喜剧规模适中，结构复杂，是对真正的犯罪爱好者和想要成为影响者的反复无常的讽刺，是出于感情而不是恶意。它围绕着一个（虚构的）25 年前震惊整个香港的案件展开。七岁时，青梅竹马的Mark（凌文龙饰）和Kit（林中基饰）声称在东头山的树林里亲眼目睹了同学何氏被外星人绑架。在这起所谓的事件发生 25 周年之际，两人在一次关于未解之谜的在线访谈节目中接受采访后，重新进入了互联网的视野。马克的女友曼（杨仁慈饰）利用他们的病毒名气，聘请演员金（陈可辛饰）假扮何浩，希望能在她的社交频道上获得更多的关注。就在摄像机全部架好时，曼惊恐地看着这场上演的重聚导致了一场真正的谋杀……是吗？影片在一系列日益棘手的复杂情况和逆转中展开。突然之间，表面上的受害者被揭露为诡计多端的策划者，反之亦然。由于大部分情节都发生在据称发生绑架的森林中，因此事实与表演之间的界限越来越模糊，情节因此而变得喜剧化。它主要是用手持摄像机拍摄的，其视觉风格为在线媒体的表现提供了真实性，尽管有时这会分散演员们表演的肢体喜剧的注意力。不断的曲折也变成了一场竞技运动，这意味着这部电影更像是一场写作练习。继续阅读...

reflection.en: This Hong Kong comedy playfully satirizes our fascination with true crime and the curated realities of social media influencers. In a world saturated with information and manufactured narratives, the apostle Paul’s exhortation to focus our minds on what is true, noble, right, pure, lovely, admirable, excellent, and praiseworthy offers a timely reminder. May...
reflection.zh: 这部香港喜剧以一种趣味盎然的方式讽刺了我们对真实犯罪故事和社交媒体网红精心打造的现实的迷恋。在这个充斥着信息和虚构叙事的世界里，使徒保罗劝勉我们要将心思意念专注于凡是真实的、凡是可敬的、凡是公义的、凡是清洁的、凡是可爱的、凡是美好的、有德行的、有称赞的，这提醒我们恰逢其时。愿我们培养分辨力，在喧嚣的耸人听闻之中，寻求并沉思那良善、真实和美好的事物。

verse.textEn: Whatever is true, whatever is noble, whatever is right, whatever is pure, whatever is lovely, whatever is admirable — think about such things.
verse.textZh: 凡是真实的、可敬的、公义的、清洁的、可爱的、有美名的，这些事你们都要思念。

title.en: Hong Kong pro-democracy activist Joshua Wong pleads guilty in second national security case
title.zh: 香港民主派活动人士黄之锋承认一项新的国安案件罪名

summary.en: Joshua Wong, a prominent pro-democracy activist in Hong Kong, pleaded guilty to charges of conspiring to seek foreign sanctions against China. This national security offense carries a maximum penalty of life imprisonment.
summary.zh: 香港著名民主派活动人士黄之锋承认了串谋寻求外国制裁中国的指控。这项国家安全罪行最高可判处无期徒刑。

body.en: Wong, 29, is accused of urging foreign powers to impose sanctions, blockades and other hostile measures against China Joshua Wong , one of Hong Kong’s most prominent pro-democracy activists, pleaded guilty on Wednesday to conspiring to seek foreign sanctions against Hong Kong and China, a national security charge that carries a maximum life sentence. Prosecutors have accused Wong, 29, of working with the exiled Hong Kong activist Nathan Law to urge foreign powers to impose sanctions, blockades or other hostile measures against China. Continue reading...
body.zh: 29 岁的黄之锋被指控敦促外国势力对中国实施制裁、封锁和其他敌对措施。香港最著名的民主活动人士之一黄之锋周三承认密谋寻求外国对香港和中国实施制裁，这一国家安全指控最高可判处无期徒刑。检察官指控 29 岁的黄与流亡香港活动人士罗冠聪合作，敦促外国势力对中国实施制裁、封锁或其他敌对措施。继续阅读...

reflection.en: Joshua Wong has pleaded guilty to charges related to seeking foreign sanctions. His case brings to the fore the difficult choices individuals face when they believe their actions align with a higher moral imperative, even when they conflict with state laws. The apostles' declaration, 'We must obey God rather than human beings,' resonates in such moments of...
reflection.zh: 黄之锋承认了寻求外国制裁的相关指控。他的案件凸显了当个人认为自己的行为符合更高的道德指令，即使这与国家法律相冲突时，所面临的艰难抉择。使徒们所宣告的‘我们必须听从雅伟，而不是听从人’，在这样的良心时刻回响。

verse.textEn: We must obey God rather than human beings!
verse.textZh: 顺从神，不顺从人，是应当的。

title.zh: 自然科学

strap.en: Discoveries in nature, climate, health, and the wider cosmos.

title.en: World's water cycle becoming more unpredictable, UN warns
title.zh: 联合国警告：全球水循环变得更加不可预测

summary.en: The United Nations has warned that the Earth's water cycle is becoming increasingly unpredictable, characterized by extreme swings between drought and flood conditions. This trend is expected to be worsened by an unprecedented El Niño event.
summary.zh: 联合国警告称，地球的水循环正变得日益不可预测，表现为在干旱和洪水之间剧烈摇摆。预计前所未有的厄尔尼诺现象将加剧这一长期趋势。

body.en:
This article has been reviewed according to Science X's editorial process and policies . Editors have highlighted the following attributes while ensuring the content's credibility:

The planet's water cycle is becoming increasingly erratic, swinging between too little and too much, the United Nations warned Thursday, with an unprecedented El Niño expected to exacerbate the long-term trend.

Last year was among the driest for the world's rivers in more than three decades, the U.N.'s World Meteorological Organization said in a report.

In 2025—one of the warmest years on record—glaciers also shrank in all regions, even as groundwater levels in many parts of the world were in a multiyear decline, it found.

Overall, the WMO's annual State of Global Water Resources report showed that Earth's freshwater storage—the total amount of water stored in groundwater, lakes and rivers, soil moisture, vegetation, and ice and snow—continued a decade-long decline.

Some elements of the water cycle change rapidly—like precipitation, river flow and soil moisture—responding to weather within days or weeks.

WMO Secretary-General Celeste Saulo voiced particular concern about the decline in "slow reserves," like groundwater and glaciers, which she said had traditionally served as the planet's "savings account."

They have served as "a buffer that absorbs bad years so that a single drought or a single dry season does not translate directly into a water crisis," she told reporters.

Now, "we are depleting that savings account," she warned. "We are spending our reserves."

Glaciers have also been shrinking at a precipitous rate, with 2025 marking the fourth consecutive year in which they shed significant ice mass across all regions.

Between 2023 and 2025, the report estimated that glaciers lost a cumulative global glacier mass of 1,400 gigatons of water—roughly equal to the water required to fill 560 million Olympic-sized swimming pools, or about a third of the world's annual freshwater withdrawals.

"Groundwater tells a similar story: nearly two-thirds of monitored wells worldwide showed conditions outside the historical norm in 2025," Saulo said.

She highlighted that this was happening in parallel with "more water-related disasters."

In particular, she pointed to the current El Niño pattern, which is expected to be the strongest since comparable records began four decades ago.

El Niño is the warm phase of a natural climate cycle that occurs every two to seven years and is characterized by above-average ocean temperatures across the Pacific. It brings worldwide changes in winds and rainfall patterns and erratic weather.

"The strengthening El Niño will increase the risk of drought in some areas and flooding in others," Saulo cautioned.

Even before El Niño hit, rivers...
body.zh: 本文已根据 Science X 的编辑流程和政策进行审阅。编辑在确保内容可信度的同时强调了以下属性： 联合国周四警告说，地球的水循环正变得越来越不稳定，在太少和太多之间摇摆，前所未有的厄尔尼诺现象预计将加剧这一长期趋势。 联合国世界气象组织在一份报告中表示，去年是三十多年来世界河流最干旱的一年。 研究发现，2025 年是有记录以来最温暖的年份之一，尽管世界许多地区的地下水位多年来一直在下降，但所有地区的冰川都出现了萎缩。 总体而言，世界气象组织的年度全球水资源状况报告显示，地球的淡水储存量（地下水、湖泊和河流、土壤湿度、植被以及冰雪中储存的水总量）持续十年来不断下降。 水循环的某些要素会在几天或几周内对天气做出快速反应，例如降水、河水流量和土壤湿度。 世界气象组织秘书长塞莱斯特·索洛对地下水和冰川等“缓慢储备”的减少表示特别担忧，她说这些传统上一直是地球的“储蓄账户”。 她告诉记者，它们起到了“吸收糟糕年份的缓冲作用，这样一次干旱或一次旱季就不会直接转化为水危机”。 现在，“我们正在耗尽储蓄账户，”她警告说。 “我们正在花费我们的储备。” 冰川也在急剧萎缩，到 2025 年，所有地区的冰川将连续第四年流失大量冰块。 该报告估计，2023 年至 2025 年间，全球冰川累计流失了 1,400 亿吨水，大约相当于填满 5.6 亿个奥林匹克规模的游泳池所需的水，约占世界每年淡水抽取量的三分之一。 “地下水讲述了一个类似的故事：到 2025 年，全球近三分之二的监测井的状况超出了历史正常水平，”Saulo 说。 她强调，这种情况与“更多与水有关的灾难”同时发生。 她特别指出了当前的厄尔尼诺现象，预计将是自四十年前有类似记录以来最强烈的一次。 厄尔尼诺现象是自然气候周期的温暖阶段，每两到七年发生一次，其特点是整个太平洋的海洋温度高于平均水平。它带来了全球风和降雨模式的变化以及不稳定的天气。 萨洛警告说：“厄尔尼诺现象的加强将增加一些地区发生干旱和其他地区发生洪水的风险。” 甚至在厄尔尼诺现象发生之前，河流...

reflection.en: The United Nations report highlights a growing instability in the planet's water cycle, a phenomenon that echoes the biblical description of all creation groaning and being in agony as it awaits its final redemption. This erratic behavior, swinging between extremes of too little and too much water, serves as a stark reminder of the fragility of our world...
reflection.zh: 联合国报告强调了地球水循环日益增长的不稳定性，这一现象呼应了圣经中描述的万物都在痛苦呻吟，等待最终救赎的情景。这种在缺水和水涝之间剧烈摇摆的不可预测行为，警示我们世界的脆弱性，以及人类活动和自然循环对环境的深远影响。

verse.textEn: We know that the whole creation has been groaning as in the pains of childbirth right up to the present time.
verse.textZh: 我们知道，一切受造之物一同叹息、劳苦，直到如今。

title.en: NASA spacecraft discovers a huge new crater on the moon
title.zh: NASA航天器在月球上发现了一个巨大的新陨石坑

summary.en: Scientists have discovered a crater on the moon that's bigger than the Roman Colosseum and is the result of a powerful impact two years ago that initially went undetected.
summary.zh: 科学家们在月球上发现了一个比罗马斗兽场还大的陨石坑，这是两年前一次强大撞击的结果，最初并未被发现。

body.en:
This article has been reviewed according to Science X's editorial process and policies . Editors have highlighted the following attributes while ensuring the content's credibility:

Scientists have discovered a crater on the moon that's bigger than the Roman Colosseum and is the result of a powerful impact two years ago that initially went undetected.

The steep-sided hole—about 728 feet (222 meters) across and up to 141 feet (43 meters) deep—is the solar system's biggest known impact crater carved out in recent times.

Such a large-scale event is estimated to occur only once every 132 years, researchers said, making this a treasure trove of information as NASA prepares to build a base for astronauts on the moon.

"This event constitutes a statistically rare, effectively once-in-a-lifetime observation," the scientists wrote in one of two studies appearing on the subject Wednesday in the journal Science Advances .

NASA's Lunar Reconnaissance Orbiter spotted the crater on the moon's near side in May 2024 soon after it was formed by an incoming fragment of an asteroid or comet. The moon strike escaped real-time detection by telescopes on Earth and in space.

LRO's wide-angle images were not identified in the crush of data until August 2025. The spacecraft gathered more detailed pictures last fall, followed by confirmation of the discovery early this year.

The crater—named for the late Thomas McGetchin, a former director of Houston's Lunar and Planetary Institute—is three times bigger than the previous record-holder found by the LRO a decade ago. Pockmarked since ancient times, the moon bears some of the solar system's largest impact craters, including one that stretches more than 1,500 miles (2,400 kilometers) across.

This latest impact churned the lunar surface for more than 66 miles (100 kilometers). Dust and rocky soil were hurled away at a higher angle than expected, according to Mark Robinson, chief scientist for the LRO's cameras who works at Intuitive Machines. Robinson was the lead author for one of the studies.

A separate study identified a 4-mile-wide (7-kilometer-wide) cold spot around the new crater, consistent with a loosening of the moon's top soil. Co-author David Paige of the University of California, Los Angeles, likens it to gardening.

"We're now thinking of impacts as a way to garden the regolith—churning the sediments and putting stuff above that's usually below the surface," Paige said in a statement.

The LRO's numerous crater discoveries since its launch in 2009 show that the moon's top inch (2 centimeters) of soil is being overturned by ejected material every 80,000 years, faster than previously thought, according to Robinson.

Contrary to the popular belief that the Apollo moonwalkers' dusty lunar footprints will last...
body.zh: 本文已根据 Science X 的编辑流程和政策进行审阅。编辑在确保内容可信度的同时强调了以下属性： 科学家们在月球上发现了一个比罗马斗兽场还要大的陨石坑，它是两年前一次强大撞击的结果，最初并未被发现。 这个陡峭的洞直径约 728 英尺（222 米），深 141 英尺（43 米），是太阳系近年来已知最大的撞击坑。 研究人员表示，这种大规模事件估计每 132 年才会发生一次，这使得该事件成为 NASA 准备在月球上为宇航员建造基地时的信息宝库。 科学家们在周三发表在《科学进展》杂志上的两项研究中的一项中写道：“这一事件在统计上是罕见的，实际上是一生一次的观察。” 2024 年 5 月，美国宇航局的月球勘测轨道飞行器在月球近侧发现了这个由小行星或彗星撞击碎片形成的陨石坑。这次月球撞击没有被地球和太空中的望远镜实时探测到。 直到 2025 年 8 月，LRO 的广角图像才在大量数据中被识别出来。该航天器去年秋天收集了更详细的图像，随后在今年年初确认了这一发现。 这个陨石坑以已故休斯敦月球与行星研究所前所长托马斯·麦格钦 (Thomas McGetchin) 的名字命名，比十年前月球勘测轨道飞行器发现的纪录保持者大三倍。月球自古以来就坑坑洼洼，拥有一些太阳系最大的撞击坑，其中一个直径超过 1,500 英里（2,400 公里）。 这次最新的撞击使月球表面搅动了超过 66 英里（100 公里）。 Intuitive Machines 负责月球勘测轨道飞行器相机的首席科学家马克·罗宾逊 (Mark Robinson) 表示，灰尘和岩石土壤以比预期更高的角度被抛出。罗宾逊是其中一项研究的主要作者。 另一项研究在新陨石坑周围发现了一个 4 英里宽（7 公里宽）的冷点，这与月球表层土壤的松动一致。加州大学洛杉矶分校的合著者戴维·佩奇将其比作园艺。 佩奇在一份声明中说：“我们现在正在考虑将影响视为一种对风化层进行园艺的方法——搅拌沉积物并将东西放置在通常位于地表以下的上面。” 罗宾逊表示，自 2009 年发射以来，LRO 发现的众多陨石坑表明，月球顶部一英寸（2 厘米）的土壤每 8 万年就会被喷射出的物质推翻，速度比之前想象的要快。 与人们普遍认为阿波罗登月者布满灰尘的月球足迹将持续下去的看法相反……

reflection.en: The discovery of a massive new crater on the moon, larger than the Roman Colosseum, reminds us of the dynamic and often unseen forces shaping our solar system. It's a testament to the vastness and power of the cosmos, a silent declaration of the Creator's grandeur. As we gaze at the moon and ponder such discoveries, we are invited to reflect on the...
reflection.zh: 在月球上发现一个比罗马斗兽场还大的巨大新陨石坑，提醒我们宇宙中塑造我们太阳系的动态且常常不为人知的力量。这是宇宙浩瀚与力量的证明，是造物主荣耀的无声宣告。 当我们凝视月球并思考这样的发现时，我们被邀请反思雅伟创造的浩瀚，它以我们才刚刚开始理解的方式宣告祂的荣耀。

verse.textEn: The heavens declare the glory of God; the skies proclaim the work of his hands.
verse.textZh: 诸天述说神的荣耀，穹苍传扬他的手段。

title.en: Climate change made deadly Nepal glacier and rock collapse more likely, according to analysis
title.zh: 根据分析，气候变化使尼泊尔冰川和岩石崩塌的致命事件发生的可能性增加

summary.en: Human-caused global warming thinned glaciers and thawed mountain permafrost, likely helping to destabilize the Himalayan slope that collapsed last month and unleashed catastrophic flooding across Nepal, according to a report released Thursday. The report by the World Weather Attribution cautioned that climate change...
summary.zh: 周四发布的一份报告称，人类活动引起的气候变暖导致冰川变薄和山区永久冻土融化，这可能加剧了上个月喜马拉雅山坡的不稳定，并引发了尼泊尔的灾难性洪水。世界天气归因组织（World Weather Attribution）的报告警告说，气候变化并非8月26日灾难的唯一原因，2015年的一次大地震可能在数年前就削弱了岩石。

body.en:
This article has been reviewed according to Science X's editorial process and policies . Editors have highlighted the following attributes while ensuring the content's credibility:

Human-caused global warming thinned glaciers and thawed mountain permafrost, likely helping to destabilize the Himalayan slope that collapsed last month and unleashed catastrophic flooding across Nepal, according to a report released Thursday.

The report by the World Weather Attribution cautioned that climate change was not the sole cause of the Aug. 26 disaster. A large 2015 Nepal earthquake may have weakened the rock years before the collapse, their analysis found.

"This disaster was not an extreme weather event, but the fingerprints of climate change are still clear to see in long-term changes," said Ben Clarke, a climate researcher at Imperial College London who worked on the analysis, in a press statement.

More than 1,300 people were killed and over 5,000 remain missing after a massive section of rock and overlying glacier collapsed near Nepal's border with China. The resulting torrent of water, ice, boulders and sediment swept through communities along the Trishuli River corridor and caused billions of dollars in damage.

Climate scientists said that across the Himalayas rising temperatures are causing glaciers to retreat and thawing permanently frozen ground that helps bind fractured mountain rock together. That means climate change can alter not only weather hazards such as heat and heavy rain, but the stability of the mountains themselves—threatening communities concentrated in narrow river valleys below.

The analysis did not determine whether the collapse would have happened without climate change, caused mainly by the release of greenhouse gases when fuels like oil, gas and coal are burned. However, researchers concluded that warming intensified several processes that made the slope less stable over decades.

The report found that one of the clearest changes directly linked to climate change was the rising elevation of the freezing threshold.

The report found that warming had pushed the altitude at which ground remains consistently frozen upward by roughly 100 meters (328 feet) per decade. This exposes rock at increasingly high elevations to longer periods above freezing, thawing permafrost and causing cracks within the ice, ultimately weakening the rock face under the ice.

Jakob Steiner, a geoscientist at the University of Graz who has worked in the Himalayan region since 2006 but is not an author of Thursday's report, said monitoring instruments around 5,000 meters (16,404 feet) now show that some rock and ground no longer remain frozen throughout the year.

"This means that the ground that was sitting below ice for hundreds and thousands of years is...
body.zh: 本文已根据 Science X 的编辑流程和政策进行审阅。编辑在确保内容可信度的同时强调了以下属性： 周四发布的一份报告称，人为造成的全球变暖导致冰川变薄，山区永久冻土融化，可能导致上个月崩塌的喜马拉雅山斜坡不稳定，并在尼泊尔各地引发灾难性洪水。 世界天气归因组织的报告警告说，气候变化并不是造成 8 月 26 日灾难的唯一原因。他们的分析发现，2015 年尼泊尔发生的一场大地震可能在崩塌前几年就削弱了岩石的强度。 参与这项分析的伦敦帝国理工学院气候研究员本·克拉克在一份新闻声明中表示：“这场灾难不是极端天气事件，但在长期变化中，气候变化的痕迹仍然清晰可见。” 尼泊尔与中国边境附近的一大片岩石和上覆冰川崩塌，造成 1,300 多人死亡，5,000 多人失踪。由此产生的洪流、冰、巨石和沉积物席卷了特里苏利河走廊沿线的社区，造成了数十亿美元的损失。 气候科学家表示，喜马拉雅山脉各地气温上升导致冰川退缩，永久冰冻的地面融化，从而将破碎的山岩粘合在一起。这意味着气候变化不仅会改变炎热和暴雨等天气灾害，还会改变山脉本身的稳定性，从而威胁到集中在下面狭窄河谷的社区。 该分析并未确定如果没有气候变化是否会发生塌陷，气候变化主要是由于石油、天然气和煤炭等燃料燃烧时释放的温室气体造成的。然而，研究人员得出的结论是，变暖加剧了几个过程，使斜坡在几十年内变得不稳定。 报告发现，与气候变化直接相关的最明显的变化之一是冰冻阈值的升高。 报告发现，气候变暖导致持续冰冻的地面高度每十年上升约 100 米（328 英尺）。这使得海拔越来越高的岩石暴露在冰点以上的时间更长，永久冻土融化并导致冰内裂缝，最终削弱冰下的岩石表面。 格拉茨大学地球科学家雅各布·施泰纳自 2006 年以来一直在喜马拉雅地区工作，但他不是周四报告的作者。他表示，5,000 米（16,404 英尺）附近的监测仪器现在显示，一些岩石和地面不再全年保持冻结状态。 “这意味着在冰层下存在了数百年和数千年的地面......

reflection.en: The report highlights how human actions, through climate change, have contributed to the destabilization of natural landscapes, leading to devastating consequences like the Nepal glacier collapse. This echoes the biblical understanding that all of creation groans, burdened by the effects of human sin and environmental neglect, awaiting redemption. As we...
reflection.zh: 报告指出，人类活动通过气候变化加剧了自然景观的不稳定，并导致了尼泊尔冰川崩塌等毁灭性后果。这与圣经中关于万物因人类的罪和对环境的忽视而一同叹息，并等待救赎的观点相呼应。 当我们目睹此类事件时，我们被提醒要承担起管理地球的责任，并认识到我们的行为与自然世界息息相关。愿我们寻求智慧，并以更大的关怀来对待托付给我们的地球。

verse.textEn: We know that the whole creation has been groaning as in the pains of childbirth right up to the present time.
verse.textZh: 我们知道，一切受造之物一同叹息、劳苦，直到如今。

title.en: Does AI make us smarter or more dependent?
title.zh: 人工智能使我们更聪明还是更依赖？

summary.en: Artificial intelligence is increasingly integrated into learning, problem-solving, and knowledge construction. However, it remains unclear whether AI enhances human intellect or promotes excessive reliance.
summary.zh: 人工智能正日益融入人们的学习、解决问题和构建知识的方式中。然而，人工智能究竟是增强了人类的智力，还是助长了过度的依赖，这仍然是一个悬而未决的问题。

body.en:
This article has been reviewed according to Science X's editorial process and policies . Editors have highlighted the following attributes while ensuring the content's credibility:

Artificial intelligence is rapidly becoming part of how people learn, solve problems and construct knowledge. Yet whether AI strengthens human intelligence or encourages excessive dependence remains an open question.

A research team led by Associate Professor Ye Weiming of Peking University HSBC Business School and Li Qian, a faculty associate at Arizona State University's Walter Cronkite School of Journalism and Mass Communication, examined how the public discusses AI-assisted learning.

Their study, published in Comunicar , analyzes the cognitive, behavioral and ethical consequences of using AI to acquire, understand and apply knowledge.

AI improves access to information and helps users complete complex tasks efficiently. However, concerns about inaccurate content, weakened independent thinking, plagiarism and unclear responsibility have also grown. The researchers therefore examined AI-assisted learning through three dimensions—cognition, behavior and ethics—and three stages of knowledge construction—acquisition, comprehension and application.

The study analyzed Reddit discussions from 2013 to 2025. Of 20,174 collected texts, 10,503 valid posts remained after cleaning. Using the Biterm Topic Model (BTM) and qualitative analysis, the researchers identified major public concerns about how AI is changing learning and knowledge construction.

During knowledge acquisition, users appreciated AI's speed and ability to organize information, but factual errors and flawed reasoning created "credibility anxiety." During knowledge comprehension, AI made difficult concepts easier to grasp, while overreliance risked weakening independent reasoning and critical thinking. Some users responded by limiting AI use and reconstructing knowledge themselves.

During knowledge application, AI reduced trial-and-error costs and offered new problem-solving paths. However, it also raised concerns about plagiarism, intellectual property, fairness and responsibility. Overall, public attitudes followed a cycle of trust, doubt and recalibration. AI use also expanded from individual experimentation to result comparison, collaborative verification and community checking.

The study suggests that AI is increasingly becoming an intellectual partner, behavioral facilitator and ethical interlocutor, rather than merely a tool.

The researchers argue that AI-assisted learning is an ongoing negotiation over efficiency, trust, autonomy and responsibility. They call for transparent, participatory and phased governance that can evolve alongside AI technology.
