The DKRZ project is called “CMIP7-ark” — a...
body.zh: 随着世界各地的研究人员开始进行下一次联合国气候评估，人们越来越担心特朗普政府可能会干预美国的关键气候数据。作为回应，科学家们正准备将大量数据转移到德国的存储库。 在德国汉堡市中心的一栋现代化五层建筑中，技术人员正准备安装几个新的“机架”——容纳计算硬件的灰色金属外壳——以及德国气候计算中心 (DKRZ) 狭窄、光线昏暗的走廊上已经排列的分数，该中心是世界上最大的气候模拟数据存储库之一。新设备将在已存储的 254 PB 数据的基础上增加约 5 PB 的存储容量。 1 PB 数据相当于大约 2 亿张高分辨率图像所需的存储空间。 正常情况下，DKRZ的使命是为德国气候科学界提供计算能力和存储。但这些新机架将服务于不同且高度敏感的目的：它们将存储来自大西洋另一边的气候模拟的备份版本。此次行动的目的是确保美国科学家为 2029 年举行的下一次联合国重大气候评估所做的重要工作不会受到特朗普政府的干扰或损害。特朗普政府削减了气候研究资金，埋藏了科学报告，从数十个政府网站上删除了有关人为变暖的内容，并试图阻止卫星收集关键气候数据。 德国科学组织的领导人公开引用这些行动作为他们创建备份的主要动机。该国主要科学资助机构德国研究基金会认为，特朗普政府可能会阻止欧洲获取存储在美国的数据和研究成果。该基金会的项目经理凯瑟琳·温克勒(Kathrin Winkler)表示，“删除数据也成为一种可能性，而且存在[数据]可能被操纵、使研究结果偏向预期方向的风险。” 欧洲对美国科学政策的信任度已降至低点，对丢失科学数据的担忧与日俱增。美国政府于一月份退出了联合国政府间气候变化专门委员会（IPCC）和联合国气候变化框架公约，尽管美国研究人员仍在为全球气候科学做出贡献。为了支持他们，德国研​​究基金会于 2025 年底设立了一项预算为 3500 万美元的计划，为永久存储来自公共和开源来源的美国数据副本提供安全港。 订阅 E360 新闻通讯，每周更新发送到您的收件箱。报名 。 DKRZ 项目称为“CMIP7-ark”——一个...

reflection.en: In a world where data is crucial for understanding our planet, scientists are taking extraordinary steps to safeguard climate information. This act of preservation, moving data across borders, echoes the profound truth that all the Earth and its fullness belong to Yahweh. It calls us to be faithful stewards of the knowledge we gain about creation.
reflection.zh: 在这个数据对于理解我们星球至关重要的世界里，科学家们正采取非凡的措施来保护气候信息。这种跨越国界转移数据的保存行为，呼应了雅伟拥有全地及其万有的深刻真理。它呼唤我们成为所获得的关于受造界知识的忠实管家。

verse.textEn: The earth is Yahweh's, and everything in it, the world, and all who live in it.
verse.textZh: 地和其中所充满的，世界和住在其间的，都属雅伟。

title.en: Rescuers race against time as fires ravage orangutan habitat inside Indonesian oil palm concession
title.zh: 救援人员争分夺秒，大火吞噬印尼油棕种植园内的猩猩栖息地

summary.en: Conservationists are urgently working to rescue orangutans from a peat-swamp forest that has been ravaged by fire within an RSPO-certified oil palm concession in West Kalimantan. The fire is ongoing, with smoke still rising and the ground dangerously hot. This 657-hectare forest, designated as a High Conservation...
summary.zh: 在西加里曼丹，环保主义者正争分夺秒地营救栖息地被大火蹂躏的红毛猩猩，这些森林位于一个获得RSPO认证的油棕种植园内。火势仍在蔓延，浓烟滚滚，地面温度极高。这片占地657公顷的森林被指定为高保护价值区域，约有60只婆罗洲红毛猩猩在此栖息。

body.en: JAKARTA — Conservationists are racing to rescue orangutans from a fire-ravaged peat-swamp forest inside an RSPO-certified oil palm concession in West Kalimantan, with smoke still rising and the ground remaining dangerously hot. The 657-hectare (1,623-acre) forest, designated as a High Conservation Value (HCV) area inside PT Kayung Agro Lestari (KAL), is home to around 60 Bornean orangutans (Pongo pygmaeus), one of three orangutan species in the world and the only one found on the island of Borneo, according to conservationists. The forest was also used in October 2015 to release four orangutans rescued by the Yayasan International Animal Rescue Indonesia (YIARI), a Borneo-based NGO working to establish and maintain sustainable orangutan populations. Nearly 11 years after four orangutans were released there, the peat-swamp forest that provided their habitat has itself been almost completely affected by fire, according to satellite analysis by technology consultancy TheTreeMap. This animation shows the progression of fire within and around the PT Kayung Agro Lestari concession in Ketapang (yellow lines), West Kalimantan, between 8 August and 12 September 2026. The sequence shows how fires progressively burned the HCV forests (turning from dark green to dark red) over the course of several weeks. Image courtesy of TheTreeMap/Nusantara Atlas. The analysis indicates that one of the major fires began on Aug. 8 along a canal at the edge of the oil palm plantation in Ketapang district, before spreading westward into the HCV forest. A team of conservationists, including staff from YIARI, is now trying to rescue orangutans still…This article was originally published on Mongabay
body.zh: 雅加达——西加里曼丹省一处经 RSPO 认证的油棕特许经营区内，自然资源保护主义者正在竞相营救被大火蹂躏的泥炭沼泽森林中的猩猩，浓烟仍在升腾，地面仍处于危险的高温状态。据自然资源保护人士称，这片占地 657 公顷（1,623 英亩）的森林被指定为 PT Kayung Agro Lestari (KAL) 内的高保护价值 (HCV) 区域，是约 60 只婆罗洲猩猩 (Pongo pygmaeus) 的家园，它们是世界上三种猩猩物种之一，也是婆罗洲岛上唯一发现的猩猩物种。 2015 年 10 月，这片森林还被用来释放由 Yayasan International Animal Rescue Indonesia (YIARI) 救出的四只猩猩，Yayasan 是一家位于婆罗洲的非政府组织，致力于建立和维持可持续的猩猩种群。根据技术咨询公司 TheTreeMap 的卫星分析，在四只猩猩被释放近 11 年后，为它们提供栖息地的泥炭沼泽森林本身几乎完全受到火灾的影响。该动画显示了 2026 年 8 月 8 日至 9 月 12 日期间西加里曼丹吉打邦（黄线）的 PT Kayung Agro Lestari 特许权内部和周围的火灾进展情况。该序列显示了火灾如何在几周内逐渐烧毁 HCV 森林（从深绿色变为深红色）。图片由 TheTreeMap/Nusantara Atlas 提供。分析表明，其中一场重大火灾于 8 月 8 日沿着吉打邦地区油棕种植园边缘的一条运河开始，然后向西蔓延到 HCV 森林。包括 YIARI 工作人员在内的自然资源保护团队目前仍在努力营救猩猩……本文最初发表于 Mongabay

reflection.en: The plight of the orangutans, unable to voice their own distress, calls to mind the responsibility to speak for the voiceless. Conservationists are acting as their advocates, a vital role in protecting vulnerable lives and habitats threatened by human activity. May we all be moved to champion those who cannot speak for themselves, whether they be animals,...
reflection.zh: 红毛猩猩无法为自己发声的困境，提醒我们有责任为无声者代言。环保主义者正扮演着它们的代言人，在保护受人类活动威胁的脆弱生命和栖息地方面发挥着至关重要的作用。愿我们都能被感动，为那些不能为自己发声的生命——无论是动物、儿童还是任何边缘群体——而奔走呼吁。

verse.textEn: Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for the rights of all who are destitute. Speak up and judge fairly; defend the rights of the poor and needy.
verse.textZh: 你当为不能自辩的开口，为孤独的伸冤。你当开口按公义判断，为困苦和穷乏的辨屈。

title.en: Exotic pet trade poses rising zoonotic disease risks in India
title.zh: 印度外来宠物贸易增加人畜共患病风险

summary.en: The exotic pet trade in India is escalating the risk of zoonotic disease spillovers. Close contact with imported wild animals provides repeated chances for dangerous pathogens to transfer between humans and animals. Veterinarian Dr. Rina Dev experienced this firsthand when hospitalized with a lung infection, fearing...
summary.zh: 在印度，外来宠物贸易正在增加人畜共患病传播的风险。与进口野生动物的密切接触为危险病原体在人类和动物之间转移提供了反复的机会。兽医 Rina Dev 亲身体验了这种潜在危险，她因肺部感染而住院，担心可能是由她正在治疗的鹦鹉引起的，因为像禽衣原体病这样的疾病可以通过接触而感染。

body.en: In India, the exotic pet trade is increasing the risk of zoonotic disease spillovers, as close contact with imported wild animals creates repeated opportunities for dangerous pathogens to jump to humans and vice versa, reports Mongabay India’s Arathi Menon. Dr. Rina Dev, an avian and exotic animal veterinarian in Mumbai who treats imported and seized wildlife, experienced the potential danger firsthand when she was hospitalized with a lung infection. “I hope it’s not something from the parrots I was treating,” Dev told Mongabay India after she was released from the hospital. Her concerns are warranted: diseases like avian chlamydiosis (psittacosis) are commonly contracted by people who handle birds, earning it the nickname “bird handler’s disease.” Dev noted that traded animals can carry a wide array of infections, including salmonellosis from reptiles, tuberculosis from primates, and avian influenza from birds. “Tuberculosis is increasingly being detected among primates, which is a big zoonotic concern,” she said. Uttara Mendiratta, a conservation researcher working on illegal wildlife hunting and trade, said disease transfer between humans and other primates is especially easy because we’re so closely related. Ebola and HIV can both pass from nonhuman primates to people, for example. Human diseases can also be deadly for wildlife. A global analysis revealed that traded mammals are 1.5 times more likely to share pathogens with humans than nontraded mammals. On average a traded species shares one additional pathogen with humans for every decade it’s traded. Additionally, a 2026 report by Humane World for Animals, a global…This article was originally published on Mongabay
body.zh: 印度 Mongabay 的 Arathi Menon 报道称，在印度，外来宠物贸易正在增加人畜共患疾病蔓延的风险，因为与进口野生动物的密切接触创造了危险病原体多次传染给人类的机会，反之亦然。孟买的鸟类和外来动物兽医 Rina Dev 博士负责治疗进口和捕获的野生动物，她在因肺部感染住院时亲身经历了潜在的危险。 “我希望这不是我正在治疗的鹦鹉身上的东西，”德夫出院后告诉 Mongabay India。她的担忧是有道理的：禽衣原体病（鹦鹉热）等疾病通常是由处理鸟类的人感染，因此被称为“鸟类处理者病”。戴夫指出，交易的动物可能携带多种感染，包括爬行动物的沙门氏菌病、灵长类动物的结核病和鸟类的禽流感。 “灵长类动物中越来越多地发现结核病，这是一个重大的人畜共患病问题，”她说。致力于非法野生动物狩猎和贸易的保护研究员乌塔拉·门迪拉塔 (Uttara Mendiratta) 表示，人类和其他灵长类动物之间的疾病传播特别容易，因为我们的关系非常密切。例如，埃博拉病毒和艾滋病毒都可以从非人类灵长类动物传播给人类。人类疾病对于野生动物来说也可能是致命的。一项全球分析显示，进行贸易的哺乳动物与人类共享病原体的可能性是非贸易哺乳动物的 1.5 倍。平均而言，被交易的物种每交易十年就会与人类共享一种额外的病原体。此外，全球动物人道世界 (Humane World for Animals) 的 2026 年报告……本文最初发表于 Mongabay

reflection.en: The intricate design of creation, evident in the complex biological systems of wild animals, also carries inherent risks when these creatures are removed from their natural contexts and brought into close proximity with human populations. Romans 1:20 reminds us that the unseen qualities of God—eternal power and divine nature—are clearly perceived in the...
reflection.zh: 造物的精妙设计，体现在野生动物复杂的生物系统中，当这些生物脱离其自然环境并与人类密切接触时，也带来了固有的风险。罗马书 1:20 提醒我们，神那看不见的永恒之能和神性，原是藉着所造之物就可以晓得的。这种情况强调了我们在与自然世界互动时需要智慧和尊重，既要认识到它的奇妙，也要认识到它潜在的危险。

verse.textEn: Since the creation of the world God's invisible qualities — his eternal power and divine nature — have been clearly seen, being understood from what has been made.
verse.textZh: 自从造天地以来，神的永能和神性是明明可知的，虽是眼不能见，但借着所造之物就可以晓得。

title.en: Access-to-nature crisis ‘on par with that of Victorian Britain’s filthy air’
title.zh: 自然获取危机“堪比维多利亚时代英国的污浊空气”

summary.en: New research indicates that almost half of all parliamentary constituencies in England have limited access to green and blue spaces, falling short of a government target for everyone to be within a 15-minute walk of such areas. This finding prompts calls for Labour to accelerate its manifesto pledge to improve nature...
summary.zh: 一项新研究表明，英格兰近一半的议会选区自然环境可及性较低，未能达到政府设定的目标——确保每个人都能在15分钟步行范围内到达绿色或蓝色空间。这一发现促使人们呼吁工党加快兑现其改善自然环境可及性和生物多样性的竞选承诺。

body.en: Research finds many in England lack proximity to green and blue spaces as Labour urged to speed up manifesto pledge Nearly half of all parliamentary constituencies in England have low access to nature despite a government target to ensure everyone is within a 15-minute walk from a green or blue space, new research reveals. The analysis by the Wildlife Trusts comes as the charity presents a green paper to ministers in an attempt to speed up Labour’s manifesto promise to improve access to nature and promote biodiversity. Make it more affordable for local authorities to use compulsory purchase powers for land purchase. Establish a community right to buy land for nature access. Treat nature as essential infrastructure, and free up capital funds to pay for the ongoing maintenance of natural spaces. Make it mandatory for developers to create climate- and nature-friendly housing estates. Make access to major rivers, especially those in urban areas, a statutory right. Continue reading...
body.zh: 研究发现，工党敦促加快宣言承诺，许多英格兰人缺乏接近绿色和蓝色空间的机会新的研究显示，尽管政府的目标是确保每个人都在 15 分钟步行范围内到达绿色或蓝色空间，但英格兰近一半的议会选区与大自然的接触程度较低。野生动物信托基金会的分析发布之际，该慈善机构向部长们提交了一份绿皮书，试图加快工党宣言中的承诺，即改善人们接触自然的机会并促进生物多样性。使地方当局能够更容易地使用强制购买权购买土地。建立社区购买土地以进入自然的权利。将自然视为重要的基础设施，并释放资本资金来支付自然空间的持续维护费用。强制开发商建造气候和自然友好型住宅区。使进入主要河流，特别是城市地区的河流成为一项法定权利。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The report reveals a stark reality: many in England lack easy access to the natural world, a space God declared 'very good.' This 'access-to-nature crisis' calls us to consider our stewardship of creation and ensure its benefits are shared, not hoarded.
reflection.zh: 报告揭示了一个严峻的现实：许多英国人难以亲近自然，而雅伟曾宣告这片创造是“甚好的”。这场“自然获取危机”促使我们反思对受造界的管理之责，并确保其益处能被共享，而非被垄断。

verse.textEn: The earth is Yahweh's, and everything in it, the world, and all who live in it.
verse.textZh: 地和其中所充满的，世界和住在其间的，都属雅伟。

title.en: Displaced by typhoons, Taiwan’s Bunun Indigenous people struggle to preserve heritage
title.zh: 因台风流离失所，台湾原住民布农族人努力保存文化遗产

summary.en: Wild grass now grows around the abandoned wooden houses of Tengjhih, a high-mountain hamlet in southern Taiwan, once a key settlement of the Bunun Indigenous people. Around 150 Bunun Indigenous residents of Tengjhih were permanently resettled in lowland areas after Typhoon Morakot in 2009 destroyed the only access...
summary.zh: 台湾南部一个高山村落藤枝的废弃木屋周围野草丛生，这里曾是布农族原住民的重要聚居地。2009年莫拉克台风摧毁了通往村庄的唯一道路后，约150名藤枝的布农族居民被永久安置到低地地区，导致祖屋和文化传承的丧失。

body.en: Wild grass now grows around the abandoned wooden houses of Tengjhih, a high-mountain hamlet in southern Taiwan, once a key settlement of the Bunun Indigenous people. Now, little remains except for the memories it holds. Around 150 Bunun Indigenous residents of Tengjhih were permanently resettled in lowland areas after the deadly Typhoon Morakot in 2009 destroyed the only access road to their village, contributor Aylin Ho reports for Mongabay. Typhoon Morakot killed 755 people across Taiwan, triggering catastrophic floods and landslides. While Indigenous peoples represented just 2.1% of Taiwan’s population at the time, approximately 70% of the land declared unsafe by authorities was located within Indigenous territories. Efforts to rebuild the road to Tengjhih in 2012, 2021 and 2023 faced setbacks due to climate change-amplified rainfall and landslides. More recently, a typhoon in 2025 also devastated one section of the mountain, Ho reports. The indefinite closure of the surrounding Tengjhih National Forest Recreation Area has wiped out the local ecotourism and agricultural economy. “When a major typhoon hits us, I have no income for the entire year,” said Bi’ Ismahasan, 70, a tea and coffee farmer who now relies on government assistance. “In 2026, I lost my entire harvest. Every year is worse than the previous one.” Displacement has severed connections to ancestral land, threatening the transmission of cultural practices and language to younger generations. “Today, when [young people] come back, there is no village and no work,” said Saminat Maliklan, 55, a Bunun cultural guide and one of five…This article was originally published on Mongabay
body.zh: 台湾南部的一个高山小村庄腾智村，曾经是布农族原住民的重要聚居地，如今废弃的木屋周围长满了野草。现在，除了它所承载的记忆之外，所剩无几。据 Mongabay 撰稿人 Aylin Ho 报道，2009 年致命的台风莫拉克摧毁了通往 Tengjhih 村的唯一道路，之后大约 150 名布农族原住民被永久安置在低地地区。台风莫拉克在台湾造成 755 人死亡，引发灾难性洪水和山体滑坡。虽然当时原住民仅占台湾人口的 2.1%，但当局宣布不安全的土地中约有 70% 位于原住民领土内。由于气候变化加剧了降雨和山体滑坡，2012年、2021年和2023年重建通往Tengjhih公路的努力遭遇挫折。据 Ho 报道，最近，2025 年的一场台风也摧毁了这座山的一部分。周边Tengjhih国家森林游乐区的无限期关闭已经摧毁了当地的生态旅游和农业经济。 “当一场大台风袭击我们时，我一整年都没有收入，”70 岁的比伊斯玛哈桑 (Bi’ Ismahasan) 说，他是一名茶叶和咖啡种植者，现在依靠政府的援助。 “2026年，我失去了全部收成。每一年都比前一年更糟。”流离失所切断了与祖传土地的联系，威胁着文化习俗和语言向年轻一代的传播。 55 岁的萨米纳特·马里克兰 (Saminat Maliklan) 说：“如今，当[年轻人]回来时，那里没有村庄，也没有工作。”他是布农族文化导游，也是五人之一……本文最初发表于 Mongabay

reflection.en: The displacement of the Bunun people from their ancestral village of Tengjhih due to Typhoon Morakot in 2009 has disrupted their connection to their heritage. This loss underscores the importance of passing down stories and traditions, ensuring that the memories and cultural identity of a people are not forgotten by future generations. We are called to...
reflection.zh: 莫拉克台风于2009年导致布农族人从其祖居地藤枝村流离失所，这中断了他们与文化遗产的联系。这种失落凸显了传承故事和传统的重要性，确保一个民族的记忆和文化身份不被后代遗忘。我们蒙召要记念并教导我们社群的历史以及雅伟在其中的信实。

verse.textEn: We will not hide them from their descendants; we will tell the next generation the praiseworthy deeds of Yahweh, his power, and the wonders he has done.
verse.textZh: 我们不将这些事向他们的子孙隐瞒，要将雅伟的美德和他的能力，并他奇妙的作为，述说给后代听。

title.en: In Southeast Asia, residents grapple with life under Indonesia’s wildfire haze
title.zh: 在印尼野火烟雾笼罩下，东南亚居民艰难求生

summary.en: Residents in Southeast Asia, particularly in Malaysia, are struggling with severe air pollution caused by wildfires in Indonesia. Cities like Kuching, usually known for clean air, have become the world's most polluted major cities, forcing people like video editor Mohamad Haazim to constantly monitor air quality...
summary.zh: 东南亚居民，特别是马来西亚的居民，正艰难应对印尼野火造成的严重空气污染。像古晋这样的城市，通常以空气清新著称，却已成为全球污染最严重的主要城市之一，迫使像视频编辑Mohamad Haazim这样的人们不断查看空气质量网站。

body.en: KUALA LUMPUR — Video editor Mohamad Haazim has lost count of how many times he refreshes Malaysia’s Air Pollutant Index (API) website every day to check air quality in the city where he lives. It’s been hovering between “unhealthy” and “hazardous” in recent weeks. Haazim, who asked to be identified only by his given names for privacy reasons, lives in Kuching, the capital of Malaysia’s Sarawak state. It is known as one of the cities with the cleanest air quality in the country, but since last month, Kuching has earned a dubious distinction of being the world’s “most polluted major city,” according to IQAir, a Swiss-based air quality technology company. The culprit? Smog from Indonesia’s wildfires. “It has deeply disrupted my daily routine,” Haazim said of the haze. “Outdoor routines are completely on hold; morning and evening walks are out of the question.” An avid marathon runner, Haazim no longer runs five times a week outdoors. “I am now down to just two indoor runs,” he told Mongabay last week. At home and at work, he said he ensures windows are shut tight, with air purifiers running at full blast. Kuching riverside in the city center is shrouded in thick haze in Kuching, Sarawak state, Malaysia, on Sept. 4, 2026. Image by AP Photo/Xpin Voon. He can’t forget his long drive home from Lawas, a Sarawak town located between Sabah and Brunei, on Aug. 31. “The haze became much thicker as we went back to Kuching,” he said. “As we arrived…This article was originally published on Mongabay
body.zh: 吉隆坡——视频编辑穆罕默德·哈齐姆 (Mohamad Haazim) 已经记不清他每天刷新马来西亚空气污染物指数 (API) 网站多少次，以检查他所居住城市的空气质量。最近几周它一直在“不健康”和“危险”之间徘徊。出于隐私原因，哈齐姆要求仅透露自己的名字，他住在马来西亚沙捞越州首府古晋。总部位于瑞士的空气质量技术公司 IQAir 称，古晋被誉为全国空气质量最干净的城市之一，但自上个月以来，古晋获得了世界“污染最严重的主要城市”的可疑称号。罪魁祸首？印度尼西亚山火产生的烟雾。 “它严重扰乱了我的日常生活，”哈齐姆谈到雾霾时说道。 “户外活动完全暂停；早上和晚上散步是不可能的。”作为一名狂热的马拉松运动员，哈齐姆不再每周在户外跑五次。 “我现在只剩下两次室内跑步了，”他上周告诉 Mongabay。他说，在家里和工作时，他都会确保窗户关紧，空气净化器开足马力。 2026 年 9 月 4 日，马来西亚沙捞越州古晋市中心的古晋河边笼罩在浓浓的雾霾中。图片来源：美联社照片/Xpin Voon。他无法忘记8月31日从位于沙巴和文莱之间的砂拉越小镇老越开车回家的路。“当我们回到古晋时，雾霾变得更浓了，”他说。 “当我们到达时......这篇文章最初发表在 Mongabay

reflection.en: The thick haze blanketing Southeast Asia serves as a stark reminder of humanity's impact on the environment. Genesis 2:15 calls us to tend and keep the earth, a mandate that feels urgent when air quality plummets to hazardous levels, affecting daily life and health. May we be moved to greater stewardship of the natural world entrusted to us.
reflection.zh: 笼罩东南亚的浓重烟雾，是人类对环境影响的严峻警示。创世记2:15呼吁我们修理、看守这地，当空气质量降至危险水平，影响日常生活和健康时，这一使命显得尤为迫切。愿我们被激励去更好地管理托付给我们的自然世界。

verse.textEn: Yahweh God took the man and put him in the Garden of Eden to work it and take care of it.
verse.textZh: 雅伟神将那人安置在伊甸园，使他修理看守。

title.en: 2025 was among driest years on record for world’s rivers, study finds
title.zh: 研究发现，2025年全球河流干旱程度创纪录

summary.en: Analysis of global resources reveals depletion in the world’s water savings bank to 42% below normal levels last year. Rivers across the world experienced one of their driest years in more than three decades in 2025, a comprehensive study of global water resources has found. The assessment of the global water cycle by...
summary.zh: 全球资源分析显示，去年世界的水储蓄银行枯竭了42%，低于正常水平。世界气象组织（WMO）对全球水循环的评估显示，世界的水储蓄银行枯竭：去年全球地表或地下的淡水总量，包括地下水、湖泊、河流、冰雪、土壤中的水分以及植物和树木内的水分，比正常水平低了42%。

body.en: Analysis of global resources reveals depletion in world’s water savings bank to 42% below normal levels last year Rivers across the world experienced one of their driest years in more than three decades in 2025, a comprehensive study of global water resources has found. The assessment of the global water cycle by the World Meteorological Organisation (WMO) reveals a depletion in the world’s water savings bank: the amount of freshwater held on or under the ground, including groundwater, lakes, rivers, snow, ice moisture in the soil and inside plants and trees, was 42% below normal across the world last year. Continue reading...
body.zh: 对全球资源的分析显示，去年世界水资源储量枯竭，比正常水平低 42% 对全球水资源的综合研究发现，2025 年，世界各地的河流将经历三十多年来最干旱的年份之一。世界气象组织（WMO）对全球水循环的评估显示，世界水储库正在枯竭：去年世界各地地下或地下的淡水量，包括地下水、湖泊、河流、雪、土壤中以及植物和树木内部的冰水分，比正常水平低42%。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The report details a significant depletion in global freshwater reserves, a stark reminder of the intricate systems that sustain life. Yahweh's creation is filled with 'many things,' each playing a vital role in the planet's delicate balance. May we approach these resources with awe and a renewed commitment to stewardship.
reflection.zh: 报告详细说明了全球淡水储备的严重枯竭，这有力地提醒我们维持生命所必需的复杂系统。雅伟的创造充满了“各样的事物”，每一样都在地球微妙的平衡中扮演着至关重要的角色。愿我们怀着敬畏之心来对待这些资源，并重拾管理之责。

verse.textEn: How many are your works, Yahweh! In wisdom you made them all; the earth is full of your creatures.
verse.textZh: 雅伟啊，你所造的何其多！都是你用智慧造成的；遍地满了你的丰富。

title.en: ‘Like a Disney movie’: Three wild dog brothers make Africa’s longest journey
title.zh: 如同迪士尼电影：三只野狗兄弟完成非洲最长旅程

summary.en: As three wild dog siblings reached maturity and were compelled to leave their pack, scientists documented their dangerous 2,500-mile journey across Africa in search of a new territory. The brothers navigated hazards such as vehicles and hunters, as well as bushmeat snares and human hostility, ultimately finding refuge...
summary.zh: 当三只野狗兄弟成年并被迫离开它们的群体时，科学家们记录了它们为寻找新领地而进行的危险的2500英里旅程。这三兄弟穿越了非洲大陆，躲避了车辆和猎人的危险，以及陷阱和人类的敌意，最终在非洲大草原上找到了新的栖息地。这次非凡的旅程是大陆上任何哺乳动物有记录以来最长的单次迁徙。

body.en: As three siblings came of age and had to leave their pack, scientists tracked the dogs’ perilous 2,500-mile odyssey to find their own territory It sounds like a Disney movie: three wild dogs, all brothers, on an epic journey to find a home of their own after their family tells them to leave. They dodge cars and hunters in search of a new life, navigating bushmeat snares and the hostility of a human-dominated landscape until they find a new haven on the African savannah. But this is exactly what happened in Zambia last year, when three endangered African wild dogs made the longest-ever recorded single journey of any mammal from the continent. The brothers travelled more than 2,500 miles (4,100km) over eight months in their “dispersal” – when a young dog comes of age and must establish new territory to find a mate and start a family of their own. Continue reading...
body.zh: 当三个兄弟姐妹成年并不得不离开他们的狼群时，科学家们追踪了这些狗为寻找自己的领地而进行的 2,500 英里的危险冒险。这听起来就像一部迪士尼电影：三只野狗，都是兄弟，在家人告诉他们离开后，踏上了寻找自己家的史诗般的旅程。他们躲避汽车和猎人，寻找新的生活，穿越丛林肉陷阱和人类主导的敌对环境，直到在非洲大草原上找到新的避风港。但这正是去年在赞比亚发生的事情，当时三只濒临灭绝的非洲野狗完成了有记录以来来自非洲大陆的哺乳动物中最长的单次旅行。兄弟俩在八个月的时间里旅行了超过 2,500 英里（4,100 公里）——当一只小狗成年后，必须建立新的领地来寻找伴侣并组建自己的家庭。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The epic journey of these three wild dog brothers, facing dangers and seeking a new home, echoes the ancient biblical understanding of creation itself groaning under the weight of its fallen state. Even in the wild, the struggle for survival and the search for a safe haven are profound realities. This instinctual drive to find a place of belonging and...
reflection.zh: 这三只野狗兄弟史诗般的旅程，它们面对危险并寻找新家园，呼应了圣经中关于受造界本身在堕落状态下呻吟的古老观念。即使在野外，生存的挣扎和对安全避难所的寻找也是深刻的现实。 这种本能的驱动力，尽管面临巨大的危险，也要寻找归属和安全之地，这反映了所有生物内心深处更深切的渴望，而这种渴望最终将在雅伟对受造界的救赎计划中得到满足。

verse.textEn: We know that the whole creation has been groaning as in the pains of childbirth right up to the present time.
verse.textZh: 我们知道，一切受造之物一同叹息、劳苦，直到如今。

title.en: English Heritage trains new generation of scythers to maintain meadows and craft
title.zh: 英格兰遗产委员会培训新一代割草工以维护草地和工艺

summary.en: An initiative aims to preserve an ancient skill and improve habitats for rare bees, involving volunteers cutting meadows by hand. This effort by English Heritage seeks to maintain modern meadowland using traditional methods.
summary.zh: 一项倡议旨在保留古老的技能并改善稀有蜜蜂的栖息地，招募志愿者用传统方式手工割草。英格兰遗产委员会的这项努力旨在以古老的方式维护21世纪的草地。

body.en: Initiative aims to keep alive age-old skill, and at Muchelney Abbey in Somerset improve habitat for rare shrill carder bee It sounds like something out of a Thomas Hardy novel: a merry band of men and women roaming the West Country cutting meadows by hand in exchange for hunks of bread and cheese. But the conservation charity English Heritage is recruiting a team of volunteer scythers to maintain 21st-century meadowland in the old-fashioned way. Continue reading...
body.zh: 该倡议旨在保留古老的技艺，并在萨默塞特郡的穆切尔尼修道院改善稀有的刺耳卡德蜂的栖息地。这听起来像是托马斯·哈代小说中的情节：一群快乐的男女在西部乡村手工砍伐草地，以换取大块面包和奶酪。但保护慈善机构英国遗产正在招募一支镰刀志愿者团队，以传统方式维护 21 世纪的草地。继续阅读...

reflection.en: It is inspiring to see an organization like English Heritage revive an 'age-old skill' through volunteer efforts. This dedication to traditional craftsmanship and environmental care reflects the biblical call to approach all our work with diligence and purpose, as if serving a higher calling. Colossians 3:23 reminds us, 'Whatever you do, work at it with all...
reflection.zh: 看到英格兰遗产委员会这样的组织通过志愿者的努力复兴一项“古老的技艺”，这令人鼓舞。这种对传统工艺和环境保护的奉献，体现了圣经中呼吁我们全心投入工作，如同为主而做，而非为人服务的精神。 歌罗西书3章23节提醒我们：“无论做什么，都要从心里做，像是为主做的，不像为人做的。”这种古老的技艺如今服务于现代的保育目标，正是这种全心投入精神的体现。

verse.textEn: Whatever you do, work at it with all your heart, as working for Yahweh, not for human masters.
verse.textZh: 无论做什么，都要从心里做，像是给主做的，不是给人做的。

title.en: Humpback whale filmed apparently grieving its stillborn calf – video
title.zh: 视频显示座头鲸似乎在哀悼其死产的幼崽

summary.en: Footage from July 2025 shows a humpback whale returning repeatedly for over an hour to the location of its stillborn calf, approximately one kilometer off Australia's Gold Coast. While similar behaviors have been observed in other cetaceans, this is reportedly the first documented instance of a baleen whale mother...
summary.zh: 2025年7月的视频显示，一只座头鲸在澳大利亚黄金海岸附近一公里处，一个多小时内反复返回其死产幼崽所在的位置。虽然在其他鲸类中也观察到过类似行为，但这据称是首次有须鲸母亲表现出对已故新生儿的这种关怀。

body.en: Footage recorded in July 2025 shows a humpback whale repeatedly returning for more than an hour to the spot where its stillborn calf lay, a kilometre off Australia’s Gold Coast. While similar behaviours have been documented in pilot whales, dolphins and killer whales, a new report from Griffith University and the Sea World Foundation suggests this is the first described case of a toothless baleen whale mother caring for her deceased newborn calf. ‘However, we can’t directly measure the emotional state of whales,’ writes Olaf Meynecke, a co-author of the report. ‘The behaviours we observed could represent grief, but they could also reflect maternal attachment, confusion or instinctive caregiving. For this reason, researchers use broader terms – such as postmortem attentive behaviour – rather than concluding that whales grieve in the human sense’ Do whales grieve? Rare footage of humpback alongside stillborn calf suggests they might Continue reading...
body.zh: 2025 年 7 月记录的视频显示，一头座头鲸在一个多小时内反复返回其死产幼崽所在的地点，该地点距离澳大利亚黄金海岸一公里。虽然领航鲸、海豚和虎鲸也有类似行为，但格里菲斯大学和海洋世界基金会的一份新报告表明，这是首例描述无牙须鲸母亲照顾已故新生幼鲸的案例。该报告的合著者奥拉夫·梅内克（Olaf Meynecke）写道：“然而，我们无法直接测量鲸鱼的情绪状态。” “我们观察到的行为可能代表悲伤，但也可能反映母性依恋、困惑或本能的照顾。”出于这个原因，研究人员使用更广泛的术语——比如死后的关注行为——而不是得出人类意义上的鲸鱼悲伤的结论“鲸鱼会悲伤吗？”座头鲸和死产小牛旁边的罕见镜头表明它们可能会继续阅读...

reflection.en: The profound instinctual bond between a mother and her young is evident in the humpback whale's persistent return to her stillborn calf. This deep connection, a part of the natural world's fabric, echoes the biblical description of all creation groaning in travail, awaiting redemption. It reminds us that even in the animal kingdom, there is a reflection of...
reflection.zh: 母鲸与其幼崽之间深刻的本能联系，体现在座头鲸反复回到其死产幼崽身边的行为中。这种深厚的情感纽带是自然界的一部分，呼应了圣经中关于万物一同叹息、劳苦产难的描述，一同等候那得赎的日子。这提醒我们，即使在动物界，也反映出弥漫于存在中的深切悲伤与渴望。

verse.textEn: We know that the whole creation has been groaning as in the pains of childbirth right up to the present time.
verse.textZh: 我们知道，一切受造之物一同叹息、劳苦，直到如今。

title.en: At Least 124 Environmental Defenders Killed Worldwide Last Year
title.zh: 去年全球至少有124名环境卫士遇害

summary.en: A new report reveals that at least 124 individuals were murdered last year for defending their natural environments, such as forests, farms, and waterways. The report's authors attribute this violence, partly, to reduced foreign aid weakening human rights groups that support these defenders, with specific mention of...
summary.zh: 一份新报告显示，去年至少有124名个人因捍卫森林、农场或水道等自然环境而遭到谋杀。报告作者认为，这种暴力部分归因于富裕国家削减对外援助，削弱了支持这些卫士的人权团体，并特别提到了援助削减对哥伦比亚相关工作的影响。

body.en:
At least 124 people were murdered last year for defending their forests, farms, or waterways from destruction or degradation, according to a stark new report. Its authors say that deep cuts to foreign aid by wealthy nations have weakened human rights groups that support environmental defenders.

“The effects of these budget cuts are not abstract,” said Juliana Vélez Echeverri , a senior campaigner with the watchdog group Global Witness, which published the report . “In Colombia, projects working to promote and protect human rights and support defenders have been hit by the sudden drop in foreign aid, particularly from the U.S.”

Land disputes were linked to more than half of the killings of environmental defenders last year, while roughly a third of those killed were Indigenous people, according to the report. Latin America accounted for 85 percent of killings, making it the deadliest region for defenders, a distinction it has earned every year since Global Witness began tracking killings in 2012.

Last year Colombia led the world with 39 murders, followed by Brazil with 26. Colombia has seen a surge in the growing of coca, used to make cocaine, and its cultivation is driving conflicts over land, putting defenders in the crosshairs of drug traffickers. In Brazil, killings were concentrated at the edges of the Amazon, where miners, loggers, and ranchers are illegally pushing further into the rainforest.

The Philippines was once again the deadliest country in Asia. It recorded 12 killings last year, as armed forces cracked down on activists. Killings were lower elsewhere on the continent, though the report documents how Indonesia has moved to criminalize activism, while regimes in Russia and across Central Asian nations have worked to discredit political opponents through online smear campaigns.
body.zh: 一份严峻的新报告显示，去年至少有 124 人因保护森林、农场或水道免遭破坏或退化而被谋杀。该报告的作者表示，富裕国家大幅削减对外援助削弱了支持环境捍卫者的人权组织。 “这些预算削减的影响并不抽象，”发布该报告的监督组织全球见证的高级活动家朱莉安娜·贝莱斯·埃切维里 (Juliana Vélez Echeverri) 表示。 “在哥伦比亚，致力于促进和保护人权以及支持维权者的项目受到了外国援助突然减少的打击，特别是来自美国的援助。” 报告称，去年一半以上的环境捍卫者遇害事件与土地纠纷有关，而其中约三分之一的遇害者是原住民。拉丁美洲占杀戮事件的 85%，使其成为维权者死亡最严重的地区，自全球见证 2012 年开始追踪杀戮事件以来，该地区每年都获得这一殊荣。 去年，哥伦比亚发生了 39 起谋杀案，位居世界第一，其次是巴西，有 26 起。哥伦比亚用于制造可卡因的古柯种植量激增，其种植加剧了土地冲突，使捍卫者成为毒贩的目标。在巴西，杀戮集中在亚马逊地区的边缘，那里的矿工、伐木者和牧场主正在非法深入雨林。 菲律宾再次成为亚洲死亡人数最多的国家。去年，武装部队镇压活动人士，导致 12 人被杀。非洲大陆其他地方的杀戮人数较低，但报告记录了印度尼西亚如何将激进主义定为犯罪，而俄罗斯和整个中亚国家的政权则致力于通过网上抹黑运动来抹黑政治对手。

reflection.en: The earth groans under the weight of destruction, and its defenders pay the ultimate price for speaking for its protection. Proverbs 31:8-9 calls us to 'speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves,' a mandate that extends to the natural world itself, which has no voice to plead its case against exploitation. May we find courage to advocate for...
reflection.zh: 大地在毁灭的重压下呻吟，而它的捍卫者们为保护它付出了生命的代价。《箴言》31:8-9呼吁我们“为不能说话者说话”，这一使命也延伸至自然界本身，它无法为自己免遭剥削而辩护。愿我们找到勇气去倡导保护造物，即使代价高昂。

verse.textEn: Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for the rights of all who are destitute. Speak up and judge fairly; defend the rights of the poor and needy.
verse.textZh: 你当为不能自辩的开口，为孤独的伸冤。你当开口按公义判断，为困苦和穷乏的辨屈。

title.en: Record heatwaves bring Britain’s second-best butterfly season in 16 years
title.zh: 创纪录高温带来英国16年来第二佳蝴蝶季

summary.en: Volunteers counted almost 1.4m common butterflies and moths, with painted ladies up 335% on last year. The record-breaking heat of 2026 delivered the second-best British butterfly season of the past 16 years, according to the Big Butterfly Count. The largest insect count in the world, in which more than 100,000...
summary.zh: 志愿者们统计了近140万只常见的蝴蝶和飞蛾，其中纹白蝶的数量比去年增加了335%。根据“大蝴蝶统计”的数据，2026年创纪录的高温带来了英国过去16年来第二好的蝴蝶季。这项世界上最大的昆虫统计活动，有超过10万名志愿者统计了近140万只常见的蝴蝶和白天飞行的蛾子，证实了许多人的体验——在长达五个星期的热浪夏季里，蝴蝶数...

body.en: Volunteers counted almost 1.4m common butterflies and moths, with painted ladies up 335% on last year The recording-breaking heat of 2026 delivered the second-best British butterfly season of the past 16 years, according to the Big Butterfly Count . The largest insect count in the world, in which more than 100,000 volunteers counted almost 1.4m common butterflies and day-flying moths, confirmed what many people experienced – a noticeable profusion of butterflies during the five-heatwave summer. Continue reading...
body.zh: 志愿者清点了近 140 万只普通蝴蝶和飞蛾，其中彩绘蝴蝶数量比去年增加了 335%。根据 Big Butterfly Count 的数据，2026 年破纪录的高温带来了过去 16 年来第二好的英国蝴蝶季节。世界上最大规模的昆虫统计，超过 100,000 名志愿者统计了近 140 万只普通蝴蝶和飞蛾，证实了许多人的经历——在五次热浪夏季期间，蝴蝶数量明显增多。继续阅读...

reflection.en: Even amidst record heatwaves, the natural world displays remarkable resilience and beauty, as seen in Britain's flourishing butterfly population. This abundance serves as a testament to the intricate design and power of the Creator, whose invisible attributes are clearly perceived through the wonders of creation. It invites us to pause and recognize the...
reflection.zh: 即使在创纪录的热浪中，自然界也展现出惊人的韧性和美丽，英国蝴蝶数量的繁盛便是明证。这种丰饶证明了造物主精妙的设计和力量，祂那不可见的神性特质，借着受造物的奇妙，可以被清晰地看见。这邀请我们停下脚步，认识到那编织在生命之中的神圣艺术。

verse.textEn: Since the creation of the world God's invisible qualities — his eternal power and divine nature — have been clearly seen, being understood from what has been made.
verse.textZh: 自从造天地以来，神的永能和神性是明明可知的，虽是眼不能见，但借着所造之物就可以晓得。

title.en: Country diary: Drama on the trail cam – this is Somerset’s version of the snow leopard | Derek Niemann
title.zh: 乡村日记： the trail cam 上的戏剧——这是萨默塞特郡的雪豹版本

summary.en: In Frome, Somerset, efforts to help struggling hedgehogs have finally yielded a sighting. The story questions the extent of human intervention, detailing a hedgehog's escape from a predator via a tunnel, where its own defenses deterred the hunter. This encounter raises questions about natural instincts and...
summary.zh: 在萨默塞特郡的弗洛姆，帮助挣扎的刺猬的努力终于得到了一个目击。故事质疑人类干预的程度，详细描述了一只刺猬通过隧道逃脱捕食者，其自身的防御措施吓退了猎人。这次遭遇引发了关于自然本能和干预的问题。

body.en: Frome: We’ve been trying to help out struggling hedgehogs, and finally we have a sighting. But how long should we intervene for? Deep into the night, and out of our sight, tiny claws rake over plastic. The animal skitters halfway through a pipe, then stops. A hunter five times its weight is on its tail, but it is safe from harm, and not just because the tunnel is too narrow for the hunter to enter. Curiosity killed the cat’s predatory thoughts with a face full of prickles a long time ago. The cat sniffs the tube, and wanders off. Continue reading...
body.zh: 弗罗姆：我们一直在努力帮助陷入困境的刺猬，最后我们看到了它们。但我们应该干预多久呢？夜色深处，在我们的视线之外，小爪子在塑料上耙着。这只动物在管道中滑行了一半，然后停了下来。一个体重是其体重五倍的猎人在尾巴上，但它不会受到伤害，这不仅仅是因为隧道太窄，猎人无法进入。好奇心早已杀掉了满脸刺痛的猫的掠食念头。猫闻了闻管子，然后走开了。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The natural world is a profound teacher. Observing the intricate dance of predator and prey, like the hedgehog escaping the cat thanks to its unique defenses and environment, reminds us that wisdom is often found in the details of creation. Yahweh's handiwork invites us to look closely and learn.
reflection.zh: 大自然是一位深刻的老师。观察捕食者与猎物之间错综复杂的互动，例如刺猬因其独特的防御和环境而逃脱猫的追捕，这提醒我们智慧常常蕴藏在创造的细节之中。雅伟的作为邀请我们仔细观察并从中学习。

verse.textEn: But ask the animals, and they will teach you, or the birds in the sky, and they will tell you; or speak to the earth, and it will teach you, or let the fish in the sea inform you.
verse.textZh: 你且问走兽，走兽必指教你；又问空中的飞鸟，飞鸟必告诉你。或与地说话，地必指教你；海中的鱼也必向你说明。

title.en: From Indigenous Loss, a Potent Legal Argument on Climate
title.zh: 从原住民的损失中，一个强有力的气候法律论点

summary.en: Human rights lawyer Julian Aguon discusses how global warming endangers not only the existence of small island nations but also the cultural traditions of their Indigenous inhabitants. He is incorporating these harms into legal challenges, which have already seen a significant victory at the International Court of...
summary.zh: 人权律师朱利安·阿圭恩探讨了全球变暖如何不仅威胁到小岛屿国家的生存，也威胁到其原住民的传统。他正在将这些伤害纳入法律诉讼，包括在国际法院取得重大胜利。

body.en:
Human rights lawyer Julian Aguon explores how warming threatens not only the survival of small island nations but also the traditions of their Indigenous peoples. He is citing these injuries in legal actions, including in a major victory at the International Court of Justice last year.

Last year, the International Court of Justice unanimously ruled that countries have a legal obligation to limit greenhouse gas emissions. The decision was the culmination of a years-long campaign launched by a group of law students in the Pacific island nation of Vanuatu.

The landmark opinion , which said countries’ failure to address emissions from fossil fuels and other sources could carry legal consequences, provides a potentially powerful new tool for communities, organizations, or governments suing in national courts to compel climate action or win damages. It could also push international climate negotiators toward a more aggressive stance on a danger the judges called “urgent and existential.”

Julian Aguon, an Indigenous Chamorro human rights lawyer from Guam, wore a garland of coconut fronds and cowry shells as he argued Vanuatu’s case in The Hague. He and his colleagues had traveled across Melanesia and Micronesia to gather testimony from residents whose homes, cultures, and livelihoods are being devastated by climate change.

While the impact of climate change is typically measured in degrees of warming, feet of flooding, or monetary losses, for many Indigenous people it is inflicting a profound cultural, spiritual, and emotional injury that the sterile language of science and economics fails to capture, said Aguon, founder of the Guam-based Indigenous rights and environmental justice firm Blue Ocean Law. In an interview with Yale Environment 360, he said that highlighting the harms Indigenous peoples and cultures are suffering proved a potent legal strategy at the United Nations’ main judicial body.

“Climate change is unraveling the very terms by which people know themselves and keep covenant with the natural world.” In the ICJ case, he said, “we brought that to the court’s attention because these are rights violations of the highest order — violations of the right to life, the right to culture, the right to self-determination.”

Yale Environment 360 : Can you tell me about the testimonies you and your colleagues gathered when you traveled to Vanuatu, Fiji, and other island nations in preparation for the case? How did they shape your arguments in court?

Julian Aguon : There’s no way to translate the urgency and gravity of the climate crisis other than via firsthand accounts of loss and damage, so we wanted to foreground vulnerable communities’ experiences. The process revealed in spectacular ways just how emaciated the global discourse on climate harms...
body.zh: 人权律师朱利安·阿古恩探讨了气候变暖如何不仅威胁小岛屿国家的生存，而且威胁其土著人民的传统。他在法律诉讼中引用了这些伤害，包括去年在国际法院取得的重大胜利。 去年，国际法院一致裁定各国有限制温室气体排放的法律义务。这一决定是太平洋岛国瓦努阿图的一群法律学生发起的长达数年运动的高潮。 这一具有里程碑意义的意见指出，各国未能解决化石燃料和其他来源的排放问题可能会带来法律后果，为社区、组织或政府在国家法院提起诉讼以强制采取气候行动或赢得损害赔偿提供了一个潜在的强大新工具。它还可能促使国际气候谈判代表对法官所说的“紧迫且事关生死存亡”的危险采取更积极的立场。 来自关岛的查莫罗原住民人权律师朱利安·阿古恩 (Julian Aguon) 在海牙为瓦努阿图的案件辩护时戴着椰子叶和贝壳制成的花环。他和他的同事们走遍了美拉尼西亚和密克罗尼西亚，收集那些家园、文化和生计正受到气候变化破坏的居民的证词。 总部位于关岛的原住民权利和环境正义公司“蓝海法”的创始人阿古恩表示，虽然气候变化的影响通常以变暖程度、洪水深度或金钱损失来衡量，但对许多原住民来说，它正在造成深刻的文化、精神和情感伤害，这是科学和经济学语言无法捕捉到的。在接受耶鲁环境 360 采访时，他表示，事实证明，强调土著人民和文化所遭受的伤害是联合国主要司法机构的有效法律策略。 “气候变化正在瓦解人们认识自己并与自然世界保持契约的条件。”他说，在国际法院案件中，“我们提请法院注意这一点，因为这些都是最高级别的侵犯权利行为——侵犯生命权、文化权和自决权。” 耶鲁环境 360：您能告诉我您和您的同事在前往瓦努阿图、斐济和其他岛国准备此案时收集的证词吗？他们如何影响你在法庭上的论点？ 朱利安·阿古恩：除了通过损失和损害的第一手资料之外，没有其他方法可以体现气候危机的紧迫性和严重性，因此我们希望突出弱势社区的经历。这一过程以惊人的方式揭示了全球关于气候危害的讨论是多么的无力……

reflection.en: In the face of climate change, the voices of Indigenous peoples and small island nations are often drowned out. Julian Aguon's legal advocacy, however, amplifies their suffering and demands accountability, embodying the principle of speaking for those who cannot speak for themselves. His work reminds us that justice requires us to champion the cause of the...
reflection.zh: 面对气候变化，原住民和小岛屿国家的呼声常常被淹没。然而，朱利安·阿圭恩的法律倡导放大了他们的痛苦，并要求问责，体现了为那些不能为自己发声的人说话的原则。他的工作提醒我们，正义要求我们为弱势群体争取权益，确保他们的困境被听到和解决。

verse.textEn: Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for the rights of all who are destitute. Speak up and judge fairly; defend the rights of the poor and needy.
verse.textZh: 你当为不能自辩的开口，为孤独的伸冤。你当开口按公义判断，为困苦和穷乏的辨屈。

title.en: ‘It’s really taking off’: hedge revival as farmers rediscover ancient tools
title.zh: “真的在兴起”：农民重拾古老工具，树篱复兴

summary.en: Grant applications in England are surging as interest grows in hedge habitats that capture carbon and help reduce flood risk. The ancient craft of hedge laying, using techniques popular in the 18th and 19th centuries, is experiencing a strong revival as farmers seek to boost wildlife, capture carbon, and tackle...
summary.zh: 在英格兰，随着人们对能够固碳并帮助减少洪水风险的树篱栖息地兴趣的增长，相关补助金的申请激增。古老的树篱铺设工艺正在经历强劲复兴，农民们采用在18世纪和19世纪达到顶峰的技术来促进野生动物繁衍、固碳并帮助应对洪水。

body.en: Grant applications in England surge as interest grows in habitat that captures carbon and helps reduce flood risk The ancient craft of hedge laying is experiencing a strong revival as farmers use techniques that peaked in the 18th and 19th centuries to boost wildlife, capture carbon and help tackle flooding. Hedge laying, which restores and revives mature hedges to keep them fresh, was among the four most popular categories of capital grants selected by farmers out of a total pot of £225m provided by the government this year to support practical environmental improvements on farms and across the countryside. Continue reading...
body.zh: 随着人们对捕获碳和帮助降低洪水风险的栖息地的兴趣日益浓厚，英格兰的赠款申请激增 随着农民利用 18 世纪和 19 世纪鼎盛时期的技术来增加野生动物数量、捕获碳并帮助应对洪水，古老的树篱铺设工艺正在经历强劲复兴。树篱铺设可以恢复和恢复成熟的树篱，使其保持新鲜，是农民从今年政府提供的总计 2.25 亿英镑的资金补助中选择的四种最受欢迎​​的资本补助类别之一，用于支持农场和整个农村的实际环境改善。继续阅读...

reflection.en: It is encouraging to see farmers turning to time-tested methods, recognizing the inherent wisdom in the land itself. This revival of hedge laying reminds us that creation holds profound lessons for stewardship, offering practical solutions for environmental challenges. As we observe the natural world, we can learn much about sustainable practices and the...
reflection.zh: 看到农民们转向经过时间考验的方法，认识到土地本身的内在智慧，这令人鼓舞。这种树篱铺设工艺的复兴提醒我们，造物蕴含着关于管理的深刻教训，为环境挑战提供了切实可行的解决方案。 当我们观察自然世界时，我们可以学到许多关于可持续实践和生命相互联系的知识。愿这种对古老生态智慧的新认识，能激发更多植根于对雅伟的创造物之尊重的新创新。

verse.textEn: But ask the animals, and they will teach you, or the birds in the sky, and they will tell you; or speak to the earth, and it will teach you, or let the fish in the sea inform you.
verse.textZh: 你且问走兽，走兽必指教你；又问空中的飞鸟，飞鸟必告诉你。或与地说话，地必指教你；海中的鱼也必向你说明。

title.en: Iceland, One of Three Countries That Still Hunts Whales, Considers Ban
title.zh: 冰岛，仍捕鲸的三国之一，考虑禁止

summary.en: Iceland, one of only three countries still permitting commercial whaling alongside Norway and Japan, is considering a ban. The Icelandic government plans to introduce a bill in February that could end the practice.
summary.zh: 冰岛是仍允许商业捕鲸的三个国家之一，与挪威和日本并列，但现在正在考虑禁止。冰岛政府将于二月提出一项法案，可能禁止这一做法。

body.en:
Iceland is one of just three countries, along with Norway and Japan, that still allows commercial whaling in its waters, but that may be about to change. The Icelandic government will put forward a bill in February that could ban the practice.

The Icelandic government will allow for as many as 134 minke whales and 150 fin whales to be killed this year by its last remaining whaling company, Hvalur. While minke whales are not a threatened species, fin whales are classified as vulnerable to extinction by the International Union for Conservation of Nature. So far this year, 80 adult fin whales have been killed in Iceland, where authorities have found that harpooned animals often endure immense suffering. A 2023 report released by the Icelandic Food and Veterinary Authority determined that some harpooned whales can take up to two hours to die. The government is now looking to update its whaling law, it says, and will consider a permanent ban on whaling. “This is a really significant milestone in efforts to consign to history Iceland’s cruel and needless whale hunts,” said Wendy Higgins , a spokesperson for Humane World for Animals.

Over the past two decades, Icelandic whalers have killed more than 1,000 fin whales, according to Humane World for Animals, which says that most of the whale meat produced is consumed not by Icelanders but by visiting tourists.

Whaling in the early 20th century decimated populations of cetaceans around the world, leading countries to agree to an international ban on whale hunting in 1986. Despite the ban, Norway resumed commercial whaling in 1993, Iceland in 2006, and Japan in 2019.
body.zh: 冰岛是仅有的三个仍然允许在其水域进行商业捕鲸的国家之一，但这种情况可能即将改变。冰岛政府将于二月份提出一项法案，可能禁止这种做法。 冰岛政府今年将允许其最后一家捕鲸公司 Hvalur 捕杀多达 134 头小须鲸和 150 头长须鲸。虽然小须鲸不是受威胁物种，但长须鲸被国际自然保护联盟列为易危物种。今年到目前为止，冰岛已有 80 头成年长须鲸被杀，当局发现被鱼叉刺伤的动物常常承受巨大的痛苦。冰岛食品和兽医局 2023 年发布的一份报告确定，一些鱼叉鲸可能需要两个小时才能死亡。政府目前正在寻求更新捕鲸法，并将考虑永久禁止捕鲸。人道动物世界发言人温迪·希金斯 (Wendy Higgins) 表示：“这确实是一个重要的里程碑，旨在让冰岛残忍和不必要的鲸鱼捕猎成为历史。” 根据动物人道世界的数据，在过去的二十年里，冰岛捕鲸者已经捕杀了 1000 多头长须鲸，该组织表示，生产的大部分鲸肉不是由冰岛人食用，而是由来访的游客食用。 20 世纪初的捕鲸活动导致世界各地的鲸目动物数量锐减，导致各国于 1986 年同意国际禁止捕鲸。尽管有这项禁令，挪威还是于 1993 年恢复了商业捕鲸，冰岛于 2006 年恢复了商业捕鲸，日本于 2019 年恢复了商业捕鲸。

reflection.en: The news from Iceland, a nation deeply connected to the sea, brings a potential shift in its long-standing whaling practices. This consideration invites reflection on the intricate tapestry of life Yahweh has woven into our world, a creation so vast and wondrous that even our best efforts to understand it reveal only a fraction of its glory. May this moment...
reflection.zh: 来自冰岛的消息，一个与海洋紧密相连的国家，预示着其长期捕鲸习俗可能发生转变。这一考量促使我们反思雅伟编织在我们世界中的生命织锦，这创造是如此浩瀚而奇妙，即使我们尽最大努力去理解，也只能揭示其荣耀的一小部分。愿这个潜在变革的时刻激发对所有被造物的更深敬畏。

verse.textEn: How many are your works, Yahweh! In wisdom you made them all; the earth is full of your creatures.
verse.textZh: 雅伟啊，你所造的何其多！都是你用智慧造成的；遍地满了你的丰富。

title.en: The Breakdown of Natural Systems Could Intensify Warming by 30 Percent
title.zh: 自然系统失灵可能加剧变暖30%

summary.en: As the planet heats up, natural systems like tundras, wetlands, and forests are breaking down, releasing significant emissions. This 'feedback loop' could amplify human-caused warming by 20 to 30 percent, adding further temperature increases even if net zero emissions are achieved.
summary.zh: 随着地球变暖，苔原解冻、湿地发酵、森林遭受更频繁的野火。这些自然系统的崩溃释放出巨量排放物，进一步加剧了因燃烧化石燃料而引起的变暖。研究表明，这种反馈循环可能将人类活动造成的变暖放大20%至30%。

body.en:
As the planet heats up, tundras are thawing, wetlands are fermenting, and forests are succumbing to larger and more frequent wildfires. The breakdown of these natural systems is unleashing huge volumes of emissions, further intensifying warming from the burning of fossil fuels. According to new research, such feedback loops could amplify human-driven warming by 20 to 30 percent.

Even if humans reach net zero emissions later this century, feedbacks would add another 0.2 degrees C of warming, according to the modeling study , published this week in Environmental Research Letters. And if the world fails to reach net zero, and countries continue to produce some residual emissions through the end of this century, the added warming would be closer to 0.4 degrees C.

The world is already 1.4 degrees C hotter than in the preindustrial era, and fossil fuel emissions continue to grow, putting the Earth on course to surpass 2.5 degrees C of warming this century, scientists say, well in breach of international climate targets. And yet, while the added warming from feedback loops will further hasten the rise in temperatures, emissions from the breakdown of natural systems are largely absent from the most influential climate models, those that inform climate negotiations.

“This hidden multiplier is missing from the models guiding climate policy, so those models are likely underestimating how much warming is coming — and overestimating how much carbon we can still afford to emit,” said lead author Sam Abernethy, a researcher at Spark Climate Solutions, a San Francisco-based nonprofit that aims to identify climate “blind spots” and account for them in policy. ”To close that gap, we need to understand these processes better and build them into the models we rely on.”

The challenges are steep. Feedback loops are difficult to model, and emissions data is lacking in hard-to-reach places, such as Siberia or the Congo Basin. But as Yale Environment 360 recently reported , scientists around the world are now racing to forecast emissions from natural systems.

“If you’re not including all the emissions going into the atmosphere, you’re hamstrung from the get-go,” Brian Buma, a climate scientist at the Environmental Defense Fund, told e360 . “People are recognizing that the longer we go without taking these emissions into account, there’s just going to be a bigger gap.”
body.zh: 随着地球变暖，苔原正在融化，湿地正在发酵，森林正在遭受更大、更频繁的野火的袭击。这些自然系统的崩溃正在释放大量的排放物，进一步加剧了化石燃料燃烧造成的变暖。根据新的研究，这种反馈循环可能会使人类造成的变暖幅度扩大 20％ 至 30％。 根据本周发表在《环境研究快报》上的模型研究，即使人类在本世纪晚些时候达到净零排放，反馈也会使气温再增加 0.2 摄氏度。如果世界未能实现净零排放，并且各国在本世纪末继续产生一些残余排放，则升温幅度将接近 0.4 摄氏度。 科学家表示，世界温度已经比工业化前时代高出 1.4 摄氏度，而化石燃料排放量继续增加，使地球本世纪升温将超过 2.5 摄氏度，这远远违反了国际气候目标。然而，虽然反馈循环带来的额外变暖将进一步加速气温上升，但最有影响力的气候模型（为气候谈判提供信息的模型）基本上不存在自然系统崩溃造成的排放。 “指导气候政策的模型中缺少这个隐藏的乘数，因此这些模型可能低估了即将到来的变暖程度，并高估了我们仍然能够承受的碳排放量，”主要作者萨姆·阿伯内西（Sam Abernethy）说，他是旧金山非营利组织 Spark Climate Solutions 的研究员，旨在识别气候“盲点”并在政策中加以考虑。 “为了缩小这一差距，我们需要更好地理解这些过程，并将它们构建到我们依赖的模型中。” 挑战是严峻的。反馈回路很难建模，西伯利亚或刚果盆地等难以到达的地方缺乏排放数据。但正如耶鲁环境 360 最近报道的那样，世界各地的科学家现在正在竞相预测自然系统的排放量。 美国环境保护基金会的气候科学家布莱恩·布马 (Brian Buma) 告诉 e360：“如果不包括进入大气中的所有排放量，那么从一开始就会受到阻碍。” “人们认识到，不考虑这些排放的时间越长，差距就会越大。”

reflection.en: The report details how Earth's natural systems are 'groaning' under the strain of climate change, releasing emissions that worsen warming. This echoes Romans 8:22, which speaks of all creation groaning in travail, awaiting its ultimate liberation. It’s a stark reminder of our interconnectedness with the planet and the deep impact of human actions on the...
reflection.zh: 报道详细说明了地球的自然系统在气候变化的重压下“一同叹息”，释放出加剧变暖的排放物。这呼应了罗马书8:22所说的，万物都在一同劳苦，等候得着释放。这有力地提醒我们与地球的相互联系，以及人类行为对整个世界产生的深远影响。

verse.textEn: We know that the whole creation has been groaning as in the pains of childbirth right up to the present time.
verse.textZh: 我们知道，一切受造之物一同叹息、劳苦，直到如今。

title.zh: 纪录片精选

strap.en: New and notable documentaries — nature, creation, and the stories worth two hours of attention.
strap.zh: 值得关注的新纪录片——自然、受造世界，以及值得花两小时细看的故事。

title.en: ‘When you tell people the story, it’s almost too good to be true’: the incredible journey behind The Cycle of Love
title.zh: 《爱之循环》背后的不可思议之旅：当你告诉人们这个故事，它几乎好得令人难以置信

summary.en: Documentary director Orlando von Einsiedel discusses the true story of a man who cycled 6,000 miles from India to Sweden in search of his true love, a tale that promises to warm hearts. The story begins in New Delhi in December 1975 when Swedish hippie Lotta von Schedvin met Indian street artist Pradyumna Kumar...
summary.zh: 纪录片导演奥兰多·冯·艾因西德尔讲述了一个真实故事：一位男子骑行了6000英里，从印度到瑞典寻找他的真爱，这个故事足以温暖人心。故事始于1975年12月的德里，瑞典嬉皮士洛塔·冯·谢德文遇见了印度街头艺术家普拉迪尤姆纳·库马尔·马哈南迪亚（PK）。两人一见钟情，迅速坠入爱河，PK陪同洛塔回到了他在印度的村庄。然而，不久...

body.en: Documentary director Orlando von Einsiedel on how the real life tale of a man who cycles 6,000 miles from India to Sweden to find his true love will warm your heart New Delhi, December 1975. It was love at first sight when a Swedish hippy called Lotta von Schedvin sat down to be sketched by an Indian street artist, Pradyumna Kumar Mahanandia, known to everyone as PK. In the 10 minutes it took PK to complete her portrait, everything clicked into place for the pair. They were swept headlong in a whirlwind romance, and PK took Lotta to his village in the east of India to meet his family. But soon after, the time came for Lotta to pack up her VW campervan and head back home with her friends. Heart-stricken PK promised to follow, but a plane ticket to Sweden was an impossible dream. Determined not to lose the love of his life, PK bought a secondhand Raleigh bike, and with $80 sewn into the waistband of his trousers, set off to cycle 6,000 miles to Lotta . He knew the sun set in the west, so that was the direction he took. His plan was to follow the hippy trail, cycling through India, Pakistan, Afghanistan, Iran and Turkey, crossing Europe, finally arriving in Sweden. Continue reading...
body.zh: 1975 年 12 月，新德里，纪录片导演奥兰多·冯·艾因西德尔 (Orlando von Einsiedel) 讲述了一个男人骑车 6,000 英里从印度到瑞典寻找真爱的真实故事如何温暖你的心。当瑞典嬉皮士洛塔·冯·谢德文 (Lotta von Schedvin) 坐下来接受印度街头艺术家普拉杜姆纳·库马尔·马哈南迪亚 (Pradyumna Kumar Mahanandia)（大家都称为 PK）的素描时，他一见钟情。 PK 花了 10 分钟完成了她的肖像画，两人的一切都顺利完成。他们被旋风般的浪漫所席卷，PK带着洛塔到印度东部的村庄去见他的家人。但不久之后，洛塔就收拾好她的大众露营车，和朋友们一起回家了。伤心欲绝的PK答应了，但一张飞往瑞典的机票却是一个遥不可及的梦想。 PK 决心不失去一生挚爱，他买了一辆二手罗利自行车，并用 80 美元缝在裤腰带上，出发骑车 6,000 英里前往洛塔。他知道太阳已经西下，所以他就朝西边走。他的计划是沿着嬉皮士路线，骑自行车穿过印度、巴基斯坦、阿富汗、伊朗和土耳其，穿越欧洲，最后到达瑞典。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The incredible journey of Pradyumna Kumar Mahanandia, cycling thousands of miles for love, echoes the profound commitment described in Genesis. This story reminds us that true love can inspire extraordinary devotion and a willingness to bridge vast distances for union. This journey, spanning 6,000 miles from India to Sweden, speaks to a deep human longing...
reflection.zh: 普拉迪尤姆纳·库马尔·马哈南迪亚为爱骑行数千英里的非凡旅程，呼应了《创世记》中所描述的深刻承诺。这个故事提醒我们，真爱能够激发非凡的奉献精神，以及为结合而跨越遥远距离的意愿。 这场跨越印度到瑞典6000英里的旅程，体现了人类对连接的深切渴望，以及一个人可能为了珍贵的关系而付出的努力。它彰显了爱的强大力量，能够激励个人承担起艰巨的任务。

verse.textEn: That is why a man leaves his father and mother and is united to his wife, and they become one flesh.
verse.textZh: 因此，人要离开父母，与妻子连合，二人成为一体。

title.en: The Watergate Caper: Richard Nixon and the Death of the American Dream review – political scandal, 70s style
title.zh: 水门事件：理查德·尼克松与美国梦之死评论——70年代风格的政治丑闻

summary.en: Shane O’Sullivan’s documentary weaves archive clips and snippets from films old and new to draw out the highlights of the crisis that rocked the US. Judging by his past work, the Irish-born, London-based writer and film-maker Shane O’Sullivan may have a chronic case of...
summary.zh: 沙恩·奥沙利文的纪录片通过剪辑旧电影和新电影的片段，回顾了那场震动美国的危机的亮点。从他过去的作品来看，这位出生于爱尔兰、现居伦敦的作家兼电影制作人沙恩·奥沙利文可能患有……

body.en: Shane O’Sullivan’s documentary weaves archive clips and snippets from films old and new to draw out the highlights of the crisis that rocked the US Judging by his past work, the Irish-born, London-based writer and film-maker Shane O’Sullivan may have a chronic case of born-too-late nostalgia. It manifests as a fascination with the politics and counterculture of the late 1960s and 70s, and that’s clearly a theme in O’Sullivan’s previous works, which include: a book and film about the assassination of Robert Kennedy; the acclaimed feature doc Children of the Revolution about the female leaders of the Baader-Meinhof Group and the Japanese Red Army; and a film about Lee Harvey Oswald . His latest takes aim at the big kahuna itself: Watergate – the crime, the scandal and the cultural phenomenon. It is explored through a hailstorm of archive clips and snippets of feature films, all nimbly stitched together, with a deadpan voiceover by the great Harry Shearer. The result is, of course, nostalgic, but also feels fresh and immediate, especially thanks to the use of moments from more recent features about, but not from, the period, including a Watergate-hearings-obsessed teenage Christina Ricci in The Ice Storm from 1997, the comic ineptitude of the Watergate burglars as represented in 1999 spoof Dick, or Shea Whigham’s skewering of break-in mastermind G Gordon Liddy from recent TV miniseries Gaslit. These performed moments all play nicely with O’Sullivan’s selection of clips from more contemporaneous, Watergate-adjacent classics such as Medium Cool, All the President’s Men and Taxi Driver. Continue reading...
body.zh: 肖恩·奥沙利文 (Shane O’Sullivan) 的纪录片将新旧电影中的档案片段和片段编织在一起，勾勒出这场震撼美国的危机的亮点。从爱尔兰出生、现居伦敦的作家兼电影制片人肖恩·奥沙利文 (Shane O’Sullivan) 过去的作品来看，他可能患有一种长期的、生来太晚的怀旧情绪。它表现为对 20 世纪 60 年代末和 70 年代政治和反主流文化的迷恋，这显然是奥沙利文之前作品的主题，其中包括：一本关于罗伯特·肯尼迪遇刺的书籍和电影；广受好评的专题纪录片《革命之子》讲述了巴德尔-迈因霍夫集团​​和日本红军的女性领导人；以及一部关于李·哈维·奥斯瓦尔德的电影。他的最新作品瞄准了大魔王本身：水门事件——犯罪、丑闻和文化现象。通过大量的档案剪辑和故事片片段来探索它，所有这些都灵活地缝合在一起，并由伟大的哈利·希勒（Harry Shearer）面无表情的画外音。当然，其结果是怀旧的，但也让人感觉新鲜和直接，特别是得益于使用了有关这一时期的最新电影中的片段，包括 1997 年《冰风暴》中沉迷于水门事件听证会的青少年克里斯蒂娜·里奇，1999 年恶搞迪克所代表的水门窃贼的滑稽无能，或者谢伊·惠格姆对入室盗窃的串烧最近电视迷你剧《煤气灯火》中的策划者 G Gordon Liddy。这些表演时刻都与奥沙利文从更多同时代的、与水门事件相关的经典作品中精选的片段（例如《Medium Cool》、《总统班底》和《出租车司机》）完美契合。继续阅读...

reflection.en: Shane O’Sullivan’s documentary revisits the Watergate scandal, a moment when trust in American leadership was profoundly shaken. The crisis serves as a stark reminder that national integrity is not merely a political ideal but a foundational element of a nation's character and stability. When leaders betray public trust, the very fabric of the nation's...
reflection.zh: 沙恩·奥沙利文的纪录片重温了水门事件，那是一个美国领导层信任受到严重动摇的时刻。这场危机鲜明地提醒我们，国家的正直不仅仅是一个政治理想，更是国家品格和稳定的基石。当领导人辜负公众信任时，国家梦想的根基就会受到威胁。

verse.textEn: Righteousness exalts a nation, but sin condemns any people.
verse.textZh: 公义使邦国高举；罪恶是人民的羞辱。

title.en: Ex-BBC presenter questions role of Royal Family in new documentary
title.zh: 新纪录片中前BBC主持人质疑王室的作用

summary.en: Veteran broadcaster John Humphrys has released a new documentary, 'The Royals: Time to Go?', exploring the role of the Royal Family and arguing that the UK public should have the right to choose their leaders. The film features discussions with both critics and supporters of the monarchy.
summary.zh: 资深广播人约翰·汉弗莱斯推出了一部新纪录片《王室：是时候离开了？》，探讨了王室的作用，并主张英国公众应该有权选择自己的领导人。该片采访了君主制的批评者和支持者。

body.en:
Veteran broadcaster John Humphrys has said the people of the United Kingdom should "be able to choose our leaders" as he releases a documentary exploring the role of the Royal Family.

Humphrys, who for decades was one of the most prominent faces on the BBC, is presenting a new Channel 4 documentary called The Royals: Time to Go?

Speaking to BBC Radio Wales Breakfast , the Cardiff-born presenter said he "admires" King Charles III in many ways, but said it was a "matter of choice".

In the documentary, Humphrys speaks to both critics and supporters of the monarchy, and makes the case for electing a president as the head of state.

He recalled seeing the late Queen Elizabeth II visiting Cardiff when he was growing up, watching her being driven down Newport Road.

"My father didn't attend and said he would never bend the knee to anyone. I guess that rubbed off on me," he said.

Humphrys asked why it was seen as such a taboo to call for an alternative to the Royal Family, saying that "we can because it's a democracy".

"I know the monarch is not a political leader, but he is our leader, and we need to bow our knee to him.

He met the Queen throughout his career, including at Buckingham Palace where he said he spoke to her "and the corgis of course".

Humphrys, who presented the Nine O'Clock News, the Today programme and Mastermind throughout a decades-long career with the corporation, said he took the opportunity to ask her for an interview.

"When I'd finished, she looked up at me and said just one word 'no' and I thought I could build on that," he said.
body.zh: 资深广播员约翰·汉弗莱斯在发布一部探索王室角色的纪录片时表示，英国人民应该“能够选择我们的领导人”。 几十年来，汉弗莱斯一直是 BBC 最著名的面孔之一，他正在制作第四频道的一部新纪录片，名为《皇家队：该出发了？》 这位出生于卡迪夫的主持人在接受英国广播公司威尔士广播电台早餐节目采访时表示，他在很多方面“钦佩”国王查理三世，但表示这是一个“选择的问题”。 在纪录片中，汉弗莱斯与君主制的批评者和支持者进行了交谈，并阐述了选举总统作为国家元首的理由。 他回忆起在他长大的时候看到已故女王伊丽莎白三世访问卡迪夫，看着她被开车沿着纽波特路行驶。 “我父亲没有出席，他说他永远不会向任何人屈服。我想这对我产生了影响，”他说。 汉弗莱斯问为什么呼吁替代王室被视为禁忌，他说“我们可以，因为这是民主国家”。 “我知道君主不是政治领袖，但他是我们的领袖，我们需要向他屈服。 他在整个职业生涯中都见过女王，包括在白金汉宫，他说他在那里与她“当然还有柯基犬”交谈过。 汉弗莱斯在该公司长达数十年的职业生涯中一直主持《九点钟新闻》、《今日节目》和《Mastermind》，他说他借此机会邀请她接受采访。 “当我说完后，她抬头看着我，只说了一个字‘不’，我想我可以在此基础上再接再厉，”他说。

reflection.en: John Humphrys' documentary prompts a timely question about the nature of leadership and the right of citizens to choose their heads of state. Jeremiah 22:3 calls rulers to 'execute justice and righteousness, and deliver from the oppressor him who suffers violence.' This verse reminds us that leadership, whether inherited or elected, carries a profound...
reflection.zh: 约翰·汉弗莱斯的纪录片提出了一个关于领导力本质和公民选择国家元首权利的及时问题。《耶利米书》22章3节呼吁统治者“施行公平和公义，拯救被欺压的脱离欺压者的手”。这节经文提醒我们，无论是世袭还是民选的领导，都肩负着公正服务人民的重大责任。

verse.textEn: Do what is just and right. Rescue from the hand of the oppressor the one who has been robbed.
verse.textZh: 你们要施行公平和公义，拯救被抢夺的脱离欺压人的手。

title.en: Israeli minister threatens to strip Israeli film-makers of citizenship over Gaza documentary NAZA
title.zh: 以色列部长威胁取消加沙纪录片制作人的公民身份

summary.en: Israel's culture minister, Miki Zohar, has called for the citizenship of Oscar-winning directors Yuval Abraham and Rachel Szor to be revoked. He accused them of "treason against the state" for their documentary 'NAZA,' which exposes the Israeli intelligence service's acronym for expected civilian casualties in Gaza...
summary.zh: 以色列文化部长米基·佐哈尔呼吁取消奥斯卡获奖导演尤瓦尔·亚伯拉罕和蕾切尔·索尔的公民身份。他指责他们制作的纪录片《NAZA》犯有“叛国罪”，该片揭露了以色列情报部门用于表示加沙空袭中预期平民伤亡的缩略语。这部电影强调了以色列军事行动对平民造成的毁灭性影响。

body.en: Miki Zohar accuses Oscar-winning directors Yuval Abraham and Rachel Szor of ‘treason against the state’ ‘They know the house they are bombing is full of children’: NAZA’s directors on their devastating film about Israeli intelligence Israel’s culture minister has called for the Oscar-winning Israeli directors of NAZA , a documentary about the country’s mass killing of civilians in Gaza, to be stripped of their citizenship, accusing them of “treason against the state”. NAZA, which was produced by the Guardian, is named for an acronym used by Israel’s intelligence service to indicate how many civilians it expects to die in an airstrike on Gaza. Continue reading...
body.zh: 米基·佐哈尔指责奥斯卡获奖导演尤瓦尔·亚伯拉罕和雷切尔·索尔“背叛国家”“他们知道他们轰炸的房子里都是孩子”：NAZA 的导演在拍摄有关以色列情报的毁灭性电影时以色列文化部长呼吁剥夺奥斯卡获奖导演 NAZA 的以色列国籍，这是一部关于该国在加沙大规模屠杀平民的纪录片，指责他们“背叛国家”。 NAZA 由《卫报》制作，以以色列情报部门使用的缩写词命名，用于表示预计在加沙空袭中将有多少平民死亡。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The story presents a stark conflict between artistic expression and state power. When a government official threatens to revoke citizenship for a film that documents civilian suffering, it raises questions about accountability and the role of art in confronting difficult truths. Jeremiah 22:3 calls leaders to "execute justice and righteousness" and protect...
reflection.zh: 这个故事呈现了艺术表达与国家权力之间尖锐的冲突。当一位政府官员威胁要取消一部记录平民苦难的电影制作人的公民身份时，就引发了关于问责制和艺术在面对艰难真相中的作用的问题。耶利米书 22:3 呼吁领导人“施行公平和公义”，保护弱者，这是一个可以衡量此类行为的标准。

verse.textEn: Do what is just and right. Rescue from the hand of the oppressor the one who has been robbed.
verse.textZh: 你们要施行公平和公义，拯救被抢夺的脱离欺压人的手。

title.en: ‘Who do you really believe?’: the true crime fans who became a part of the story
title.zh: “你到底相信谁？”：成为故事一部分的真实犯罪迷

summary.en: In HBO’s gripping new docuseries A Killer Story, a crusading couple become convinced that the woman accused of murder is innocent. A man and a woman were murdered in cold blood inside their Topeka, Kansas, bedroom under cover of darkness in 2002. Suspicion quickly fell on the man’s ex-wife, Dana Chandler, with family...
summary.zh: 在HBO引人入胜的新纪录片系列《一个杀人故事》中，一对热心的夫妇坚信被指控谋杀的女子是无辜的。2002年的一天晚上，一男一女在堪萨斯州托皮卡家中被谋杀。嫌疑很快落在了受害男子的前妻 Dana Chandler...

body.en: In HBO’s gripping new docuseries A Killer Story, a crusading couple become convinced that woman accused of murder is innocent A man and a woman are murdered in cold blood inside their Topeka, Kansas, bedroom under cover of darkness in 2002. Suspicion quickly falls on the man’s ex-wife, Dana Chandler, with family and forensic evidence painting her as the jealous type. But the county prosecutor at the time declines to pursue charges in large part because nothing places Chandler at the scene of the crime. It’s only after a politically motivated prosecutor is appointed and CBS’s 48 Hours airs a 2009 report rehashing the case that Chandler is arrested on two counts of premeditated first-degree murder in 2011 and condemned to consecutive life sentences the following year. No doubt: the story is hot copy. And more than likely, Chandler’s conviction marks the conclusion if a husband-and-wife team of true crime enthusiasts hadn’t become convinced that the real killer was still walking free. “There’s a lot of questions that remain,” says film-maker Matthew Galkin. “But when you start to unpack the crime itself, there’s a lot of hoops to jump through and a very high bar to clear in order for her to have pulled this off.” Continue reading...
body.zh: 在 HBO 扣人心弦的新纪录片《杀手故事》中，一对斗志昂扬的夫妇确信被指控谋杀的女子是无辜的。 2002 年，一名男子和一名女子在黑暗的掩护下，在堪萨斯州托皮卡的卧室里被冷血谋杀。嫌疑人很快就落到了该男子的前妻达纳·钱德勒的身上，家人和法医证据都将她描绘成嫉妒型的人。但当时的县检察官拒绝提出指控，很大程度上是因为没有任何证据显示钱德勒在犯罪现场。直到任命了一位出于政治动机的检察官，并且哥伦比亚广播公司的 48 小时频道播出了 2009 年的报道，重述了此案之后，钱德勒才于 2011 年因两项预谋一级谋杀罪被捕，并在次年被连续判处无期徒刑。毫无疑问：这个故事是热门副本。如果一对真正的犯罪爱好者组成的夫妻团队没有相信真正的凶手仍然逍遥法外，那么钱德勒的定罪很可能标志着一个结论。 “还有很多问题没有解决，”电影制片人马修·加尔金说。 “但是，当你开始揭开犯罪本身的真相时，为了让她成功完成这件事，有很多障碍需要跨越，还有很高的门槛需要克服。”继续阅读...

reflection.en: This documentary series delves into the complexities of true crime, where a couple's conviction of innocence challenges the initial accusations. It reminds us of the importance of seeking truth and not settling for the first or loudest narrative. Proverbs 18:17 speaks to this, stating that 'The first person to speak in a lawsuit seems right, until someone...
reflection.zh: 这部纪录片系列深入探讨了真实犯罪的复杂性，其中一对夫妇坚信某女子无辜，这挑战了最初的指控。它提醒我们寻求真相的重要性，不要满足于第一个或最响亮的声音。箴言18:17对此有所阐述，‘在讼事上先开口的，似乎都有理；但邻 Comes，就审问他。’

verse.textEn: In a lawsuit the first to speak seems right, until someone comes forward and cross-examines.
verse.textZh: 先诉情由的，似乎有理；但邻舍来到，就察出实情。

title.en: Musk review – epic study of the world’s richest and most banal man
title.zh: 马斯克评论——关于世界上最富有但又最平庸的男人的史诗研究
